data.htmlContent:
MBE 刑法考点解析

Property Crimes & Parties
正确答案：D. Receiving Stolen Property
(收受赃物罪)
核心考点：收受赃物罪的构成要件
Receiving Stolen Property 要求同时满足以下三个要素：
  1. Receiving control: 取得对被盗财物的控制权。
  2. Knowledge: 在接收时明知该财物是被盗的。
  3. Intent: 具有永久剥夺物主所有权的特定意图 (Specific Intent)。
案情逻辑推演
1
接收控制 (Control)：
朋友将偷来的药品交给学生，学生接受了。这满足了“接收”的要件。
2
知情 (Knowledge)：
关键点：在学生接受药品之前，朋友已经承认药品是偷来的。因此，学生在接收的那一刻具备了“明知是赃物”的心理状态 (Mens Rea)。
3
剥夺意图 (Intent)：
学生接受药品并开始制造冰毒，说明她打算消耗掉这些药品，这构成了“永久剥夺物主财产”的意图。

综上所述，学生完全符合 Receiving Stolen Property 的所有构成要件。

为什么其他选项是错误的？
A. Accessory after the fact (事后从犯)
事后从犯要求被告在重罪发生后，主动协助罪犯逃避逮捕、审判或定罪（例如藏匿罪犯、销毁证据）。本案中，学生只是接受了赃物供自己使用，并没有为了帮助朋友逃避法律制裁而采取行动。
B. Accomplice to larceny (盗窃罪共犯)
共犯 (Accomplice) 要求在犯罪发生前或发生时，具有协助犯罪的意图 (Intent to aid)。虽然学生开车接送了朋友（客观上协助了），但她在当时不知道朋友在偷窃，因此缺乏必要的犯意 (Mens Rea)。
C. Conspiracy (共谋罪)
共谋罪的核心是协议 (Agreement)。学生和朋友从未达成“去药店偷窃”的协议。朋友是临时起意偷窃，学生并不知情。
💡 MBE 解题技巧 在处理共犯 (Accomplice) 和 收受赃物 (Receiving Stolen Property) 的题目时，务必紧扣时间线和犯意 (Mens Rea)：
  • 如果在犯罪进行时不知情，通常不能成为共犯。
  • 如果在接收物品时知情，则构成收受赃物罪。
  • 单纯的接收赃物通常不构成事后从犯，除非目的是为了藏匿罪行。

questions.question:
A man entered the county museum at a time when it was open to the public, intending to steal an etching by a famous painter. Once inside, he took what he thought was the etching from an unlocked display case and concealed it under his coat. However, the etching was a photocopy of an original that had been loaned to another museum. A sign over the display case containing the photocopy said that similar photocopies were available free at the entrance. The man did not see the sign.
Burglary in the jurisdiction is defined as "entering a building unlawfully with the intent to commit a crime."
Of which crime(s) is the man guilty?

choices.a: Burglary and larceny.
choices.b: Burglary and attempted larceny.
choices.c: Larceny.
choices.d: Attempted larceny.

data.questionStem:
Q84099

A man entered the county museum at a time when it was open to the public, intending to steal an etching by a famous painter. Once inside, he took what he thought was the etching from an unlocked display case and concealed it under his coat. However, the etching was a photocopy of an original that had been loaned to another museum. A sign over the display case containing the photocopy said that similar photocopies were available free at the entrance. The man did not see the sign.

Burglary in the jurisdiction is defined as "entering a building unlawfully with the intent to commit a crime."

Of which crime(s) is the man guilty?

一名男子在县博物馆对公众开放时进入，意图偷窃一幅著名画家的蚀刻画。进入馆内后，他从一个未上锁的陈列柜中取走了他认为是蚀刻画的物品，并将其藏在外套下。然而，该“蚀刻画”是一份影印本，其原作已被借给另一家博物馆。存放该影印本的陈列柜上方有一个标志，说明入口处可免费索取类似的影印本。该男子没有看到这个标志。

在该司法管辖区，入室犯法罪（Burglary）被定义为“以实施犯罪为目的非法进入建筑物”。

该男子犯了何种罪行？
options:
A. Burglary and larceny.
入室犯法罪（Burglary）与盗窃罪（larceny）。

B. Burglary and attempted larceny.
入室犯法罪（Burglary）与盗窃未遂（attempted larceny）。

C. Larceny.
盗窃罪（Larceny）。

D. Attempted larceny.
盗窃未遂（Attempted larceny）。
data.explanation:
In this jurisdiction (and most others), burglary requires proof that a person unlawfully entered a building with the intent to commit a crime therein. Here, the man entered the museum with the intent to steal an etching. But since persons may lawfully enter a building held open to the public, his entry was lawful. Therefore, he is not guilty of burglary (Choices A & B).

However, the man is guilty of larceny - ie, the unlawful (eg, nonconsensual) taking and carrying away of another's personal property with the specific intent to permanently deprive the owner thereof. The man took a photocopy of the etching from the display case even though other copies were available for free at the museum's entrance (unlawful taking). He then completed the crime when he concealed the photocopy under his coat (carrying away) with the intent to steal it (permanent deprivation).

(Choices B & D) Attempt occurs when a person (1) has the specific intent to commit a crime, (2) engages in an overt act in furtherance of that crime, but (3) does not complete it. Since the man completed the larceny, he is not guilty of attempt.

Educational objective: Burglary requires proof that a person unlawfully entered a building, so a person cannot burglarize a building while it is open to the public. And larceny requires proof that a person took another's personal property unlawfully - eg, without the owner's consent.



选项正确率统计：A选项 9%，B选项 8%，C选项 56%（正确选项），D选项 24%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

在该司法管辖区（以及大多数其他地区），入室犯法罪（burglary）要求证明一个人非法进入一座建筑物，并意图在其中犯罪。在本案中，该男子进入博物馆的意图是偷窃一幅蚀刻画。但是，由于个人可以合法进入向公众开放的建筑物，他的进入是合法的。因此，他不构成入室犯法罪 (选项 A & B)。

然而，该男子犯有盗窃罪（larceny）——即，以永久剥夺他人财产所有权为特定意图，非法（例如，未经同意）占有并带走他人的个人财产。尽管博物馆入口处有免费的影印本，该男子还是从陈列柜中取走了一份蚀刻画的影印本（非法占有）。随后，他将影印本藏在外套下（带走），意图将其窃取（永久剥夺），从而完成了该罪行。

(选项 B & D) 未遂罪（Attempt）发生在一个人 (1) 具有实施犯罪的特定意图，(2) 为促进该犯罪而实施了公开行为，但 (3) 未能完成犯罪的情况下。由于该男子完成了盗窃罪，他不构成未遂罪。

教学目标：入室犯法罪（Burglary）要求证明一个人非法进入建筑物，因此，一个人不能在建筑物对公众开放时对其进行入室犯罪。而盗窃罪（larceny）要求证明一个人非法——例如，未经所有者同意——占有了他人的个人财产。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 刑法考点解析

Burglary & Larceny Analysis
✅ 正确答案：C (Larceny)

该男子构成盗窃罪（Larceny），但不构成入室犯法罪（Burglary）。

🏛️ 考点 1：入室犯法罪 (Burglary)

题目中给出了具体的法条定义：
"Entering a building unlawfully..."

分析逻辑：

  • 向公众开放 (Open to the public)： 博物馆在营业时间向公众开放，这意味着公众拥有进入的“默示许可” (Implied Consent)。
  • 进入的合法性： 尽管该男子心怀鬼胎（意图盗窃），但他进入建筑物的行为本身是经过许可的。因此，他不符合“非法进入” (Unlawful Entry) 这一要素。
  • 结论： 既然进入是合法的，就不可能构成 Burglary。排除选项 A 和 B。
🖼️ 考点 2：盗窃罪 (Larceny)

盗窃罪的定义通常为：非法占有并带走他人财产，意图永久剥夺。

关键争议点解析：

  • 非法占有 (Trespassory Taking)： 虽然门口有免费的影印本，但该男子是从陈列柜中取走的。博物馆同意你在门口拿，但并未同意你打开陈列柜拿。因此，这种拿取行为侵犯了博物馆的占有权 (Possession)。
  • 财产属性： 即使这只是一张影印纸，它也是博物馆的实体财产。
  • 意图 (Intent)： 男子将其藏在外套下，证明他有永久剥夺的意图。虽然他误以为那是真迹（事实认识错误，Mistake of Fact），但这并不影响他“偷窃手里这件物品”的意图。
🚫 为什么不是未遂 (Attempt)?

选项 D 是错误的干扰项。

合并原则 (Merger)： 未遂罪 (Attempt) 只有在犯罪未完成时才适用。一旦犯罪的所有要素都已满足（他已经拿到了物品并藏起来，完成了“带走” Asportation），未遂罪就合并入既遂罪中。

既然他已经成功实施了盗窃（哪怕偷的只是张纸），他就是犯了 Larceny，而不是 Attempted Larceny。

MBE 解题技巧 (Pro-Tip)
仔细阅读题目给出的法规定义（Statute）。
如果题目定义了 Burglary 需要 "Unlawful Entry"，
那么进入任何向公众开放的场所通常都不构成 Burglary，
无论被告人的内心意图多么邪恶。

questions.question:
A 22-year-old man went to a nightclub with a group of friends. The nightclub is known for its strict 18-and-up policy. While there, the man ran into a former coworker who introduced the man to her sister. Over the course of the night, the man and the sister danced and engaged in conversation. Unbeknownst to him, the sister was only 16 and had gotten into the club using a fake ID. Later that evening, the man had consensual sexual intercourse with the coworker's sister.
The age of consent in the jurisdiction is 17.
Is the man guilty of statutory rape?

choices.a: No, because the man did not knowingly engage in sexual intercourse with a minor.
choices.b: No, because the man's mistake of fact, under the totality of circumstances, was reasonable.

Is the man guilty of statutory rape?

一名22岁的男子和一群朋友去了一家夜店。这家夜店以其严格的18岁及以上准入政策而闻名。在那里，该男子遇到了一位前同事，前同事将她的妹妹介绍给了该男子。在当晚，该男子和这位妹妹一起跳舞、交谈。这位妹妹告诉该男子她19岁，就读于本地大学。临近营业结束时，妹妹邀请该男子去她的公寓。他不知道的是，这位妹妹只有16岁，是使用假身份证进入夜店的。当天晚上晚些时候，该男子与前同事的妹妹发生了双方自愿的性交行为。

在该司法管辖区，法定同意年龄是17岁。

该男子是否构成法定强奸罪 (statutory rape)？
options:
A. No, because the man did not knowingly engage in sexual intercourse with a minor.
不构成，因为该男子并未在知情的情况下与未成年人发生性交行为。

B. No, because the man's mistake of fact, under the totality of circumstances, was reasonable.
不构成，因为根据整体情况来看，该男子对事实的错误认知是合理的。

C. Yes, because the man was negligent in failing to confirm the sister's age.
构成，因为该男子在未能确认妹妹年龄方面存在过失。

D. Yes, because the man's commission of the requisite actus reus is sufficient for a finding of guilt.
构成，因为该男子实施了必要的犯罪行为 (actus reus)，足以认定其有罪。
data.explanation:
Statutory rape arises when a defendant has sexual intercourse with a person under the age of consent. This is a strict liability crime, which means that it has no mens rea requirement. Instead, proof of the actus reus (here, intercourse with an underage person) is alone sufficient to support a conviction. As a result, the fact that the man did not knowingly engage in sexual intercourse with a minor does not absolve him of guilt (Choice A).

Additionally, mistake of fact is never a defense to a strict liability crime because this defense is predicated on the notion that the defendant's mistake negates the mens rea necessary to convict. So even though the coworker's sister misrepresented her age to the man, he cannot escape liability for statutory rape by establishing that he was reasonably mistaken about the victim's age (Choice B). Therefore, the man is guilty of statutory rape.

(Choice C) The man did not confirm the sister's age. But whether his failure to do so was negligent - or even reasonable - is irrelevant to this strict liability crime. All that matters is whether he committed the actus reus.

Educational objective: Mistake of fact is never a defense to a strict liability crime - including statutory rape. Therefore, a defendant's reasonable mistake as to the victim's age will not serve as a defense to statutory rape.



选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 6%，C选项 1%，D选项 86%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当被告与未达到法定同意年龄的人发生性交时，便构成Statutory rape（法定强奸罪）。这是一种strict liability crime（严格责任犯罪），意味着它没有 mens rea（犯罪意图）的要求。相反，仅凭actus reus（犯罪行为）的证据（在此案中，即与未成年人发生性交）就足以支持定罪。因此，该男子并非在知情的情况下与未成年人发生性交这一事实，并不能免除其罪责（选项A）。

此外，mistake of fact（事实错误）绝不能作为strict liability crime（严格责任犯罪）的抗辩理由，因为该抗辩理由的前提是，被告的错误否定了定罪所必需的 mens rea（犯罪意图）。因此，即使前同事的妹妹向该男子谎报了年龄，他也无法通过证明自己对受害人年龄存在合理错误来免除法定强奸罪的责任（选项B）。因此，该男子构成法定强奸罪。

（选项C）该男子没有确认妹妹的年龄。但其未能确认年龄的行为是否属于过失——甚至是否合理——都与此严格责任犯罪无关。唯一重要的是他是否实施了 actus reus（犯罪行为）。

教学目的：Mistake of fact（事实错误）绝不能作为 strict liability crime（严格责任犯罪）——包括 statutory rape（法定强奸罪）——的抗辩理由。因此，被告对于受害人年龄的合理错误认知，不能作为 statutory rape（法定强奸罪）的抗辩理由。

Criminal Law / 刑法

法定强奸罪与严格责任
Statutory Rape & Strict Liability

核心法律原则

法定强奸罪 (Statutory Rape) 属于 严格责任犯罪 (Strict Liability Crime)。

这意味着定罪不需要证明被告有犯罪意图 (Mens Rea)。只要被告实施了犯罪行为 (Actus Reus)，即与未达到法定年龄的人发生性行为，无论其是否知情或是否存在合理错误，均构成犯罪。

为什么选 D (Correct Answer)？
正确逻辑

本题的关键在于理解严格责任的本质。在严格责任犯罪中，检方只需证明：

  1. 被告实施了被禁止的行为 (Actus Reus)；
  2. 受害人未达到法定同意年龄。

题目中，该男子确实与16岁的女孩发生了性关系（该地法定年龄为17岁）。因为不需要证明男子的心理状态（意图或过失），所以只要行为发生，罪名即成立。

为什么 B 是错误的 (Common Trap)？
常见陷阱：事实错误抗辩

选项 B 提到了 事实错误 (Mistake of Fact)。在普通意图犯罪 (General Intent Crimes) 或特定意图犯罪 (Specific Intent Crimes) 中，合理的事实错误确实可以作为抗辩理由。

但是，对于严格责任犯罪 (Strict Liability)，事实错误绝不是抗辩理由。即使女孩使用了假身份证、谎报年龄、且看起来像成年人（使得男子的错误认知看起来非常“合理”），在法律上这都无关紧要。

🎓 MBE 备考锦囊：

在处理 MBE 刑法题目时，一旦识别出罪名是 Statutory Rape 或 Bigamy (重婚罪)：

  • 立即联想到 Strict Liability (严格责任)。
  • 直接排除所有基于 "Reasonable Mistake" (合理错误) 或 "Lack of Intent" (缺乏意图) 的抗辩选项。
  • 除非题目明确引用了《模范刑法典》(MPC) 的规则（MPC允许合理错误作为抗辩），否则默认适用普通法规则：年龄错误不免责。

A man revered a famous guitarist who had recently died. The man convinced his girlfriend, who worked at the cemetery where the guitarist was buried, to help him acquire a 12-foot sculpture of a steel guitar that had been commissioned by the guitarist's surviving spouse and installed on the guitarist's gravesite. One day, when the girlfriend knew that no other cemetery employees would be present, she gave the man the keys to a truck with a hydraulic lift that the cemetery used to install headstones. She and the man then drove to the guitarist's gravesite. The girlfriend maintained a lookout while the man severed the sculpture from its base and raised it onto the truck bed using the hydraulic lift. The man then drove the sculpture to a storage unit he had rented, placed it in the unit, and returned the truck to the cemetery. On the way home from the storage facility, the man was killed in a car accident.
The police later ascertained the identities of the man and the girlfriend and recovered the sculpture unharmed.
If the girlfriend is charged with larceny in a jurisdiction that follows the common law, which of the following is her best defense?

choices.a: The man, who is deceased, cannot be convicted of larceny.
choices.b: The sculpture constituted real property.
choices.c: The sculpture was unharmed.
choices.d: The taking occurred during the day.

一名男子十分崇敬一位最近去世的著名吉他手。该男子说服了在吉他手安葬的墓地工作的女友，帮助他获取一座12英尺高的钢制吉他雕塑。该雕塑由吉他手在世的配偶委托制作并安装在吉他手的墓地上。一天，女友知道没有其他墓地员工在场，便将墓地用来安装墓碑的、带液压升降机的卡车钥匙交给了该男子。随后，她和该男子开车前往吉他手的墓地。女友负责望风，而该男子则将雕塑从其基座上切断，并用液压升-降机将其吊上卡车车厢。该男子随后将雕塑运至他租来的一个储物单元，将其放入单元内，并将卡车归还至墓地。在从仓储设施回家的路上，该男子在一场车祸中丧生。

警方后来查明了该男子和女友的身份，并找回了完好无损的雕塑。

如果女友在一个遵循普通法（common law）的司法管辖区被控盗窃罪（larceny），以下哪项是她最好的辩护理由？
options:
A. The man, who is deceased, cannot be convicted of larceny.
该男子已故，不能被判定犯有盗窃罪（larceny）。

B. The sculpture constituted real property.
该雕塑构成不动产。

C. The sculpture was unharmed.
该雕塑完好无损。

D. The taking occurred during the day.
拿取行为发生在白天。
data.explanation:
At common law, a person who (1) aided or encouraged a principal in the commission of a crime and (2) was present at the crime is classified as a principal in the second degree. This designation is significant because a principal in the second degree is liable for the offense to the same extent as the principal - even if the principal is not convicted.

Here, the girlfriend aided the man in the unlawful removal of the sculpture from the guitarist's grave by serving as a lookout during the removal. As a result, the girlfriend is a principal in the second degree and can be tried and potentially convicted even though the man, who died before police could apprehend him, was not previously convicted (Choice A). For the girlfriend to be convicted of common law larceny, the prosecution must prove that the man:
  • unlawfully took and carried away another's personal property and
  • did so with the intent to permanently deprive the owner of that property.

However, a person who unlawfully severs and then immediately carries away an item of real property - eg, a planted tree or fixture - is not guilty of common law larceny. That is because such an item does not constitute personal property in its attached state.† Therefore, the girlfriend's best defense is that the sculpture affixed to the grave constituted real property and, as such, was not subject to common law larceny.

†In contrast, an item of real property that (1) was previously severed by the owner or (2) was severed by the defendant and later came into the owner's possession is personal property and subject to larceny.

(Choice C) It is not a defense to larceny that the stolen property was recovered unharmed.

(Choice D) Unlike common law burglary, larceny need not be committed at night.

Educational objective: A defendant who unlawfully severs and then immediately carries away an item of real property is not guilty of larceny because such an item does not constitute personal property.

选项正确率统计：A选项 30%，B选项 63%（正确选项），C选项 2%，D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

在普通法下，一个人如果 (1) 在犯罪实施过程中协助或教唆主犯，并且 (2) 在犯罪现场，则被归类为二级主犯。这个分类很重要，因为二级主犯与主犯对罪行承担同等责任——即使主犯未被定罪。

在本案中，女友在非法移走吉他手墓地雕塑的过程中负责望风，从而协助了该男子。因此，女友是二级主犯，即使在该男子（在警方逮捕他之前已经死亡）未被定罪的情况下，她也可能被审判并可能被定罪 (选项A)。要判定女友犯有普通法盗窃罪 (common law larceny)，检方必须证明该男子：
  • 非法拿走并搬离他人的动产并且
  • 具有意图永久剥夺物主对该财产的占有。

然而，非法切断并立即搬离不动产项目的人——例如，种植的树木或固定物——不构成普通法盗窃罪 (common law larceny)。这是因为该物品在其附着状态下不构成动产。† 因此，女友最好的辩护理由是，固定在墓地上的雕塑构成不动产，因此，不受普通法盗窃罪 (common law larceny) 的约束。

†相比之下，一个不动产项目如果 (1) 先前已被物主切断，或 (2) 被被告人切断后又回到物主占有之下，则属于动产，并可构成盗窃罪 (larceny) 的对象。

(选项C) 被盗财产完好无损地被追回，这不能作为盗窃罪 (larceny) 的辩护理由。

(选项D) 与普通法入室犯法罪 (common law burglary) 不同，盗窃罪 (larceny) 无需在夜间实施。

教学目标：非法切断并立即搬离不动产项目的被告人不构成盗窃罪 (larceny)，因为该物品不构成动产。

MBE 考点解析

Criminal Law | Larceny & Real Property

最佳辩护理由 (Best Defense)
选项 B：该雕塑构成不动产。
(The sculpture constituted real property.)
⚖️ 法律依据与推理

本题的核心考点是普通法下的盗窃罪 (Common Law Larceny) 的对象限制。

1. 盗窃罪的定义：
普通法将盗窃罪定义为：非法拿取并搬离（Trespassory taking and carrying away）他人的动产 (Personal Property)，并意图永久剥夺其占有权。

2. 不动产例外原则 (Real Property Exception)：
在普通法下，不动产 (Real Property)（如土地、建筑物、农作物或固定在土地上的附着物）不能成为盗窃罪的对象。

3. 分离规则 (Severance Rule)：
这是本题的关键。如果一个人将附着物（如雕塑）从土地上分离（Sever），并在一个连续的行为中 (in one continuous act) 将其带走，这在普通法下不构成盗窃罪。因为在被带走的那一刻，该物品从未成为物主占有的“动产”。

🔍 案情分析

在本案中：

  • 物品性质：雕塑被“安装”在墓地上，属于附着物 (Fixture)，即不动产的一部分。
  • 行为过程：男子将雕塑从基座上切断（Severed），并立即用升降机将其装车运走。
  • 结论：由于切断和搬离是一个连续的过程，该雕塑在法律上从未转化为“动产”供其盗窃。因此，根据严格的普通法规则，盗窃罪 (Larceny) 不成立。
❌ 为什么其他选项无效？
选项 A (主犯已死)
错误。女友作为二级主犯 (Principal in the Second Degree)——即在现场协助犯罪的人——其责任是独立的。只要犯罪行为发生了，即使主犯（Principal in the First Degree）死亡、逃跑或未被定罪，共犯仍可被起诉。
选项 C (物品完好)
错误。盗窃罪是针对占有权 (Possession) 的犯罪。只要物品被非法拿走（哪怕只有一瞬间），犯罪即已完成。事后归还或物品未受损不是有效的辩护理由。
选项 D (发生在白天)
错误。这是将盗窃罪与入室犯法罪 (Burglary) 混淆。普通法下的入室犯法罪必须发生在夜间 (Nighttime)，但盗窃罪可以在任何时间发生。
💡 MBE 备考策略

注意“普通法” (Common Law) 的限定词：

现代刑法典 (Modern Penal Codes) 通常已经废除了不动产不能被盗窃的规则。但是，当 MBE 题目明确指出"in a jurisdiction that follows the common law"时，你必须应用古老的普通法规则。

记住这个“连续性”考点：
如果题目说男子切断了雕塑，第二天回来把它拿走，那么这就构成了盗窃罪（因为切断后它变成了动产，第二天拿走就是拿走动产）。但在本题中，切断和拿走是同时发生的。

questions.question:
An elderly woman was visiting a friend in a sizeable nursing home. After the woman's visit, she attempted to leave the facility. However, a nurse mistakenly believed that the woman was one of the residents and told her to remain on the premises. The woman protested and tried to explain that she was actually a visitor, but the nurse did not believe her. Instead, the nurse guided the woman toward an empty room and told her to wait there until he could verify her identity. The woman refused to enter the room, so the nurse pulled out a syringe and said, "Do I need to give you a sedative or are you going to listen to me?" The woman reluctantly entered the room, and the nurse told the woman to stay in there until he got back. He then closed the door behind him but did not lock it. Thirty minutes later, the nurse returned, apologized for the misunderstanding, and told the woman that she could leave. The woman subsequently filed a criminal complaint against the nurse, and he was charged with false imprisonment.
Is the nurse guilty of false imprisonment?

choices.a: No, because the nurse mistakenly believed that the woman was a patient.
choices.b: No, because the woman was free to leave the unlocked room.
choices.c: Yes, because the nurse intended to lawfully confine a patient, not a visitor.
choices.d: Yes, because the woman's consent was not freely given.

一位年长妇女正在一家规模相当大的疗养院探望朋友。探望结束后，该妇女试图离开该设施。然而，一名护士误以为该妇女是院内的一名居民，并告知她必须留在院内。该妇女提出抗议，并试图解释她实际上是一名访客，但护士不相信她。于是，护士将该妇女引导至一个空房间，并告诉她在那里等待，直到他能核实她的身份。该妇女拒绝进入房间，于是护士拿出一个注射器说：“我是需要给你注射一针镇静剂，还是你准备听我的话？”该妇女不情愿地进入了房间，护士告诉她待在里面等他回来。随后，他关上了身后的门，但没有上锁。三十分钟后，护士回来了，为误会道歉，并告诉该妇女可以离开了。该妇女随后对护士提起了刑事诉讼，护士被指控犯有非法拘禁罪（false imprisonment）。

该护士是否犯有非法拘禁罪（false imprisonment）？
options:
A. No, because the nurse mistakenly believed that the woman was a patient.
不构成，因为护士误以为该妇女是一名病人。

B. No, because the woman was free to leave the unlocked room.
不构成，因为该妇女可以自由离开未上锁的房间。

C. Yes, because the nurse intended to lawfully confine a patient, not a visitor.
构成，因为护士的意图是合法地约束一名病人，而非一名访客。

D. Yes, because the woman's consent was not freely given.
构成，因为该妇女的同意并非自由作出。
data.explanation:
False imprisonment


Unlawfulnot consented to or specifically authorized by law
Confinementforcing person to go or remain where he/she does not wish when no alternative routes are available
Without consentnot freely agreed to by someone with capacity to do so
False imprisonment is the unlawful confinement of a person without consent. A confinement occurs when a person is compelled through actual force, threat of force, or a show of force to either go where the person does not want to go or remain where the person does not want to remain.

The confinement is unlawful unless it is specifically authorized by law or consented to by the victim. However, consent is only effective if it was freely given (ie, without force or fraud) and the victim had the capacity to consent.

Here, the elderly woman was confined when the nurse threatened to give the woman a sedative unless she entered the room. Although the woman subsequently agreed to enter, her actions did not constitute consent because her compliance was not freely given - it was made in response to the nurse's threat of force. Therefore, the confinement was unlawful.

However, mistake of fact is a defense to false imprisonment and other general intent crimes - which require only the intent to perform an act that is unlawful - if the mistake was honest and reasonable and negates the requisite mens rea. The mens rea required for false imprisonment is the intent to unlawfully confine another.

Here, the nurse may have honestly and reasonably believed that the elderly woman was a resident. But mistake of fact is not a defense because the nurse could not have threatened and confined a nursing home resident in that manner. Such confinement would have also been unlawful. Therefore, the mistake does not negate the requisite mens rea and the nurse is guilty of false imprisonment (Choices A & C).

(Choice B) Although the door was left unlocked, the woman was still confined because she remained in the room due to the nurse's threat of force.

Educational objective: False imprisonment is the unlawful confinement of a person without consent. Consent is effective only if the victim gave it freely and had the capacity to consent. Mistake of fact is a defense to this general intent crime only if the mistake was honest and reasonable.

选项正确率统计：A选项 29%，B选项 25%，C选项 6%，D选项 37%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

False Imprisonment (非法拘禁罪)


Unlawful (非法的)未经同意或法律特别授权
Confinement (拘禁)当无其他替代路线时，强迫他人去其不愿去之处或留于其不愿留之所
Without consent (未经同意)未经有行为能力者自由同意
False imprisonment 是指未经同意对他人进行的非法拘禁。当一个人因实际武力、武力威胁或武力展示，而被强迫去其不愿去之处或留于其不愿留之所时，即构成拘禁 (confinement)。

此种拘禁是非法的 (unlawful)，除非有法律特别授权或得到受害人的同意。然而，只有在同意是自由作出的（即没有胁迫或欺诈）且受害人有同意能力的情况下，该同意才有效。

在本案中，当护士威胁说除非该妇女进入房间否则就给她注射镇静剂时，这位年长妇女便受到了拘禁。尽管该妇女随后同意进入，但她的行为不构成同意，因为她的服从并非自由作出——而是对护士武力威胁的回应。因此，该拘禁是非法的。

然而，事实错误 (mistake of fact) 是对 false imprisonment 及其他一般意图犯罪 (general intent crimes) 的一种抗辩理由——这类犯罪仅要求有实施非法行为的意图——前提是该错误是善意且合理的 (honest and reasonable)，并且否定了必要的犯罪意图 (mens rea)。false imprisonment 所要求的 mens rea 是非法拘禁他人的意图。

在本案中，护士可能善意且合理地相信了该年长妇女是一名院内居民。但事实错误 (mistake of fact) 并不能作为抗辩理由，因为护士不能以那种方式威胁和拘禁疗养院的居民。那样的拘禁同样也是非法的。因此，该错误并未否定必要的 mens rea，该护士犯有 false imprisonment 罪（选项 A 和 C）。

（选项 B）尽管门没有上锁，但该妇女仍然受到了拘禁，因为她是由于护士的武力威胁才待在房间里的。

教学目标：False imprisonment 是指未经同意对他人进行的非法拘禁。只有在受害人自由作出且有同意能力的情况下，同意才有效。事实错误 (Mistake of fact) 仅在该错误是善意且合理的情况下，才能作为对这种 general intent crime 的抗辩理由。

MBE 刑法考点解析

False Imprisonment (非法拘禁)

正确答案：D

构成非法拘禁，因为该妇女的同意并非自由作出 (Consent was not freely given)。

核心法律规则

非法拘禁罪 (False Imprisonment) 的构成要件通常包括：

  1. 非法拘禁 (Unlawful Confinement)：将他人限制在特定边界内。
  2. 未经同意 (Without Consent)：受害人未同意或同意无效。

关键点在于：如果同意是基于武力威胁 (Threat of Force) 作出的，则该同意无效。

本题解析逻辑

1. 拘禁的构成 (Confinement)
虽然护士没有锁门，但他拿出了注射器并威胁使用镇静剂。在法律上，武力威胁 (Threat of force) 足以构成拘禁。如果受害人因为害怕受到身体伤害而不敢离开，即使物理出口是开放的，也视为被“拘禁”。

2. 同意的无效性 (Invalid Consent)
题目中妇女虽然“不情愿地进入了房间”，但这并非有效的同意。因为这是在护士挥舞注射器并威胁注射镇静剂（即构成 Battery 的威胁）下做出的。受胁迫的同意 (Coerced consent) 在法律上无效。

因此，护士的行为满足了非法拘禁的所有要素。

为什么其他选项是错误的？

选项 A (事实错误抗辩)：
虽然护士误以为她是病人，但这属于事实错误 (Mistake of Fact)。非法拘禁是一般意图犯罪 (General Intent Crime)。事实错误只有在“如果事实如被告所信那样，其行为将是合法的”情况下才能作为抗辩。

关键点：即使该妇女真的是病人，护士通常也无权仅仅为了核实身份就威胁使用镇静剂将其关禁闭。既然即使事实如他所想，该行为（威胁注射）依然可能非法，那么这个错误就不能作为抗辩理由。

选项 B (未上锁的门)：
如果存在武力威胁，受害人就没有义务尝试逃跑。注射器的威胁剥夺了她离开的自由，即使门没锁。

选项 C (意图)：
非法拘禁只需要有“拘禁他人”的意图，不需要有“非法”的主观恶意。护士有意图将她关在房间里，这就满足了 Mens Rea（犯罪意图）。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

在处理 False Imprisonment 题目时，注意寻找“隐形”的拘禁方式。不一定要有铁栏杆或上锁的门，“如果我不听话就会受伤”的合理恐惧 (Reasonable fear of harm) 同样构成有效的拘禁边界。

A new gang member, hoping to impress the gang's leader, pointed a gun at a pedestrian and ordered her to give him her expensive watch, which she did. The gang member then tossed the watch to the gang leader, who was standing nearby. Although totally surprised by this act, the gang leader put the watch in his pocket. The pedestrian ran away.
What crime did the gang leader commit?

choices.a: Accessory after the fact to robbery.
choices.b: Accomplice to robbery.
choices.c: Conspiracy to commit robbery.
choices.d: Receiving stolen property.

data.questionStem:
Q84807 A new gang member, hoping to impress the gang's leader, pointed a gun at a pedestrian and ordered her to give him her expensive watch, which she did. The gang member then tossed the watch to the gang leader, who was standing nearby. Although totally surprised by this act, the gang leader put the watch in his pocket. The pedestrian ran away.

What crime did the gang leader commit? 一名新的黑帮成员，为了给黑帮头目留下深刻印象，用枪指着一名行人，并命令她交出其昂贵的手表，她照做了。该黑帮成员随后将手表扔给了站在附近的黑帮头目。尽管对这一行为感到十分惊讶，该黑帮头目还是将手表放进了自己的口袋。该行人跑走了。

该黑帮头目犯了什么罪？
options:
A. Accessory after the fact to robbery.
抢劫罪的事后从犯。

B. Accomplice to robbery.
抢劫罪的共犯。

C. Conspiracy to commit robbery.
共谋抢劫罪。

D. Receiving stolen property.
收受赃物罪。
data.explanation:
The crime of receiving stolen property is committed when a person: receives property that he/she knows was stolen with the intent to permanently deprive another of that property. Here, the gang leader knew that the watch was stolen since he witnessed the robbery—ie, the gang member's theft of the woman's watch through force or intimidation. The gang member then tossed the watch to the gang leader, who pocketed it—evidencing his intent to permanently deprive the woman of the watch. Therefore, the gang leader committed the crime of receiving stolen property.

(Choice A) An accessory after the fact is a person who aids or assists another (ie, the principal) by helping the principal avoid apprehension or conviction after the crime has been completed. Here, the gang leader did not play this role since his concealment of the watch did not help the gang member in such a manner.

(Choice B) An accomplice (1) knowingly aids or encourages the principal before or during a crime (2) with the intent that the crime be completed. Here, the gang leader was not an accomplice since the gang member acted of his own accord (ie, without aid or encouragement) to impress the gang leader.

(Choice C) Conspiracy is an agreement between two or more people to commit a crime that is entered with the intent to accomplish that crime. Since the gang leader was totally surprised by the gang member's act, they did not agree to commit the robbery.

Educational objective: The crime of receiving stolen property is committed when a person (1) receives property that he/she knows was stolen (2) with the intent to permanently deprive another of that property.



当一个人做出以下行为时，便构成收受赃物罪(receiving stolen property)： 接收其明知是赃物(knows was stolen)的财产 并意图永久剥夺(intent to permanently deprive)他人对该财产的所有权。 在本案中，该黑帮头目知道手表是偷来的，因为他目睹了抢劫过程——即，该黑帮成员通过暴力或恐吓手段盗取了该女子的手表。然后，该黑帮成员将手表扔给黑帮头目，后者将其放入口袋——这证明了他意图永久剥夺该女子对手表的占有。因此，该黑帮头目构成了收受赃物罪。

(选项 A) 事后从犯(accessory after the fact)是指在犯罪完成后，通过帮助主犯逃避逮捕或定罪来援助或协助主犯的人。在本案中，该黑帮头目没有扮演这个角色，因为他藏匿手表的行为并未以这种方式帮助该黑帮成员。

(选项 B) 共犯(accomplice)是指 (1) 在犯罪之前或犯罪期间，故意帮助或鼓励主犯，(2) 且意图使该犯罪完成的人。在本案中，该黑帮头目不是共犯，因为该黑帮成员是自行行动（即没有得到帮助或鼓励），目的是为了给黑帮头目留下印象。

(选项 C) 共谋(conspiracy)是指两人或两人以上达成的、意图完成该犯罪的犯罪协议。由于该黑帮头目对该成员的行为感到十分惊讶，他们之间并未达成抢劫的协议。

教学目的： 当一个人 (1) 接收其明知是赃物的财产，并且 (2) 意图永久剥夺他人对该财产的所有权时，便构成收受赃物罪。

MBE 刑法考点解析

Criminal Law Analysis
正确答案：D 收受赃物罪 (Receiving Stolen Property)
黑帮头目在明知手表是抢劫所得的情况下，接收并保留了该手表。
🔫 成员抢劫
→
⌚ 扔给头目
→
😲 头目惊讶
但收下

⚖️ 核心考点：收受赃物罪的构成要件

在普通法(Common Law)及大多数司法管辖区，Receiving Stolen Property 需要满足以下四个要素：

  • 接收财产 (Receiving possession and control)：
    头目接住了手表并放入自己口袋，建立了对财物的控制。
  • 被盗财产 (Of "stolen" personal property)：
    手表刚刚通过抢劫(Robbery)被非法获取，属于赃物。
  • 明知是赃物 (Known to have been obtained criminally)：
    头目就在旁边目睹了抢劫过程，他完全知情。
  • 意图永久剥夺 (Intent to permanently deprive)：
    将手表放入口袋的行为表明他打算据为己有，而非归还受害人。

🚫 易混淆项辨析

排除 B & C：关键在于“惊讶” (Surprise) 题目中明确指出头目对抢劫行为感到 "totally surprised"。
  • 共谋 (Conspiracy) 需要事先的协议 (Agreement)。惊讶证明没有协议。
  • 共犯 (Accomplice) 需要在犯罪前或犯罪中故意协助或鼓励。惊讶证明抢劫是成员的自发行为，头目未提供精神或实质支持。
排除 A：事后从犯 (Accessory After the Fact) 事后从犯的核心目的是帮助罪犯逃避抓捕或定罪 (e.g., hiding the felon, giving false alibi)。

虽然头目拿走了证据（手表），但他的主要意图是贪图财物 (Receiving)，而不是为了帮助小弟逃跑。仅仅接收赃物通常构成收受赃物罪，而非事后从犯。
💡 MBE 解题技巧：
注意题目中的心理状态 (Mens Rea) 描述词。本题中的 "Surprised" 是解题的关键“钥匙”。它直接切断了头目与抢劫行为本身的预谋联系（排除了 Conspiracy 和 Accomplice），迫使你将目光转向抢劫完成之后的行为——即收受赃物。

A man who had become very drunk left a bar and started to walk home. Another patron of the bar, who had observed the man's condition, followed him. The patron saw the man stumble and fall to the ground near an alley. The patron then began to pull out a gun but saw that the man had passed out in the gutter. The patron reached into the man's pocket, grabbed his wallet, and started to walk away. When the patron heard police officers approaching, he dropped the wallet and ran off.
The crimes below are listed in descending order of seriousness.
What is the most serious crime of which the patron properly could be convicted?

choices.a: Robbery.
choices.b: Larceny.
choices.c: Attempted robbery.
choices.d: Attempted larceny.

A man who had become very drunk left a bar and started to walk home. Another patron of the bar, who had observed the man's condition, followed him. The patron saw the man stumble and fall to the ground near an alley. The patron then began to pull out a gun but saw that the man had passed out in the gutter. The patron reached into the man's pocket, grabbed his wallet, and started to walk away. When the patron heard police officers approaching, he dropped the wallet and ran off.

The crimes below are listed in descending order of seriousness.

What is the most serious crime of which the patron properly could be convicted?

一名酩酊大醉的男子离开酒吧，开始步行回家。酒吧的另一名顾客观察到该男子的状况后，便尾随其后。该顾客看到该男子跌跌撞撞，在一条小巷附近摔倒在地。该顾客随后开始拔枪，但看到该男子已在排水沟中昏倒。该顾客伸手到该男子的口袋里，抓住他的钱包，然后开始走开。当该顾客听到警察走近时，他扔下钱包逃跑了。

以下罪行按严重程度降序排列。

该顾客可能被恰当定罪的最严重的罪行是什么？
options:
A. Robbery.
抢劫罪。

B. Larceny.
盗窃罪。

C. Attempted robbery.
抢劫未遂。

D. Attempted larceny.
盗窃未遂。
data.explanation:
A defendant can be convicted of larceny if he/she:
  • unlawfully took and carried away the victim's property (even a short distance) with the intent to permanently deprive the victim of that property (ie, intent to steal).
And the defendant can be convicted of the more serious crime of robbery if the property was taken from the victim's person or presence by force or intimidation. But if these (or any other) crimes are not completed , the defendant can be convicted of the less serious crime of attempt if he/she:
  • specifically intended to commit the crime and performed an overt act in furtherance of the crime.
Here, the elements of larceny were met when the patron intentionally took a wallet from the man's pocket and started to walk away. And though the patron later dropped the wallet when he heard the police approaching, this is no defense. Therefore, the patron can be convicted of larceny - not attempted larceny (Choice D).

The patron likely intended to commit robbery when he followed the man and pulled out a gun in furtherance of the crime. But since the man then passed out in the gutter, the patron was able to take the wallet without using force or intimidation. As a result, the patron could be convicted of attempted robbery - but not a completed robbery (Choice A). Nevertheless, larceny is the most serious crime of which the patron could be convicted (Choice C).

Educational objective: Larceny evolves into the more serious crime of robbery when the defendant takes property from the victim's person or presence by force or intimidation. But if an element of those (or any other) crimes is not completed, a defendant may be convicted of a less serious attempted crime.



选项正确率统计：A选项 6%，B选项 84%（正确选项），C选项 7%，D选项 2%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

如果被告人符合以下条件，则可被裁定犯有larceny：
  • 非法取得并带离（即使是短暂距离）受害人的财产，且意图永久剥夺受害人对该财产的所有权（即盗窃意图）。
并且，如果财产是通过暴力或恐吓从受害人的人身或其近旁夺取的，则被告人可被判定犯有更严重的robbery。但是，如果这些（或任何其他）罪行未完成，若被告人符合以下条件，则其可被判定犯有较轻的attempt罪：
  • 具有实施该罪行的特定意图并且为促进该罪行的实施作出了公开行为。
在本案中，当该顾客故意从该男子的口袋里拿出钱包并开始走开时，larceny的构成要件已经满足。尽管该顾客后来在听到警察走近时扔掉了钱包，但这不能作为抗辩理由。因此，该顾客可被裁定犯有larceny，而非attempted larceny（选项D）。

该顾客在尾随该男子并拔出枪以助其犯罪时，很可能意图实施robbery。但由于该男子随后在排水沟中昏倒，该顾客得以在未使用暴力或恐吓的情况下拿走钱包。因此，该顾客可被裁定犯有attempted robbery——但不是已完成的robbery（选项A）。尽管如此，larceny是该顾客可被定罪的最严重的罪行（选项C）。

教学目的：当被告人通过暴力或恐吓从受害人的人身或其近旁取得财产时，larceny就演变成了更严重的robbery。但是，如果这些（或任何其他）罪行的一项构成要件未完成，被告人可能会被裁定犯有较轻的未遂罪。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 刑法考点解析

Larceny vs. Robbery

核心考点 (Key Issue)

本题主要考察两个核心法律概念的区别与认定：

  • 盗窃罪 (Larceny) 的既遂标准。
  • 抢劫罪 (Robbery) 中“暴力或恐吓” (Force or Intimidation) 的要件。
法律规则解析 (Legal Analysis)
1. 盗窃罪 (Larceny) 的认定

普通法下的 Larceny 定义为：以永久剥夺他人财产为目的，非法拿取并带走 (Trespassory taking and carrying away) 他人的个人财产。

本案应用：

  • 拿取 (Taking)： 顾客从醉汉口袋里拿出了钱包。
  • 带走 (Carrying Away / Asportation)： 顾客拿着钱包“开始走开”。在普通法中，哪怕只是极其轻微的移动 (slightest movement)，只要发生了位移，该要件即满足。
  • 意图 (Intent)： 顾客拿走钱包时显然有据为己有的意图。
  • 既遂 (Completed Crime)： 尽管顾客后来扔掉了钱包，但这属于犯罪既遂后的放弃，不能作为抗辩理由。Larceny 在他迈步走开的那一刻已经完成。
2. 抢劫罪 (Robbery) 的排除

Robbery 是指通过暴力 (Force) 或 恐吓 (Intimidation) 从受害人身上或其在场范围内非法夺取财产。

本案应用：

  • 无恐吓： 顾客虽然拔出了枪，但此时受害人已经昏倒 (passed out)。受害人没有看到枪，因此没有产生恐惧 (fear)。
  • 无暴力： 顾客是从一个无意识的人身上拿走钱包。除非在拿取过程中使用了超出单纯拿取动作所需的物理力量（如推搡、击打），否则单纯的“扒窃” (pickpocketing) 或从醉汉/睡着的人身上拿东西，通常被认定为 Larceny 而非 Robbery。
为什么选 B (Larceny)？

题目要求选择被告可能被定罪的最严重罪行。

  • 选项 A (Robbery)： 错误。因为缺乏 Robbery 的核心要素——暴力或恐吓。
  • 选项 D (Attempted Larceny)： 错误。因为 Larceny 已经既遂（拿取并移动了）。既遂罪行吸收了未遂罪行。
  • 选项 C (Attempted Robbery) vs. 选项 B (Larceny)：
    虽然被告可能有抢劫的意图（拔枪），可以争辩构成抢劫未遂 (Attempted Robbery)，但在 MBE 考试逻辑中，一个已完成的针对财产的实质性犯罪（Larceny，且是从人身上窃取），通常被视为比一个因客观条件（受害人昏倒）而未能实施暴力的“未遂”指控更确凿、更具实质性的定罪基础。

    更重要的是，Larceny 的所有构成要件都完美符合事实，是无可争议的既遂重罪。
正确答案：B (Larceny)
考试技巧 (Exam Tip)：
注意“带走” (Asportation) 的门槛极低。只要东西被拿起来并发生了位置移动，Larceny 就完成了。后续的归还、丢弃或被抓，都不改变既遂的事实。同时，Robbery 必须要有受害人的“感知”（恐吓）或身体上的“强制”（暴力）。

In a common-law jurisdiction, which of the following crime(s) can the assistant be found guilty of?

一家公司的CEO将她的大部分工作时间用于浏览集邮网站，并经常订购昂贵的邮票寄到她的工作地址。一天，一枚非常稀有且昂贵的邮票通过邮件送达。这位CEO的助理因对CEO付给他的微薄薪水心怀不满，决定偷走这枚邮票。他查看了CEO的日历，发现她第二天晚上要去听歌剧。第二天晚上，在CEO去听歌剧后，助理取回了藏在石头下的备用钥匙，从前门进入了CEO的家，前门直通客厅，那里显眼地陈列着邮票收藏品。正当助理在邮票收藏品中寻找那枚稀有邮票时，前门突然打开，CEO走了进来。看到助理后，CEO从她的钱包里掏出一把枪，告诉助理待在原地，然后报了警。

在普通法司法管辖区，该助理可能被裁定犯有以下哪项（或哪些）罪行？
options:
A. No crime.
无罪。

B. Burglary only.
仅构成入室犯法罪。

C. Attempted larceny only.
仅构成盗窃未遂罪。

D. Burglary and attempted larceny.
构成入室犯法罪和盗窃未遂罪。
data.explanation:
Common law burglary requires proof that the defendant: unlawfully broke and entered another's dwelling at night and did so with the specific intent to commit a felony (eg, larceny) therein.

An unlawful breaking occurs if the defendant used any amount of force to create an opening into the dwelling without consent. And once the defendant enters the dwelling with the requisite intent, the burglary is complete. This means that there is no need to prove that the defendant completed the underlying felony to obtain a burglary conviction.

In addition, a burglary defendant who failed to complete the underlying felony is guilty of the attempted commission of that felony. That is because the defendant (1) specifically intended to commit the felony and (2) performed an overt act in furtherance of the felony - the unlawful breaking and entering.

Here, the assistant unlawfully broke and entered the CEO's home at night with the specific intent to commit larceny - ie, the unlawful taking and carrying away of another's personal property (rare stamp) with the specific intent to permanently deprive the owner of that property. Therefore, the assistant is guilty of burglary (Choices A & C). And since the assistant performed the overt act of unlawfully entering the CEO's home, he is also guilty of attempted larceny (Choice B).

Educational objective: Burglary is complete when the defendant unlawfully breaks and enters another's dwelling with the specific intent to commit a felony therein - the underlying felony need not be committed. And a burglary defendant who fails to complete the underlying felony is also guilty of the attempted commission of that felony.



选项正确率统计：A选项 0%，B选项 28%，C选项 8%，D选项 62%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

普通法上的Burglary（入室犯法罪）要求证明被告人：在夜间非法破门并进入他人住宅，并且怀有在其中实施重罪（例如，larceny）的特定意图。

如果被告未经同意，使用任何程度的物理力量制造进入住宅的开口，即构成非法破门。一旦被告怀有必要意图进入住宅，burglary即告完成。这意味着，要判定burglary罪名成立，无需证明被告完成了基础重罪。

此外，实施burglary的被告如果未能完成基础重罪，则构成该重罪的未遂。这是因为被告人（1）有实施该重罪的特定意图，并且（2）为促成该重罪实施了明显行为——即非法破门并进入。

在本案中，助理在夜间非法破门并进入CEO的住宅，怀有实施larceny的特定意图——即非法取得并带走他人个人财产（稀有邮票），并怀有永久剥夺物主对该财产所有权的特定意图。因此，该助理构成burglary（排除选项A和C）。并且，由于助理实施了非法进入CEO住宅的明显行为，他也构成了attempted larceny（排除选项B）。

教学目的：当被告非法破门并进入他人住宅，且怀有在其中实施重罪的特定意图时，burglary即告完成——其意图实施的基础重罪无需既遂。并且，实施burglary的被告如果未能完成其意图实施的基础重罪，也构成该重罪的未遂。

MBE 刑法考点解析

Common Law Burglary & Attempt

✅ 正确答案：D

Burglary and Attempted Larceny
(构成入室犯法罪和盗窃未遂罪)

🏠 考点一：普通法入室犯法罪

在普通法 (Common Law) 中，Burglary 的成立必须同时满足以下六个要素。让我们结合案情一一核对：

定义： Breaking and entering of the dwelling of another at night with the specific intent to commit a felony therein.
✔
Breaking (破门):
助理使用了备用钥匙开门。
法律点使用钥匙、推开虚掩的门均属于 "Constructive Breaking" 或实际破门，只要制造了通道。
✔
Entering (进入):
助理身体进入了客厅。
✔
Dwelling (住宅):
这是CEO的家 (Home)。
✔
Of Another (他人的):
属于CEO，而非助理。
✔
At Night (夜间):
题目明确说明是 "The next night"。
✔
Intent to Commit Felony (重罪意图):
进入时怀有偷窃 (Larceny) 的特定意图。

结论： 一旦助理带着偷窃意图踏入房门，Burglary 即告既遂 (Complete)。是否偷到东西不影响此罪名的成立。

🏃 考点二：未遂 (Attempt)

虽然助理没有偷到邮票（Larceny 未既遂），但他构成了 Attempted Larceny。

构成要件： Specific Intent + Overt Act (Substantial Step).
  • 特定意图 (Specific Intent): 他想偷邮票。
  • 显见行为 (Overt Act): 他不仅准备了（查日历、拿钥匙），还实施了进入房间并开始搜寻（Searching）的行为。这已经越过了“准备阶段”，构成了实施犯罪的实质性步骤。
⚠️ MBE 关键陷阱：吸收原则

很多考生会误选 B (Burglary only)，认为盗窃未遂被入室犯法罪“吸收”了。

请记住这条铁律：

Burglary DOES NOT merge!
入室犯法罪不与内部意图实施的犯罪（无论既遂还是未遂）发生吸收。

对比：
❌ Larceny + Robbery (会吸收，Robbery包含Larceny)
❌ Attempt + Completed Crime (会吸收，既遂后不再判未遂)
✅ Burglary + Attempted Larceny (两个独立的罪名，均成立)

🎓 总结

助理的行为完全符合 Burglary 的所有普通法要素。同时，他的行为也构成了 Attempted Larceny。由于这两罪不发生吸收 (Non-merger)，他可以被判两项罪名成立。

因此，选项 D 是唯一正确的答案。

A woman was envious of her coworker for receiving a promotion they had both sought. After receiving the promotion, the coworker bought himself a very expensive watch to celebrate. The woman wanted to buy a similar watch, but she could not afford to do so. The coworker later invited the woman to attend a game night he was hosting, and the woman concocted a plan to steal the watch from him.
When the woman arrived at the coworker's house the following night, the coworker invited her in and showed her to the living room where they were playing games. Later in the evening, when no one was looking, the woman snuck into the coworker's bedroom, opened the bedroom closet, and rummaged through the closet until she found a display box in which the coworker kept his valuables. As anticipated, she found the watch inside the box, hid the watch in her jacket, and left with it at the end of the night.
The coworker reported the incident upon discovering that his watch was missing. The police interviewed all of the guests who attended the game night, and after seeing the woman wearing the watch in plain view, the police arrested the woman and charged her with burglary.
Is the woman guilty of burglary?

choices.a: No, because opening the coworker's watch box does not qualify as a breaking.
choices.b: No, because the woman had permission to enter all areas within the coworker's home.
choices.c: Yes, because the woman entered the coworker's home with the intent to steal the watch.
choices.d: Yes, because the woman opened the coworker's closet door with the intent to steal the watch.

一名女子因其同事获得了两人都曾追求的晋升而心生嫉妒。获得晋升后，该同事为自己买了一块非常昂贵的手表以示庆祝。该女子想买一块类似的手表，但她无力承担。之后，同事邀请该女子参加他举办的游戏之夜，该女子便策划了一个从他那里偷走手表的计划。

第二天晚上，当该女子到达同事家时，同事邀请她进屋，并带她到客厅玩游戏。当晚晚些时候，趁无人注意，该女子潜入同事的卧室，打开卧室壁橱，在壁橱里翻找，直到找到了一个同事存放贵重物品的展示盒。正如所料，她在盒子里找到了那块手表，将手表藏在夹克里，并在当晚结束时带着它离开。

同事发现手表丢失后报了警。警方询问了所有参加游戏之夜的客人，在看到该女子公然佩戴着那块手表后，警方逮捕了该女子，并以入室犯法罪（burglary）起诉她。

该女子是否犯有入室犯法罪？
options:
A. No, because opening the coworker's watch box does not qualify as a breaking.
否，因为打开同事的手表盒不构成“破门而入”（breaking）。

B. No, because the woman had permission to enter all areas within the coworker's home.
否，因为该女子已获得许可进入同事家中的所有区域。

C. Yes, because the woman entered the coworker's home with the intent to steal the watch.
是，因为该女子进入同事家时意图窃取手表。

D. Yes, because the woman opened the coworker's closet door with the intent to steal the watch.
是，因为该女子打开同事的壁橱门时意图窃取手表。
data.explanation:
When, as here, the question does not indicate that the majority rule is being tested, apply the common law rule for burglary. Common-law burglary is the:
  • unlawful breaking and entering of another's dwelling at nighttime with the specific intent to commit a felony (eg, larceny) therein.
A breaking is accomplished when even slight force is used to create an opening into a dwelling - eg, opening an unlocked door or window. If the defendant instead entered the dwelling with consent, a breaking can still occur if the defendant later enters part of the dwelling structure (eg, opening a closet door or wall safe) without permission.

Here, the woman went to the coworker's house with the intent to steal his watch. But since the coworker invited the woman into his home for a game night, she did not break into his dwelling when she initially entered his home. However, she did break into the coworker's bedroom closet - part of the dwelling structure that she did not have permission to enter - later that evening. And since the woman entered the closet with the specific intent to steal the coworker's watch (ie, commit larceny), she is guilty of burglary (Choices B & C).†

†This fact pattern also meets the less-stringent majority and Model Penal Code standard for burglary, which merely requires the unlawful entry of a building or other structure with the specific intent to commit any crime therein.

(Choice A) Merely opening an object within a dwelling (eg, watch box, desk drawer, trunk) does not constitute a breaking because common law burglary seeks only to protect a person's right of habitation. However, the woman did commit burglary when she opened the bedroom closet with the requisite intent.

Educational objective: For burglary, a breaking can still occur after a defendant enters a dwelling with consent if the defendant subsequently enters part of the dwelling structure (eg, opening a closet door or wall safe) without consent. But merely opening an object within a dwelling (eg, desk drawer, trunk, box) is not a breaking.



选项正确率统计：A选项 20%，B选项 18%，C选项 5%，D选项 55%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当题目未指明适用多数派规则时，如此题所示，应适用普通法中关于入室犯法罪的规则。普通法上的入室犯法罪 (Common-law burglary) 是指：
  • 在夜间非法破门并进入他人住所，且具有在其中实施重罪（如盗窃罪 (larceny)）的特定意图。
“破门而入”（breaking）是指使用即使是轻微的武力在住所上制造一个入口——例如，打开一扇未上锁的门或窗。如果被告是经同意进入住所的，但其后在未经许可的情况下进入了住所结构的一部分（例如，打开壁橱门或墙壁保险箱），那么“破门而入”（breaking）仍然可能发生。

在本案中，该女子去同事家时意图窃取其手表。但由于同事邀请该女子到他家参加游戏之夜，她在最初进入其家时并未“破门而入”其住所。然而，当晚晚些时候，她确实“破门而入”了同事的卧室壁橱——这是她未获许可进入的住所结构的一部分。并且，由于该女子进入壁橱时具有窃取同事手表的特定意图（即实施盗窃罪 (larceny)），她犯有入室犯法罪 (选项B和C)。†

†此案件事实同样满足了多数派规则和《模范刑法典》(Model Penal Code) 中关于入室犯法罪的较宽松标准，该标准仅要求非法进入建筑物或其他构筑物，并具有在其中实施任何犯罪的特定意图。

(选项A) 仅仅打开住所内的物体（例如，手表盒、书桌抽屉、箱子）不构成“破门而入”（breaking），因为普通法上的入室犯法罪仅旨在保护个人的居住权。然而，当该女子带着必要的意图打开卧室壁橱时，她确实犯下了入室犯法罪。

教学目的： 对于入室犯法罪，即使被告经同意进入住所，如果其后未经同意进入住所结构的一部分（例如，打开壁橱门或墙壁保险箱），“破门而入”（breaking）仍然可能发生。但仅仅打开住所内的物体（例如，书桌抽屉、箱子、盒子）并不构成“破门而入”（breaking）。

References

Charles E. Torcia, 3 Wharton's Criminal Law § 318 (15th ed. 2020) (stating that a breaking may occur within a dwelling by opening a closed inner door, such as a bedroom door, with the intent to commit a felony therein).

MBE 考点解析

Common Law Burglary & Breaking
正确答案：D

该女子犯有入室犯法罪，因为她带着窃取手表的意图打开了同事的壁橱门 (Closet Door)。

核心考点：什么是 "Breaking"？

普通法上的入室犯法罪 (Burglary) 需要满足 "Breaking and Entering"（破门与进入）的要素。

  • 定义：Breaking 不需要破坏性的暴力。只要使用哪怕最轻微的力 (slightest force) 移除障碍物即可，例如推开一扇没上锁的门或转动门把手。
  • 内部破门 (Inner Door Doctrine)：即使最初进入房屋是合法的（例如受邀做客），如果被告在屋内未经许可打开了属于房屋结构一部分 (part of the structure) 的门（如卧室门、壁橱门），这依然构成 Breaking。
关键区分：结构 vs. 物品

本题的陷阱在于区分“壁橱”和“手表盒”。MBE 经常考察这种细微差别：

✅ 构成 Breaking
打开壁橱 (Closet)
打开墙壁保险箱 (Wall Safe)
属于房屋结构的一部分
❌ 不构成 Breaking
打开盒子 (Box)
打开抽屉 (Drawer)
仅仅是家具或动产

这就是为什么选项 A 是错误的理由（打开盒子不算），而选项 D 是正确的理由（打开壁橱算）。

为什么其他选项是错的？
  • 选项 B (许可抗辩)： 虽然她被邀请进入“房子”，但这并不意味着她有权进入“所有区域”（如私人卧室或壁橱）。超出许可范围的进入可能构成非法侵入。
  • 选项 C (意图抗辩)： 这是一个强干扰项。虽然她进门时有坏心思，但她是受邀 (invited) 从大门进入的。因此，最初的进入没有 "Breaking"。Burglary 必须同时满足 Breaking + Entering。她的罪行是在打开壁橱那一刻才满足所有要素的。
💡 MBE 备考小贴士

遇到 Burglary 的题目，请按顺序检查以下逻辑：

  1. 进入方式：是强行进入、欺诈进入（Constructive Breaking），还是受邀进入？受邀进入通常不构成最初的 Breaking。
  2. 后续行为：如果受邀进入，看被告是否推开了任何内部的门（卧室、壁橱）。
  3. 对象属性：区分“建筑物结构”（门、窗、嵌入式保险箱）与“普通容器”（箱子、独立式家具）。只有破坏前者才算 Burglary 的 Breaking。

The employee handed her wallet to the defendant, who took the wallet and ran away. Shortly thereafter, the police found and arrested the defendant.

What crime(s) can the defendant be properly convicted of?

一天深夜，一名女雇员和她的老板正要下班离开。当他们路过一条通往停车场的黑暗小巷时，被告人持刀跳了出来。被告人突然将老板推到附近一栋建筑的墙上，用刀抵住老板的喉咙，并索要他手腕上的手表。老板照做了。随后，被告人转向女雇员，并威胁说如果女雇员不交出她的钱，他就会刺伤老板。女雇员将钱包交给了被告人，被告人拿走钱包后逃跑了。不久之后，警方找到并逮捕了被告人。

被告人可以被正式定罪的罪行是？
options:
A. Assault on the employee, battery on the boss, and robbery from both the employee and the boss.
对女雇员构成攻击罪(Assault)，对老板构成伤害罪(battery)，以及对女雇员和老板均构成抢劫罪(robbery)。

B. Battery on the boss, and larceny from both the employee and the boss.
对老板构成伤害罪(battery)，以及对女雇员和老板均构成盗窃罪(larceny)。

C. Larceny from the employee and the boss, and robbery from the boss.
对女雇员和老板均构成盗窃罪(larceny)，以及对老板构成抢劫罪(robbery)。

D. Robbery from both the employee and the boss.
对女雇员和老板均构成抢劫罪(robbery)。
data.explanation:
Larceny is the unlawful taking and carrying away of the victim's personal property with the specific intent to permanently deprive the victim of that property (ie, to steal). Larceny is elevated to robbery when:
  • the property is taken from the victim's person or presence and
  • the taking is achieved by force or threat of force against the victim, the victim's family member, or another person present.
The threat-of-force element of robbery can be satisfied by a battery, which is the unlawful application of force to another resulting in bodily injury or an offensive touching. This element can also be satisfied by an assault, which is an attempted battery or conduct that intentionally puts the victim in reasonable apprehension of imminent bodily harm.

Here, the defendant battered the boss by grabbing him, pushing him against a wall, and holding a knife to his throat. The defendant also assaulted the boss by threatening to stab him. But the defendant did not assault the employee since he did not attempt to batter her or place her in apprehension of bodily harm (Choice A). The defendant then committed larceny by taking the boss's watch and the employee's wallet.

Both larcenies elevated to robbery since (1) the taking from the boss was accomplished by force and threat of force against him and (2) the taking from the employee was achieved by threatening force against the boss. Since larceny satisfies the taking requirement for robbery - and both battery and assault satisfy the threat-of-force requirement - all three crimes are lesser included offenses. This means that they merge with the robbery and the defendant can only be convicted of robbery; not the other crimes (Choices B & C).

Educational objective: Robbery requires a taking of the victim's property by force or intimidation. Since larceny satisfies the taking requirement and battery/assault satisfy the force or intimidation requirement, they are lesser included offenses that merge with robbery.



选项正确率统计：A选项 36%，B选项 2%，C选项 4%，D选项 56%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

盗窃罪(Larceny)是指以永久剥夺受害人财产（即偷窃）的特定意图，非法拿走并带走受害人个人财产的行为。当满足以下条件时，盗窃罪将升级为抢劫罪(robbery)：
  • 财产是从受害人的人身或其在场范围内夺走的 并且
  • 该夺取行为是通过对受害人、受害人家属或在场的其他人使用暴力或以暴力相威胁而实现的。
抢劫罪中以暴力相威胁的要素可以通过伤害罪(battery)来满足，伤害罪是指对他人非法使用暴力，导致身体伤害或冒犯性接触。该要素也可以通过攻击罪(assault)来满足，攻击罪是指伤害未遂或故意将受害人置于对即时身体伤害产生合理恐惧的行为。

在本案中，被告人通过抓住老板、将其推到墙上、并用刀抵住其喉咙的方式，对老板实施了伤害罪(battery)。被告人还通过威胁要刺伤老板的方式，对老板实施了攻击罪(assault)。但被告人并未对女雇员实施攻击罪，因为他没有试图对她实施伤害，也没有让她产生对身体伤害的恐惧（选项A）。然后，被告人通过拿走老板的手表和女雇员的钱包，实施了盗窃罪。

这两起盗窃罪都升级为抢劫罪，因为（1）从老板处夺取财物是通过对他使用暴力和以暴力相威胁来完成的，以及（2）从女雇员处夺取财物是通过威胁对老板使用暴力来实现的。由于盗窃罪满足了抢劫罪的“夺取”要件，而伤害罪和攻击罪都满足了“暴力或以暴力相威胁”的要件，因此这三种罪行都属于较轻的内含罪名(lesser included offenses)。这意味着它们被抢劫罪所吸收合并，被告人只能被判抢劫罪；而不是其他罪行（选项 B & C）。

教学目的：抢劫罪要求通过暴力或恐吓的方式夺取受害人的财产。由于盗窃罪满足了“夺取”的要件，而伤害罪/攻击罪满足了“暴力或恐吓”的要件，因此它们是较轻的内含罪名，并被抢劫罪吸收合并。

MBE 考点解析

Criminal Law | Robbery & Merger
✅ 正确答案：D

本题考察的核心是抢劫罪的构成要件以及刑法中的吸收原则 (Merger Doctrine)。

核心考点：抢劫罪 (Robbery)

普通法下的抢劫罪定义为：

  • 非法拿走并带走他人的个人财产 (Larceny)；
  • 从受害人身上或其在场范围内 (From person or presence)；
  • 通过暴力 (Force) 或 恐吓 (Intimidation) 的手段。
1. 对老板 (Boss) 的定罪分析

被告将老板推到墙上并用刀抵住喉咙，这构成了殴打罪 (Battery) 和 攻击罪 (Assault)。随后被告拿走了手表。

由于拿走手表是通过“暴力”完成的，盗窃行为升级为抢劫罪 (Robbery)。

2. 对女雇员 (Employee) 的定罪分析

被告威胁女雇员：如果不交出钱，就刺伤老板。女雇员因此交出了钱包。

关键点：抢劫罪中的“恐吓”要素，不仅包括对受害人本人的威胁，也包括对在场的第三方（如家属、同事）进行即时身体伤害的威胁。

因此，尽管暴力威胁是指向老板的，但足以强迫女雇员交出财物，这同样构成了针对女雇员的抢劫罪。

为什么不选 A, B, C？(吸收原则)

这是本题最大的陷阱。在刑法中，较轻的内含罪名 (Lesser Included Offenses) 会被较重的罪名吸收。

  • 公式： Robbery = Larceny + Assault/Battery

一旦被定罪为抢劫 (Robbery)，作为其组成部分的盗窃 (Larceny) 和 攻击/殴打 (Assault/Battery) 就不再单独定罪。

因此，被告只能被判两项抢劫罪，而不能同时被判抢劫罪+盗窃罪，或抢劫罪+伤害罪。

💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 刑法题中，如果你确定被告的行为构成了抢劫罪 (Robbery)，请立即排除任何试图同时对同一行为指控盗窃 (Larceny)、攻击 (Assault) 或 殴打 (Battery) 的选项。

记住：Robbery swallows the parts. (抢劫罪吞噬了它的组成部分)。

questions.question:
Unprepared for a final examination, a student asked his girlfriend to set off the fire alarms in the university building 15 minutes after the test commenced. The girlfriend did so. Several students were injured in the panic that followed as people were trying to get out of the building.
If both the student and the girlfriend are prosecuted for battery and for conspiracy to commit battery, what is the likely result?

choices.a: They are guilty of both crimes.
choices.b: They are guilty of battery but not conspiracy.
choices.c: They are guilty of conspiracy but not battery.
choices.d: They are not guilty of either crime.

data.questionStem:
Q84135

Unprepared for a final examination, a student asked his girlfriend to set off the fire alarms in the university building 15 minutes after the test commenced. The girlfriend did so. Several students were injured in the panic that followed as people were trying to get out of the building.

If both the student and the girlfriend are prosecuted for battery and for conspiracy to commit battery, what is the likely result?

一个学生因期末考试未准备好，让其女友在考试开始15分钟后，在教学楼内拉响火警警报。其女友照做了。在随后人们惊慌逃离大楼的过程中，有几名学生受伤。

如果该学生和其女友均被以伤害罪（battery）和共谋伤害罪（conspiracy to commit battery）起诉，最可能的结果是什么？
options:
A. They are guilty of both crimes.
他们两项罪名都成立。

B. They are guilty of battery but not conspiracy.
他们伤害罪罪名成立，但共谋罪罪名不成立。

C. They are guilty of conspiracy but not battery.
他们共谋罪罪名成立，但伤害罪罪名不成立。

D. They are not guilty of either crime.
他们两项罪名都不成立。
data.explanation:
Battery requires proof that the defendant unlawfully inflicted harmful or offensive physical contact on another. Since battery is a general intent crime , the contact need not be intentionally inflicted. Criminal negligence - ie, a gross deviation from the level of care a reasonable person would use under similar circumstances - is enough to support a battery conviction.

Here, several students were injured when the fire alarms caused people to exit the building in a panic. Although the girlfriend did not intend to inflict harmful or offensive contact when she set off the alarms, she was criminally negligent when she did so during an examination. Therefore, she is guilty of battery. And since the student acted as her accomplice when he encouraged her to set off the alarms, he is liable to the same extent as the girlfriend (Choices C & D).

Conspiracy requires proof that
  • the defendant entered an agreement with the specific intent to commit a crime and
  • an overt act was committed in furtherance of that agreement.
Here, the student and the girlfriend agreed that she would pull the fire alarms. But since they did not enter that agreement with the specific intent to commit battery, they are not guilty of conspiracy to commit battery (Choice A).

Educational objective: General intent crimes (eg, battery) require at least criminally negligent conduct - ie, grossly deviating from the level of care a reasonable person would use under similar circumstances. But specific intent crimes (eg, conspiracy) require intentional conduct - ie, purposefully or knowingly causing a particular result.



选项正确率统计：A选项 28%，B选项 15%（正确选项），C选项 10%，D选项 45%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

伤害罪（Battery）要求证明被告对他人非法施加了有害或冒犯性的身体接触。由于伤害罪是一种一般意图犯罪，该接触无需是故意施加的。刑事过失——即严重偏离一个理性人在类似情况下会使用的注意程度——足以支持伤害罪的定罪。

在本案中，当火警警报导致人们惊慌逃离大楼时，有几名学生受伤。虽然女友在拉响警报时，并无意图施加有害或冒犯性的接触，但她在考试期间这样做，构成了刑事过失。因此，她犯有伤害罪。并且，由于该学生怂恿她拉响警报而成为其共犯，因此他与女友承担同等责任（据此排除选项C和D）。

共谋罪（Conspiracy）要求证明：
  • 被告怀有实施犯罪的特定意图，与他人达成了协议；并且
  • 为推进该协议，实施了一项公开行为。
在本案中，该学生和女友同意由她去拉响火警警报。但由于他们达成该协议时，并没有实施伤害罪（battery）的特定意图，因此他们不构成共谋伤害罪（据此排除选项A）。

教学目的：一般意图犯罪（例如，伤害罪 battery）至少要求刑事过失行为——即严重偏离一个理性人在类似情况下会使用的注意程度。但特定意图犯罪（例如，共谋罪 conspiracy）要求故意行为——即有目的地或明知地导致某一特定结果。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 刑法考点解析

Battery & Conspiracy
✅ 正确答案：B

他们伤害罪（Battery）成立，但共谋罪（Conspiracy）不成立。

本题的核心考点在于区分一般意图犯罪 (General Intent Crimes) 与 特定意图犯罪 (Specific Intent Crimes) 的心理状态要求。

1. 为什么伤害罪 (Battery) 成立？
法律规则

普通法下的 Battery 定义为对他人身体进行非法的、有害的或冒犯性的接触。

关键在于：Battery 是一般意图犯罪 (General Intent Crime)。

这意味着检方不需要证明被告“想要”伤害别人。只要证明被告的行为构成了刑事过失 (Criminal Negligence) 或鲁莽 (Recklessness) 即可。

  • 本案分析：在拥挤的教学楼拉响火警警报，明显会制造恐慌和踩踏风险。这种行为严重偏离了理性人的注意义务，构成了刑事过失。
  • 结果：因为过失行为导致了实际的身体伤害，Battery 罪名成立。
  • 共犯责任 (Accomplice Liability)：男友虽然没有亲自拉警报，但他教唆/怂恿 (Solicited/Encouraged) 女友实施该行为，因此作为共犯 (Accomplice) 承担同等责任。
2. 为什么共谋罪 (Conspiracy) 不成立？
法律规则

Conspiracy 是特定意图犯罪 (Specific Intent Crime)。

它要求两个层面的意图：
1. 达成协议的意图 (Intent to agree)
2. 实现犯罪目标的特定意图 (Intent to achieve the objective)

这是本题最大的陷阱。虽然他们“共谋”去做一件坏事（拉警报），但要构成“共谋伤害罪 (Conspiracy to commit Battery)”，他们必须特意想要导致有人受伤。

  • 本案分析：题目明确指出目的是“因为没准备好考试而想拖延时间”。他们达成协议是为了拉警报，而不是为了打人或让人受伤。
  • 缺乏特定意图：由于他们没有“让人受伤”的特定目的 (Specific Intent)，因此不能构成共谋伤害罪。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

在处理 MBE 刑法题时，请务必遵循以下思维路径：

  1. 识别罪名类型：首先判断该罪名是 General Intent 还是 Specific Intent。
    (常见 Specific Intent: Conspiracy, Attempt, Solicitation, First Degree Murder, Larceny, Burglary 等)
  2. 检查心理状态 (Mens Rea)：
    • 如果是 Battery (General Intent)，问自己：被告是否鲁莽/过失？如果是，且造成伤害，则有罪。
    • 如果是 Conspiracy (Specific Intent)，问自己：被告是否渴望那个特定的犯罪结果发生？如果只是导致了结果但并非本意，则无罪。

questions.question:
A state statute makes it a crime to "knowingly possess a controlled substance analogue." The statute defines a "controlled substance analogue" (CSA) as a substance that has a chemical structure similar to a controlled substance and has a physiological effect on humans similar to or greater than a controlled substance. A defendant was arrested for possession of a synthetic stimulant known by its street name as "bath salts" and was charged with violating the criminal statute.
Regarding the knowledge element of this crime as it relates to the substance found in the defendant's possession, which of the following is the most proper jury instruction?

choices.a: "If you find that the defendant knew that the substance he possessed was an illegal CSA, you must find the defendant guilty."
choices.b: "If you find that the defendant knew that the substance he possessed was illegal or had a chemical structure similar to a controlled substance and physiological effects on humans similar to or greater than a controlled substance, you must find the defendant guilty."
choices.c: "If you find that the defendant possessed a substance that was a CSA, you must find the defendant guilty even if the defendant did not know that the substance was a CSA or illegal."
choices.d: "If you find that the substance possessed by the defendant is commonly known to have a chemical structure similar to a controlled substance and physiological effects on humans similar to or greater than a controlled substance, you must find the defendant guilty."

data.questionStem:
Q84140

A state statute makes it a crime to "knowingly possess a controlled substance analogue." The statute defines a "controlled substance analogue" (CSA) as a substance that has a chemical structure similar to a controlled substance and has a physiological effect on humans similar to or greater than a controlled substance. A defendant was arrested for possession of a synthetic stimulant known by its street name as "bath salts" and was charged with violating the criminal statute.

Regarding the knowledge element of this crime as it relates to the substance found in the defendant's possession, which of the following is the most proper jury instruction?

一部州法律规定“明知而持有管控物质类似物”构成犯罪。该法律将“管控物质类似物”（CSA）定义为一种化学结构与管控物质相似，且对人体产生的生理效应与管控物质相似或更强的物质。一名被告因持有一种俗称为“bath salts”的合成兴奋剂而被捕，并被控违反该刑事法规。

关于本罪中与被告持有的物质相关的明知要素，以下哪项是为最适当的陪审团指令？
options:
A. "If you find that the defendant knew that the substance he possessed was an illegal CSA, you must find the defendant guilty."
“如果你们认定被告明知其所持有的物质为一种非法的CSA，你们必须裁定被告有罪。”

B. "If you find that the defendant knew that the substance he possessed was illegal or had a chemical structure similar to a controlled substance and physiological effects on humans similar to or greater than a controlled substance, you must find the defendant guilty."
“如果你们认定被告明知其持有的物质是非法的，或者明知该物质具有与管控物质相似的化学结构、以及对人体具有与管控物质相似或更强的生理效应，你们必须裁定被告有罪。”

C. "If you find that the defendant possessed a substance that was a CSA, you must find the defendant guilty even if the defendant did not know that the substance was a CSA or illegal."
“如果你们认定被告持有的物质是一种CSA，你们必须裁定被告有罪，即使被告并不知道该物质是一种CSA或属非法。”

D. "If you find that the substance possessed by the defendant is commonly known to have a chemical structure similar to a controlled substance and physiological effects on humans similar to or greater than a controlled substance, you must find the defendant guilty."
“如果你们认定，被告所持有的物质，是众所周知具有与管控物质相似的化学结构、以及对人体具有与管控物质相似或更强的生理效应的物质，你们必须裁定被告有罪。”
data.explanation:
Possession of controlled substance (dual-knowledge requirement)


Knowledge of possession
(Defendant must knowingly possess substance)		exercise dominion & control over substance
Knowledge of item
(Defendant must know that substance is controlled)		know that substance is prohibited by law, even if defendant does not know specific identity of substance or know facts about substance that make possession illegal, even if defendant does not know possession is illegal
When a statute makes it a crime to knowingly possess an item, the word "knowingly" applies to the statute's verb (possess) as well as the object of that verb (controlled substance analogue (CSA)). As a result, a conviction under this statute requires proof that the defendant knowingly possessed the substance and either:

  • knew that the substance was prohibited by law - even if the defendant did not know the specific identity of the substance - or

  • knew facts about the substance that made possessing it illegal - eg, knew that it had a chemical structure similar to a controlled substance and physiological effects on humans similar to or greater than a controlled substance - even if the defendant did not know that possessing it was illegal.


A jury instruction regarding the knowledge element of this crime as it relates to the substance found in the defendant's possession must include both of the above bullet points (Choice A).

The jury instruction should therefore read: "If you find that the defendant knew that the substance he possessed was illegal (prohibited by law) or had a chemical structure similar to a controlled substance and physiological effects on humans similar to or greater than a controlled substance (facts making its possession illegal), you must find the defendant guilty."(Choices C & D) Mere possession of a substance later identified as a controlled substance or an analogue thereof is not sufficient to convict the defendant. Nor is it sufficient that the substance possessed by the defendant is commonly known (by the public at large) as a CSA. Instead, the defendant must have known that the substance is illegal or known facts about the substance that made possessing it illegal.

Educational objective: In prosecutions for possession of a controlled substance or analogue thereof, the defendant's knowledge that the substance was a controlled substance or analogue may be established by evidence that the defendant knew (1) the substance was prohibited by law or (2) facts about the substance that made possessing it illegal.

选项正确率统计：A选项 30%，B选项 50%（正确选项），C选项 13%，D选项 5%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

持有管控物质（双重明知要求）


对持有的明知
（被告必须明知其持有该物质）		对物质行使支配和控制
对物品性质的明知
（被告必须明知该物质是受管控的）		明知该物质为法律所禁止，即使被告不知道该物质的具体名称 或 明知关于该物质的事实使其持有行为构成非法，即使被告不知道持有该物质是违法的
当一部法律将明知而持有一物品定为犯罪时，“明知”一词既适用于该法律的动词（持有），也适用于该动词的宾语（管控物质类似物（CSA））。因此，根据该法律定罪，需要证明被告明知其持有该物质，并且符合以下任一情形：

  • 明知该物质为法律所禁止——即使被告不知道该物质的具体名称——或

  • 明知关于该物质的事实使其持有行为构成非法——例如，明知其化学结构与管控物质相似、且对人体产生的生理效应与管控物质相似或更强——即使被告不知道持有该物质是违法的。


关于本罪中与被告处发现的物质相关的明知要素，陪审团指令必须包含上述要点中的两者 （选项 A） 。

因此，陪审团指令应为：“如果你们认定被告明知其持有的物质是非法的（为法律所禁止），或该物质具有与管控物质相似的化学结构以及对人体产生与管控物质相似或更强的生理效应（使其持有行为非法的事实），你们必须裁定被告有罪。”

（选项 C 和 D）仅仅持有后来被鉴定为管控物质或其类似物的物质，不足以给被告定罪。被告持有的物质是（广大公众）普遍知晓的CSA，这一点同样不充分。相反，被告必须明知该物质是非法的，或明知使持有该物质成为非法行为的那些事实。

教学目标：在因持有管控物质或其类似物而提起的诉讼中，可以通过证据证明被告（1）明知该物质为法律所禁止，或（2）明知使持有该物质成为非法行为的那些事实，从而证实被告明知该物质是管控物质或其类似物。

References

McFadden v. United States, 576 U.S. 186, 194 - 96 (2015) (applying the dual-knowledge requirement to controlled substance analogue prosecutions).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：管控物质类似物

本题考察的是刑法中关于“明知” (Knowingly) 这一犯罪意图 (Mens Rea) 在涉及管控物质类似物 (Controlled Substance Analogue, CSA) 时的具体适用范围。

核心考点：McFadden 规则
当法规规定“明知而持有”某物为犯罪时，“明知”不仅适用于“持有”这一行为，也适用于该物品的“非法性质”。
Ref: McFadden v. United States (2015)

⚖️ 判例确立的双重证明标准

根据最高法院在 McFadden 案中的裁决，要证明被告“明知”其持有的是 CSA，检方只需证明以下两种情况中的任意一种：

路径一：明知非法性
被告知道该物质是受管控的或非法的（即使他不知道具体的化学名称或它是类似物）。
例如：被告承认“我知道这是违禁品”。
路径二：明知物理特征
被告知道该物质具有使其成为 CSA 的特定特征（即：化学结构相似 + 生理效应相似/更强）。
即使被告不知道这在法律上叫 CSA，但他知道这东西的成分和药效像毒品一样。

✅ 正确答案解析 (选项 B)

选项 B 完美复述了上述法律标准。

陪审团指令必须包含这两种可能性（用“或”连接）：

  1. 被告明知该物质是非法的 (Illegal)；
    或者 (OR)
  2. 被告明知该物质具有类似管控物质的化学结构和生理效应。

只要满足其一，即可认定被告具有犯罪意图。

❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 A (太窄)： 要求被告必须知道该物质被法律定义为“CSA”。这是错误的，被告只需知道它是非法的，或者知道它的药效特征即可，不需要知道具体的法律术语。
选项 C (严格责任)： 认为只要持有 CSA 就有罪，无需明知。这是错误的。该法规明确要求“Knowingly”，不能适用严格责任 (Strict Liability)。
选项 D (客观标准)： 强调“众所周知 (Commonly known)”。刑法中的“明知”通常是主观标准 (Subjective Standard)，即必须是被告本人知道，而不是大众知道。
🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)
在处理涉及 Mens Rea（犯罪意图）的题目时：
  • 注意修饰词（如 Knowingly）通常会穿透到宾语的性质。
  • 对于类似物 (Analogue) 案件，记住“身份 vs. 特征” (Identity vs. Features) 的二选一逻辑：要么知道它是违禁品（身份），要么知道它像违禁品一样起作用（特征）。

A woman told a man to accompany her into her friend's unlocked barn and retrieve an expensive black saddle that she said she had loaned to the friend. The man accompanied the woman to the friend's barn, opened the door, found a black saddle hanging high above the ground, and climbed a ladder to reach it. He handed the saddle down to the woman, and the two left with it together. In fact, the saddle belonged to the friend, and when the friend discovered the saddle missing, she suspected that the woman was the thief. The friend used a screwdriver to break into the woman's house to find the saddle. Upon discovering the saddle on the woman's kitchen table, the friend took it back and called the police.
The jurisdiction follows the common law, except that burglary covers structures in addition to dwellings and the nighttime element has been eliminated.
Which of these individuals is guilty of burglary?

choices.a: All of them.
choices.b: Only the friend.
choices.c: Only the woman.
choices.d: The man and the woman.

data.questionStem:
Q84137

A woman told a man to accompany her into her friend's unlocked barn and retrieve an expensive black saddle that she said she had loaned to the friend. The man accompanied the woman to the friend's barn, opened the door, found a black saddle hanging high above the ground, and climbed a ladder to reach it. He handed the saddle down to the woman, and the two left with it together. In fact, the saddle belonged to the friend, and when the friend discovered the saddle missing, she suspected that the woman was the thief. The friend used a screwdriver to break into the woman's house to find the saddle. Upon discovering the saddle on the woman's kitchen table, the friend took it back and called the police.

The jurisdiction follows the common law, except that burglary covers structures in addition to dwellings and the nighttime element has been eliminated.

Which of these individuals is guilty of burglary?

一名女子让一名男子陪她进入其朋友未上锁的谷仓，取回一个昂贵的黑色马鞍，该女子声称马鞍是她借给朋友的。该男子陪同女子来到朋友的谷仓，打开门，发现一个黑色马鞍高高地挂着，便爬上梯子去取。他将马鞍递给女子，两人一同带着它离开。事实上，马鞍属于该朋友，当朋友发现马鞍丢失时，她怀疑女子是小偷。朋友用螺丝刀撬开女子的房门进入其房屋寻找马鞍。在女子的厨房桌子上发现马鞍后，朋友将其取回并报了警。

该司法管辖区遵循普通法，但入室犯法罪的范围除了住宅外还包括其他建筑物，且夜间犯罪的要素已被废除。

这些人中，谁犯有入室犯法罪？
options:
A. All of them.
他们全部都有罪。

B. Only the friend.
只有朋友有罪。

C. Only the woman.
只有女子有罪。

D. The man and the woman.
男子和女子都有罪。
data.explanation:
In this jurisdiction, burglary is:
  • the unlawful breaking and entering of another's structure or dwelling - eg, use of slight force to open a door and step through the doorway
  • with the specific intent to commit a felony therein.
Larceny is a felony that occurs when a person unlawfully takes and carries away another's personal property with the specific intent to permanently deprive the owner of it. And a person is guilty of these crimes if he/she personally committed the crime OR used an innocent agent to commit the criminal acts. An innocent agent is a person who lacked the requisite mens rea but was tricked or forced into committing the crime.

Here, the man was an innocent agent of the woman since she falsely told him that she had loaned the saddle to the friend to trick the man into helping her take it from the friend's barn. The woman then used the man to open the unlocked barn door (unlawful breaking) and they entered the barn. Since the woman entered intending to steal the friend's saddle (larceny), she is guilty of burglary. But since the man believed that the woman owned the saddle (no intent to commit larceny or other felony), he is not guilty of burglary (Choices A & D).

The friend then discovered that her saddle was missing. She immediately suspected that the woman stole it, so the friend broke and entered the woman's house to retrieve it. But the friend did not intend to steal another's property because she owned the saddle. And since she did not intend to commit larceny or any other felony, the friend is not guilty of burglary (Choices A & B).

Educational objective: A person is guilty if he/she personally commits a crime or uses an innocent agent to commit the criminal acts. An innocent agent is a person who lacked the requisite mens rea but was tricked or forced into committing the crime.



选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 6%，C选项 80%（正确选项），D选项 7%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

在该司法管辖区，入室犯法罪 (burglary) 的构成要件为：
  • 非法破门并进入他人的建筑物或住宅——例如，使用轻微的力气打开门并跨过门槛
  • 怀有在其中实施重罪 (felony) 的特定意图。
Larceny是一种重罪 (felony)，指某人非法取得并带走他人的个人财产，并怀有永久剥夺物主所有权的特定意图。一个人如果亲自实施犯罪或利用无辜的代理人实施犯罪行为，则犯有此等罪行。无辜的代理人是指缺乏必要的犯罪意图 (mens rea)，但被欺骗或强迫实施犯罪的人。

在本案中，该男子是女子的无辜代理人，因为女子谎称她将马鞍借给了朋友，以此欺骗男子帮助她从朋友的谷仓中取走马鞍。女子随后利用该男子打开未上锁的谷仓门（非法破门），然后他们进入了谷仓。由于女子进入时意图偷窃朋友的马鞍 (Larceny)，她犯有入室犯法罪。但由于男子相信马鞍属于女子（没有实施Larceny或其他重罪的意图），他并未犯下入室犯法罪（选项A和D）。

朋友随后发现她的马鞍不见了。她立即怀疑是女子偷了它，所以朋友破门进入女子的房屋以取回马鞍。但朋友并无意图偷窃他人的财产，因为马鞍是她自己的。并且由于她没有意图实施Larceny或任何其他重罪，朋友并未犯下入室犯法罪（选项A和B）。

教学目标：如果一个人亲自实施犯罪或利用无辜的代理人实施犯罪行为，则该人有罪。无辜的代理人是指缺乏必要的犯罪意图 (mens rea)，但被欺骗或强迫实施犯罪的人。

MBE 刑法考点解析

Burglary & Innocent Agents

⚖️ 本题适用的入室犯法罪 (Burglary) 定义 根据题目设定，该司法管辖区对普通法进行了修正：
  • 行为：非法破门并进入 (Breaking and Entering)。
  • 对象：住宅或其他建筑物 (Structure)。
  • 意图：怀有实施重罪 (Felony) 的特定意图。
  • 注意：无需“夜间”这一要素。
1. 女子 (The Woman) 有罪 (Guilty)

虽然女子没有亲自破门，但她利用了男子作为工具。在刑法中，这被称为“无辜代理人” (Innocent Agent) 理论。

女子具有实施盗窃 (Larceny) 的特定意图 (Specific Intent)。她欺骗男子，利用男子完成了“破门”和“进入”的犯罪行为 (Actus Reus)。

结论：利用无辜代理人实施犯罪的人，被视为直接正犯 (Principal in the first degree)。因此，女子构成了 Burglary。

2. 男子 (The Man) 无罪 (Not Guilty)

Burglary 是特定意图犯罪，要求被告在进入时必须怀有实施重罪（本案中为盗窃）的意图。

男子被女子欺骗，真诚地相信马鞍属于女子。因此，他缺乏盗窃罪所需的“非法剥夺他人财产”的心理状态 (Mens Rea)。

结论：没有犯罪意图，就不构成 Burglary。

3. 朋友 (The Friend) 无罪 (Not Guilty)

朋友确实实施了“破门进入”女子房屋的行为。但是，Burglary 的定罪核心在于进入时是否意图实施重罪（Larceny）。

权利主张 (Claim of Right)： 盗窃罪 (Larceny) 要求拿走“他人”的财产。如果一个人拿回自己拥有的财产（即使方式非法，如擅闯民宅），这在法律上不构成盗窃罪，因为缺乏剥夺“他人”财产的意图。

结论：既然朋友进入房屋只是为了取回自己的马鞍，她就没有实施重罪（盗窃）的意图。没有重罪意图，就不构成 Burglary。

💡 MBE 拿分技巧

1. 区分“非法侵入”与“入室犯法”： 朋友的行为构成了非法侵入 (Trespass)，甚至可能构成故意毁坏财物，但只要没有实施重罪的意图，就不是 Burglary。

2. 代理人原则： 只要题目中出现“A欺骗B去干坏事”，首先判断B是否知情。如果B不知情，A就是借刀杀人（利用无辜代理人），A有罪，B无罪。

questions.question: In which of the following cases is a defendant most likely to be convicted if charged with receiving stolen property?

choices.a: The defendant bought a car from a man. Before the purchase, the man told the defendant that the car was stolen. The man had stolen the car with the help of a friend who, unknown to the defendant or the man, was an undercover police informant who feigned cooperation with the man in the theft of the car.
choices.b: The defendant bought a car from a man. Before the purchase, the man told the defendant that the car was stolen. Unknown to the defendant, the man had stolen the car from a parking lot and had been caught by the police as he was driving it away. The man agreed to cooperate with the police and carry through with his prearranged sale of the car to the defendant.
choices.c: The defendant bought a car from a man. Before the purchase, the man told the defendant that the car was stolen. Unknown to the defendant, the man was in fact the owner of the car but had reported it to the police as stolen and had collected on a fraudulent claim of its theft from his insurance company.
choices.d: The defendant bought a car from a man who operates a used car lot. Before the purchase, the man told the defendant that the car had been stolen, which was true. Unknown to the defendant, the man is an undercover police informant who is operating the lot in cooperation with the police in exchange for leniency in connection with criminal charges pending against him.

data.questionStem:
Q84092

In which of the following cases is a defendant most likely to be convicted if charged with receiving stolen property?

在下列哪种情况下，如果被告被指控犯有收受赃物罪，其最有可能被定罪？
options:
A. The defendant bought a car from a man. Before the purchase, the man told the defendant that the car was stolen. The man had stolen the car with the help of a friend who, unknown to the defendant or the man, was an undercover police informant who feigned cooperation with the man in the theft of the car.
被告从一名男子处购买了一辆汽车。在购买前，该男子告知被告该车是偷来的。该男子是在一个朋友的帮助下偷得这辆车，但被告和该男子都不知道的是，这个朋友是一名卧底警方线人，他在盗窃汽车的过程中假装与该男子合作。

B. The defendant bought a car from a man. Before the purchase, the man told the defendant that the car was stolen. Unknown to the defendant, the man had stolen the car from a parking lot and had been caught by the police as he was driving it away. The man agreed to cooperate with the police and carry through with his prearranged sale of the car to the defendant.
被告从一名男子处购买了一辆汽车。在购买前，该男子告知被告该车是偷来的。被告所不知道的是，该男子从一个停车场偷了这辆车，并在驾车离开时被警察抓获。该男子同意与警方合作，继续执行与被告预先安排的汽车销售。

C. The defendant bought a car from a man. Before the purchase, the man told the defendant that the car was stolen. Unknown to the defendant, the man was in fact the owner of the car but had reported it to the police as stolen and had collected on a fraudulent claim of its theft from his insurance company.
被告从一名男子处购买了一辆汽车。在购买前，该男子告知被告该车是偷来的。被告所不知道的是，该男子实际上是这辆车的主人，但他向警方报失，并从其保险公司处就该车的盗窃进行了欺诈性索赔并获得了赔偿。

D. The defendant bought a car from a man who operates a used car lot. Before the purchase, the man told the defendant that the car had been stolen, which was true. Unknown to the defendant, the man is an undercover police informant who is operating the lot in cooperation with the police in exchange for leniency in connection with criminal charges pending against him.
被告从一名经营二手车场的男子处购买了一辆汽车。在购买前，该男子告知被告该车是偷来的，这是事实。被告所不知道的是，该男子是一名卧底警方线人，他与警方合作经营该车场，以换取对其待决刑事指控的宽大处理。
data.explanation:
A defendant is guilty of receiving stolen property if he/she:
  • took possession of, or exercised control over, stolen personal property
  • knew that the property was stolen and
  • specifically intended to permanently deprive the owner of the property.
But property is no longer considered stolen once the police recover the property - ie, locate and exercise control over it.

Here, the defendant bought a car from the man after the man told the defendant that it was stolen (knowledge and intent). The man stole the car with a friend who, unbeknownst to the man and the defendant, had been working as an undercover police informant. But since the police did not recover the stolen car before the defendant's purchase (possession), the defendant will likely be convicted of receiving stolen property.

(Choice B) The defendant bought a car from the man after being told that it was stolen. Although the man had taken the car from a parking lot, he was stopped and the car was recovered by police before the defendant took possession. Therefore, the car is not considered stolen and the defendant would likely be acquitted.

(Choice C) Although the defendant intended to buy a stolen car from the man, the man actually owned it. Therefore, the car was not stolen property.

(Choice D) The defendant bought a car from the man after being told that it had been stolen. But since the man operated the used car lot in cooperation with the police, the police exercised control over the car before the defendant took possession. Therefore, the car is considered recovered - not stolen.

Educational objective: Receiving stolen property requires proof that the defendant (1) took possession of, or exercised control over, stolen personal property, (2) knew that the property was stolen, and (3) specifically intended to permanently deprive the owner of it. But once stolen property is recovered by police, it is no longer considered stolen.



选项正确率统计：A选项 60%（正确选项），B选项 18%，C选项 8%，D选项 12%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

如果被告符合以下条件，则犯有收受赃物罪 (receiving stolen property)：
  • 占有或控制被盗的个人财产
  • 明知该财产是被盗的 并且
  • 有特定意图要永久剥夺财产所有人的所有权。
但是，一旦警方追回财产——即定位并控制该财产，该财产就不再被视为赃物。

在本案中，被告在男子告知其车辆系被盗后购买了该车（满足明知和意图要素）。该男子是在一个朋友的帮助下偷得这辆车，但该男子和被告都不知道的是，这个朋友一直是卧底警方线人。但由于警方在被告购买（占有）该车前并未追回该失窃车辆，因此被告很可能被判犯有收受赃物罪。

(选项B) 被告在被告知车辆系被盗后，从该男子处购买了该车。尽管该男子从停车场偷走了这辆车，但在被告占有该车之前，他已被警方拦截且车辆已被追回。因此，该车不被视为赃物，被告可能会被宣告无罪。

(选项C) 尽管被告意图从该男子处购买一辆被盗汽车，但该男子实际上拥有该车。因此，该车并非赃物。

(选项D) 被告在被告知车辆系被盗后，从该男子处购买了该车。但由于该男子与警方合作经营该二手车场，警方在被告占有该车之前已经控制了该车。因此，该车被视为已追回——而非赃物。

教学目标：收受赃物罪要求证明被告 (1) 占有或控制了被盗的个人财产，(2) 明知该财产是被盗的，以及 (3) 有特定意图要永久剥夺物主的财产。但是，一旦被盗财产被警方追回，它就不再被视为赃物。

MBE 刑法考点解析

Receiving Stolen Property
(收受赃物罪)

⚖️ 核心法律规则 (Black Letter Law)

要构成收受赃物罪 (Receiving Stolen Property)，必须同时满足以下要素：

  1. 收受 (Receiving)：占有或控制财产；
  2. 赃物 (Stolen Property)：财产在收受时必须具有“被盗”的法律属性；
  3. 明知 (Knowledge)：被告知道该财产是被盗的；
  4. 意图 (Intent)：意图永久剥夺主人的所有权。

🔍 为什么选项 A 是正确答案？

选项 A (Correct)

案情关键点：小偷在警方卧底线人 (Informant) 的“帮助”下偷车，随后卖给被告。

法律推理：

  • 虽然有线人参与，但线人只是假装合作，并没有代表警方实际控制 (Exercise Control) 或追回 (Recover) 这辆车。
  • 在被告购买的那一刻，这辆车在法律上和事实上仍然处于“被盗”状态 (Status of being stolen)。
  • 警方尚未介入切断“赃物”的属性链条。
✅ 结论：被告接收的是真正的赃物，构成既遂犯。

❌ 为什么其他选项是错误的？

这三个选项都涉及同一个核心考点：赃物属性的丧失 (Loss of Stolen Status)。

选项 B (Wrong)

陷阱：小偷被抓后，同意配合警方“钓鱼执法” (Sting Operation)。

解析：一旦警方抓住了小偷并控制了车辆，该车在法律上就被视为“已追回” (Recovered)。它不再是赃物。被告接收的不是赃物，因此不能构成收受赃物罪（可能构成未遂 Attempt）。

选项 C (Wrong)

陷阱：车主骗保 (Insurance Fraud)。

解析：卖车的人就是车主本人。车主不可能“偷”自己的车（除非涉及特定担保权益）。该车从始至终都不是赃物。

选项 D (Wrong)

陷阱：警方合作经营的车场。

解析：既然车场是与警方合作经营的，警方对车辆拥有控制权。这等同于车辆已被警方追回或处于警方控制之下，因此失去了“赃物”属性。

🎓 MBE 考试通关秘籍

在处理 Receiving Stolen Property 的题目时，务必检查时间线 (Timeline)：

如果在被告接触财产之前，警方已经介入并实际控制了该财产（即使是为了钓鱼执法），那么该财产就不再是赃物。

此时，被告通常只能被判未遂 (Attempt)，因为这是“法律上的不能犯” (Legal Impossibility) 在现代刑法中通常被视为事实上的不能犯，从而允许定未遂罪，但绝不能定既遂罪。

A man was invited to attend a party at a neighbor's house. The man knew that the neighbor kept his valuable sports memorabilia collection in the basement game room and intended to steal it. On the night of the party, guests gathered on the main floor of the house and in the basement game room. The man made his way to the basement and waited until the number of guests dwindled to none. The man then went to grab the memorabilia but found that there was too much to carry out without being noticed. As a result, he decided to hide in the basement until the neighbor went to bed, at which time he would sneak out of the house with the memorabilia. Once the house was quiet, the man tried to exit the basement but found that the basement door had been closed and locked from the outside. Left with no other choice, the man broke a small basement window and climbed out of it with the memorabilia.
The man has been charged with burglary in a common law jurisdiction.
Can the man properly be convicted of burglary?

choices.a: No, because the man did not intend to break the basement window when he decided to steal the memorabilia.
choices.b: No, because there was not a breaking sufficient to support a burglary conviction.
choices.c: Yes, because the man broke the basement window to escape with the memorabilia.
choices.d: Yes, because the man had the intent to steal the memorabilia upon entering the neighbor's house.

一名男子受邀参加邻居家的派对。该男子知道邻居将其贵重的体育纪念品收藏在地下室游戏室，并意图窃取。派对当晚，客人们聚集在房子的主楼层和地下室游戏室。该男子前往地下室，并等到客人完全散去。然后，该男子试图拿走纪念品，但发现东西太多，无法在不被注意的情况下带走。因此，他决定躲在地下室，直到邻居上床睡觉，届时他将带着纪念品偷偷溜出房子。待房子安静下来后，该男子试图离开地下室，但发现地下室的门已从外面被关闭和锁上。别无选择之下，该男子打破了一扇地下室的小窗户，并带着纪念品爬了出去。

该男子在一个普通法 (common law) 司法管辖区被指控犯有入室犯法罪 (burglary)。

该男子是否可以被正当定罪为入室犯法罪 (burglary)？
options:
A. No, because the man did not intend to break the basement window when he decided to steal the memorabilia.
不可以，因为该男子在决定偷窃纪念品时，并无意图打破地下室窗户。

B. No, because there was not a breaking sufficient to support a burglary conviction.
不可以，因为不存在足以支持入室犯法罪 (burglary) 定罪的破门行为。

C. Yes, because the man broke the basement window to escape with the memorabilia.
可以，因为该男子为了带着纪念品逃跑而打破了地下室窗户。

D. Yes, because the man had the intent to steal the memorabilia upon entering the neighbor's house.
可以，因为该男子在进入邻居家时就具有偷窃纪念品的意图。
data.explanation:
Common law burglary is the unlawful breaking and entering of another's dwelling at night with the specific intent to commit a felony therein. A breaking occurs when a person uses force to create an opening into a dwelling - eg, by opening an unlocked door or breaking a window to gain entry. But the use of force to exit a dwelling after commission of a felony therein does not constitute a breaking. Therefore, the man cannot be properly convicted of common law burglary (Choice C).

(Choice A) The fact that the man did not intend to break the window when he decided to steal the memorabilia is no defense to burglary since a breaking is accomplished by even a slight use of force (eg, opening an unlocked door or window).

(Choice D) The man did have the intent to steal the memorabilia upon entering the neighbor's house and entering the basement. But since he entered the home and the basement with the neighbor's consent, no unlawful breaking and entering occurred. Therefore, the man cannot be convicted of common law burglary.

Educational objective: The breaking element of common law burglary is satisfied when a person unlawfully uses force to create an opening into a dwelling. Therefore, use of force to exit a dwelling is insufficient to support this element.



选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 66%（正确选项），C选项 9%，D选项 18%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

普通法 (common law) 上的入室犯法罪 (burglary) 是指在夜间非法破门并进入他人住宅，且具有在其中犯下重罪的特定意图。当一个人使用暴力制造一个进入住宅的通道时，即构成破门行为——例如，通过打开一扇未上锁的门或打破一扇窗户以进入。但在住宅内犯下重罪之后，为了离开住宅而使用暴力的，不构成破门行为。因此，该男子不能被正当定罪为普通法上的入室犯法罪 (burglary) （选项C）。

（选项A）该男子在决定盗窃纪念品时并无意图打破窗户这一事实，不能作为对入室犯法罪 (burglary) 的抗辩，因为即便只是轻微使用暴力（例如，打开一扇未上锁的门或窗户），也构成破门行为。

（选项D）该男子在进入邻居的房子和地下室时，确实有偷窃纪念品的意图。但由于他是在邻居同意的情况下进入房屋和地下室的，因此并未发生非法的破门而入行为。因此，该男子不能被定罪为普通法上的入室犯法罪 (burglary)。

教学目标：普通法 (common law) 入室犯法罪 (burglary) 的破门要素，在行为人非法使用暴力制造一个进入住宅的通道时即告满足。因此，为离开住宅而使用暴力，不足以支持此项要素。
