MBE 考点解析

Common Law Burglary (普通法入室犯法罪)

⚖️ 黑体字法则 (Black Letter Law) 普通法下的 Burglary 必须同时满足以下六个要素：
  1. Breaking (破门/破坏)
  2. Entering (进入)
  3. Of a dwelling (住宅)
  4. Of another (他人)
  5. At night (夜间)
  6. With intent to commit a felony therein (意图在内犯重罪)
🔍 案情关键点分析
1. 进入方式 (Entry)：
被告是被邀请参加派对的 (invited)。他是通过未上锁的门或在主人同意下进入的。
结论：进入时没有 Breaking。
2. 离开方式 (Exit)：
被告打破窗户是为了离开 (escape)。
结论：这是 Breaking Out，不是 Breaking In。
✅ 正确答案解析 (选项 B)

选项 B 正确。因为本案中不存在足以支持 Burglary 定罪的“破门” (Breaking) 行为。

在普通法 (Common Law) 中，"Breaking" 必须是为了进入 (entry) 住宅。如果一个人在进入时获得了同意（如本案中的受邀客人），或者通过敞开的门进入，就不构成 Breaking。

虽然被告在离开时打破了窗户，但这属于 "Breaking Out"。在严格的普通法下，Breaking Out 不构成 Burglary 的破门要素。

❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A (无意图打破窗户)：
这是一个干扰项。虽然 Breaking 需要只是轻微的武力（如推开虚掩的门），但本题的关键不在于他是否“打算”打破窗户，而在于打破窗户发生在“离开”时，而非“进入”时。
选项 C (打破窗户逃跑)：
这恰恰解释了为什么他无罪。为了逃跑 (escape) 而打破窗户属于 Breaking Out，普通法不承认这是 Burglary 的构成要件。
选项 D (进入时的盗窃意图)：
这是一个常见的陷阱。虽然被告确实有 Mens Rea (犯罪意图)，即进入时想偷东西，但 Burglary 是由多个要素组成的。仅仅有“意图”是不够的，必须同时满足“破门” (Breaking) 这一行为要素 (Actus Reus)。因为他是合法进入的，所以没有 Breaking。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧：

务必注意题目中强调的是 "Common Law Jurisdiction" (普通法管辖区) 还是 "Modern Statute" (现代成文法)。

  • 如果是 Common Law：Breaking Out 通常不算 Burglary。
  • 如果是 Modern Statute：许多现代法律已经修改了规则，规定非法滞留 (remaining unlawfully) 或为了逃跑而破门 (breaking out) 可能构成 Burglary。
本题明确规定是 Common Law，因此必须严格适用“破门进入”的规则。

questions.question:
A skilled calligrapher crafted a letter on very old paper. She included details that would lead knowledgeable readers to believe the letter had been written by Thomas Jefferson to a friend. The calligrapher, who had a facsimile of Jefferson's autograph, made the signature and other writing on the letter resemble Jefferson's. She knew that the letter would attract the attention of local collectors.
When it did and she was contacted about selling it, she said that it had come into her hands from a foreign collector who wished anonymity, and that she could make no promises about its authenticity. As she had hoped, a collector paid her $5,000 for the letter. Later the collector discovered the letter was not authentic, and handwriting analysis established that the calligrapher had written the letter.
In a jurisdiction that follows the common law definition of forgery, which crime(s) has the calligrapher committed?

choices.a: Both forgery and false pretenses.
choices.b: Forgery, because she created a false document with the intent to defraud, but not false pretenses, since she made no representation as to the authenticity of the document.
choices.c: Not forgery, because the document had no apparent legal significance, but false pretenses, since she misrepresented the source of the document.
choices.d: Not forgery, because the document had no apparent legal significance, and not false pretenses, since she made no representation as to the authenticity of the document.

一位技艺精湛的书法家在一张非常古老的纸上制作了一封信。她在信中加入了一些细节，足以让有见识的读者相信这封信是 Thomas Jefferson 写给一位朋友的。这位书法家拥有一份 Jefferson 亲笔签名的摹本，她将信上的签名和其他字迹模仿得与 Jefferson 的笔迹相似。她知道这封信会吸引当地收藏家的注意。

当这封信确实引起了注意，并且有人联系她购买时，她说这封信是从一位希望匿名的外国收藏家手中得到的，并且她无法对其真实性做出任何承诺。正如她所希望的，一位收藏家为这封信支付了5000美元。后来，这位收藏家发现这封信并非真品，并且笔迹分析证实这封信是那位书法家写的。

在一个遵循普通法中伪造罪定义的司法管辖区，该书法家犯了什么罪？
options:
A. Both forgery and false pretenses.
伪造罪和诈欺罪。

B. Forgery, because she created a false document with the intent to defraud, but not false pretenses, since she made no representation as to the authenticity of the document.
构成伪造罪，因为她以欺诈为目的制作了一份虚假文件；但不构成诈欺罪，因为她没有对文件的真实性做出任何陈述。

C. Not forgery, because the document had no apparent legal significance, but false pretenses, since she misrepresented the source of the document.
不构成伪造罪，因为该文件没有明显的法律意义；但构成诈欺罪，因为她对文件的来源作了失实陈述。

D. Not forgery, because the document had no apparent legal significance, and not false pretenses, since she made no representation as to the authenticity of the document.
不构成伪造罪，因为该文件没有明显的法律意义；也不构成诈欺罪，因为她没有对文件的真实性做出任何陈述。
data.explanation:
At common law (and in most jurisdictions), forgery occurs when a person:

makes (ie, creates or alters) a false document of apparent legal significance with the intent to defraud.

Documents of legal significance include checks, letters of recommendation, wills, diplomas, and other instruments that can effectuate one's intent to defraud. But such documents must have value beyond their own existence. Therefore, forgery cannot stem from instruments of mere social significance like historical documents (as seen here) and artwork (Choices A & B).

However, a person who makes a false instrument of social significance can be liable for false pretenses if he/she:
  • knowingly misrepresented a past or existing material fact
  • did so with the specific intent to defraud and
  • thereby obtained title to another's property or money.
Here, the calligrapher intentionally crafted a letter that appeared to be written and signed by Thomas Jefferson. Although she made no representations regarding the letter's authenticity, she did misrepresent the letter's source by claiming that it had come into her hands from a foreign collector. And since that misrepresentation caused a local collector to buy the letter, the calligrapher committed the crime of false pretenses (Choices B & D).

Educational objective: Forgery requires the making of a false document of apparent legal significance (eg, check, will). But a person who makes a false instrument of social significance (eg, historical document, artwork) can be liable for false pretenses.



选项正确率统计：A选项 27%，B选项 21%，C选项 38%（正确选项），D选项 12%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

在普通法中（以及在大多数司法管辖区），当一个人：

制作（即，创作或篡改）一份具有明显法律意义的虚假文件，并意图欺诈时，即构成伪造罪。

具有法律意义的文件包括支票、推荐信、遗嘱、文凭以及其他可以实现欺诈意图的文书。但此类文件必须具有超越其自身存在的价值。因此，伪造罪不能源于仅具有社会意义的文书，如历史文件（如本案所示）和艺术品（选项 A 和 B）。

然而，如果一个人制作了一份具有社会意义的虚假文书，并在以下情况下，可能要承担诈欺罪的责任：
  • 明知故犯地对过去或现存的重大事实作出失实陈述
  • 其行为具有特定的欺诈意图并且
  • 因此获得了他人财产或金钱的所有权。
在本案中，书法家故意制作了一封看起来由 Thomas Jefferson 书写和签署的信件。尽管她没有就信件的真实性作出任何陈述，但她声称信件来自一位外国收藏家，从而对信件的来源作了失实陈述。由于这一失实陈述导致一名本地收藏家购买了这封信，因此该书法家构成了诈欺罪（选项 B 和 D）。

教学目标：伪造罪要求制作具有明显法律意义的虚假文件（例如，支票、遗嘱）。但是，制作具有社会意义的虚假文书（例如，历史文件、艺术品）的人可能要承担诈欺罪的责任。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 刑法考点解析

Forgery vs. False Pretenses

正确答案：C Key Point

结论：不构成伪造罪 (Forgery)，但构成诈欺罪 (False Pretenses)。

本题的核心在于区分“伪造文件”的法律定义与“虚假陈述”的行为特征。

考点一：伪造罪的局限性 Forgery

在普通法 (Common Law) 下，伪造罪的定义非常严格：

定义 (Definition) 制作或篡改一份具有明显法律意义 (Apparent Legal Significance) 的虚假书面文件，并意图欺诈。

为什么本案不构成伪造罪？

  • 法律意义 (Legal Significance)：这是伪造罪的关键要素。文件必须能够确立或改变法律上的权利或义务。
    Examples: Checks, Wills, Deeds, Contracts.
  • 历史文件的特殊性：虽然 Thomas Jefferson 的信件具有极高的金钱价值 (Monetary Value)，但它本身并不创设法律权利（如债务、产权转让等）。它只是一件具有历史或社会意义的物品。
  • 因此，伪造历史文献、画作等艺术品，通常不满足普通法下“伪造罪”中关于“法律效力”的要求。
考点二：诈欺罪的构成 False Pretenses

诈欺罪 (False Pretenses) 关注的是通过谎言获取财产所有权。

构成要件 (Elements)
  1. 获得他人财产的所有权 (Obtaining title);
  2. 通过故意虚构过去或现存的重大事实 (Material Fact);
  3. 具有欺诈意图 (Intent to defraud)。

为什么本案构成诈欺罪？

  • 虚假陈述 (Misrepresentation)：虽然被告对“真实性”免责（说无法承诺真伪），但她编造了一个谎言：“信件来自一位希望匿名的外国收藏家”。
  • 重大事实 (Material Fact)：这个关于来源 (Provenance) 的谎言是一个关于“过去或现存事实”的陈述。在古董交易中，来源往往是判断真伪的重要依据。
  • 因果关系 (Causation)：这个谎言诱导了买家支付 $5,000。如果她没有撒谎说来自外国收藏家，买家可能不会购买。
常见误区与陷阱 Trap

误区 1：只要是假的签名就是伪造罪。

❌ 错误。必须看文件性质。如果我在餐巾纸上签了“毕加索”的名字卖给你，这是诈欺，不是伪造文件罪，因为餐巾纸没有法律效力。

误区 2：她说了“不保证真伪”，所以没有欺诈。

❌ 错误。这就是本题最狡猾的地方。虽然她免除了对“真伪”的陈述，但她对“来源”撒了谎。只要有一个重大的虚假事实陈述导致受害人处分财产，就构成 False Pretenses。

MBE 解题锦囊

遇到涉及假冒文件的问题时，请按以下步骤思考：

  1. 检查文件类型：是支票、合同、遗嘱吗？
    👉 是 ➔ 考虑 Forgery。
    👉 是画作、古董信件、历史文物？ ➔ 排除 Forgery。
  2. 检查被告言论：是否有具体的谎言（来源、材质、鉴定结果）？
    👉 是 ➔ 考虑 False Pretenses。

questions.question:
In a crowded football stadium, a man saw a wallet fall out of a spectator's purse. The man picked up the wallet and found that it contained $100 in cash. Thinking that he could use the money and seeing no one watching, the man put the wallet in the pocket of his coat. Just then, the spectator approached the man and asked if he had seen a missing wallet. The man said no and went home with the wallet.
Of what crime, if any, is the man guilty?

choices.a: Embezzlement.
choices.b: False pretenses.
choices.c: Larceny.
choices.d: No crime.

data.questionStem:
Q84095

In a crowded football stadium, a man saw a wallet fall out of a spectator's purse. The man picked up the wallet and found that it contained $100 in cash. Thinking that he could use the money and seeing no one watching, the man put the wallet in the pocket of his coat. Just then, the spectator approached the man and asked if he had seen a missing wallet. The man said no and went home with the wallet.

Of what crime, if any, is the man guilty?

在一个拥挤的足球场，一名男子看到一个钱包从一名观众的手提包里掉了出来。该男子捡起钱包，发现里面有100美元现金。考虑到他可以用这笔钱，并且看到没人注意，该男子将钱包放进了自己外套的口袋里。就在那时，该观众走近该男子，问他是否看到了一个丢失的钱包。该男子说没有，并带着钱包回了家。

如果构成犯罪，该男子犯了什么罪？
options:
A. Embezzlement.
侵占罪 (Embezzlement)。

B. False pretenses.
诈欺罪 (False pretenses)。

C. Larceny.
盗窃罪 (Larceny)。

D. No crime.
未构成犯罪。
data.explanation:
Common property offenses


CrimeElements
Larceny
  • Unlawful taking & carrying away of another's personal property
  • Specific intent to permanently deprive the owner of the property
Larceny by trick
  • Obtaining possession of another's personal property
  • By knowing false representation of past/present material fact
  • Specific intent to permanently deprive the owner of the property
Embezzlement
  • Fraudulent conversion of another's property
  • While in lawful possession of the property
  • Specific intent to defraud the owner of the property
False pretenses
  • Obtaining title to another's property
  • By knowing false representation of past/present material fact
  • Specific intent to defraud the owner of the property
Robbery
  • Unlawful taking & carrying away of another's personal property
  • By use or threat of force
  • Specific intent to permanently deprive the owner of the property
Receiving stolen property
  • Taking possession or exercising control over stolen personal property
  • Knowing the property was stolen
  • Specific intent to permanently deprive the owner of the property
Trespass
  • Entry of a structure
  • Without permission or legal necessity
Burglary
  • Unlawful (ie, trespassory) entry of a structure
  • Specific intent to commit a crime therein
A person who finds lost or misplaced personal property is guilty of larceny if he/she:
  • knows the identity of the owner or has reason to believe that he/she can determine it
  • takes and carries away the property - ie, exercises control over and moves it and
  • possesses the specific intent to permanently deprive the owner of the property.
Here, the man saw the spectator's wallet fall out of her purse (knowledge of owner's identity). He picked up the wallet (taking and carrying away), noticed that it contained $100, and decided to keep it (specific intent to permanently deprive). Therefore, the man is guilty of larceny (Choice C).

(Choice A) Embezzlement occurs when a person in lawful possession of another's property fraudulently converts it. A person lawfully possesses another's property if the owner gave the person permission to possess or control it - eg, an owner entrusts a car to a friend. Since the man picked up the wallet without the spectator's permission (no lawful possession), he is not guilty of embezzlement.

(Choice B) Property is acquired by false pretenses when the defendant (1) obtains title (ie, legal ownership) to property (2) by knowingly making a false representation of a past or present material fact (3) with the specific intent to defraud the owner. Although the man knowingly lied to the spectator about her missing wallet, he merely obtained possession (not title) to the wallet. Therefore, he is not guilty of false pretenses.

Educational objective: A person who finds lost or misplaced property is guilty of larceny if he/she (1) knows the identity of the owner or has reason to believe he/she can determine it, (2) takes and carries away the property, and (3) specifically intends to permanently deprive the owner of it.

选项正确率统计：A选项 4%，B选项 3%，C选项 81%（正确选项），D选项 10%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

常见的财产犯罪


罪名构成要件
盗窃罪 (Larceny)
  • 非法占有并带离他人动产
  • 具有永久剥夺物主财产的特定意图
诈骗性盗窃 (Larceny by trick)
  • 取得他人动产的占有权
  • 通过明知虚假的对过去/现在重大事实的陈述
  • 具有永久剥夺物主财产的特定意图
侵占罪 (Embezzlement)
  • 欺诈性地转换他人财产
  • 在合法占有该财产期间
  • 具有欺骗物主财产的特定意图
诈欺罪 (False pretenses)
  • 取得他人财产的所有权
  • 通过明知虚假的对过去/现在重大事实的陈述
  • 具有欺骗物主财产的特定意图
抢劫罪 (Robbery)
  • 非法占有并带离他人动产
  • 通过使用武力或以武力相威胁
  • 具有永久剥夺物主财产的特定意图
收受赃物罪 (Receiving stolen property)
  • 占有或控制被盗动产
  • 明知该财产系被盗
  • 具有永久剥夺物主财产的特定意图
非法侵入 (Trespass)
  • 进入一个建筑物
  • 未经许可或无法律必要
入室犯法罪 (Burglary)
  • 非法（即侵入性）进入一个建筑物
  • 具有在其中犯罪的特定意图
拾得遗失或错置动产者，如果其构成盗窃罪 (larceny)，须满足以下条件：
  • 知道物主的身份或有理由相信可以确定其身份
  • 占有并带离该财产——即，对其进行控制并移动并且
  • 具有永久剥夺物主财产的特定意图。
在本案中，该男子看到观众的钱包从其手提包里掉出来（知道物主的身份）。他捡起钱包（占有并带离），注意到里面有100美元，并决定将其据为己有（具有永久剥夺的特定意图）。因此，该男子构成盗窃罪 (larceny) （选项 C）。

（选项 A）侵占罪 (Embezzlement) 指合法占有他人财产的人欺诈性地转换该财产。如果物主允许某人占有或控制其财产（例如，物主将汽车委托给朋友），则该人合法占有该财产。由于该男子未经观众许可捡起钱包（不属于合法占有），因此他不构成侵占罪。

（选项 B）诈欺罪 (False pretenses) 指被告(1)通过(2)明知是虚假的对过去或现在重大事实的陈述，(3)以欺骗物主的特定意图，从而(1)获得财产的所有权（即法定所有权）。尽管该男子就丢失的钱包向观众故意撒谎，但他仅仅获得了钱包的占有权（而非所有权）。因此，他不构成诈欺罪。

教学目标：拾得遗失或错置财物者，若(1)知道物主的身份或有理由相信可以确定其身份，(2)占有并带离该财物，且(3)具有永久剥夺物主财物的特定意图，则构成盗窃罪 (larceny)。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Criminal Law: Larceny of Lost Property
正确答案：C (Larceny)
核心考点：拾得遗失物的盗窃罪认定 在普通法下，拾得遗失物 (Lost Property) 或错置物 (Misplaced Property) 构成 Larceny (盗窃罪) 必须同时满足两个条件：
  1. 占有时即有犯意： 在捡起财物的那一刻，就具有永久剥夺物主财产的意图 (Intent to permanently deprive)。
  2. 知晓物主： 知道物主是谁，或者有理由相信可以找到物主。

本案逻辑推演：

1
财产状态： 钱包从手提包掉落，属于 Misplaced Property (错置物)，而非无主物。法律上，物主仍保有“推定占有” (Constructive Possession)。
2
知晓物主： 男子亲眼看到钱包从观众包里掉出来，因此他明确知道物主是谁。
3
犯意与行为的同时性 (Concurrence)： 题目明确指出他在捡起钱包时“想着可以用这笔钱” (Thinking that he could use the money)。这证明他在取得占有的瞬间就有了盗窃的意图。

结论：未经同意拿走他人财物（Trespassory taking），且在拿走时就有永久剥夺的意图，完全符合 Larceny 的构成要件。

为什么不是其他罪名？
罪名 关键区别
Embezzlement
(侵占罪)		 需要被告先合法占有 (Lawful Possession) 财物（如员工、受托人）。本案中男子捡钱包未经许可，起手就是非法占有。
False Pretenses
(诈欺罪)		 需要通过欺骗获得所有权 (Title)。本案中男子只是捡起钱包获得了占有权 (Possession)，且捡起的行为本身不是通过欺骗完成的（撒谎发生在捡起之后）。
💡 MBE 考试技巧：
在处理“捡到东西”这类题目时，关键看时间点：
  • 如果在捡起时打算归还，后来才决定据为己有 ➡️ 不构成 Larceny（因为缺乏 Concurrence，即行为与犯意不同时）。
  • 如果在捡起时就打算据为己有，且知道物主是谁 ➡️ 构成 Larceny。

questions.question:
A man told his neighbor that he was going away for two weeks and asked the neighbor to keep an eye on his house. The neighbor agreed. The man gave the neighbor a key to use to check on the house. The neighbor decided to have a party in the man's house. He invited a number of friends. One friend went into the man's bedroom, took some of the man's rings, and put them in his pocket.
Which of the following is true?

choices.a: The neighbor and the friend are guilty of burglary.
choices.b: The neighbor is guilty of burglary and the friend is guilty of larceny.
choices.c: The neighbor is guilty of trespass and the friend is guilty of larceny.
choices.d: The friend is guilty of larceny and the neighbor is not guilty of any crime.

data.questionStem:
Q84126

A man told his neighbor that he was going away for two weeks and asked the neighbor to keep an eye on his house. The neighbor agreed. The man gave the neighbor a key to use to check on the house. The neighbor decided to have a party in the man's house. He invited a number of friends. One friend went into the man's bedroom, took some of the man's rings, and put them in his pocket.

Which of the following is true?

一名男子告诉他的邻居，他要外出两周，并请邻居帮忙照看他的房子。邻居同意了。该男子给了邻居一把钥匙，以便检查房子。邻居决定在该男子的房子里举办一个派对。他邀请了许多朋友。其中一个朋友进入了该男子的卧室，拿走了该男子的一些戒指，并放进了自己的口袋里。

下列哪项陈述是正确的？
options:
A. The neighbor and the friend are guilty of burglary.
邻居和朋友均构成入室犯法罪（burglary）。

B. The neighbor is guilty of burglary and the friend is guilty of larceny.
邻居构成入室犯法罪（burglary），朋友构成盗窃罪（larceny）。

C. The neighbor is guilty of trespass and the friend is guilty of larceny.
邻居构成非法侵入（trespass），朋友构成盗窃罪（larceny）。

D. The friend is guilty of larceny and the neighbor is not guilty of any crime.
朋友构成盗窃罪（larceny），而邻居不构成任何犯罪。
data.explanation:
Trespass is the unlawful entry of a structure - ie, an entry that occurs without legal necessity or the possessor's permission. And a permissible entry can become unlawful if the entering person exceeds the scope of permission - eg, receiving permission to wait in a lobby but exploring an office.

1. Two Situations of "Exceeding the Scope of Consent"
This concept is most clearly applied in criminal law in the following situations:
  • Spatial Limitation: This is the most classic example. If the owner says, "You can use the living room, but you are not allowed in my bedroom," then when the neighbor enters the bedroom, they have exceeded the spatial scope of the consent. At that point, their entry into the bedroom becomes an "unlawful entry."
  • Temporal Limitation: If the owner says, "You can come in to check on the house during the daytime," but the neighbor enters in the middle of the night, they have also exceeded the temporal scope of the consent.
2. The Issue in This Case: Exceeding the Scope of Activity, Not Entry
In this case, the permission given by the owner was very broad and vague: "keep an eye on his house." He did not impose any explicit spatial or temporal restrictions. The neighbor's error was engaging in an unpermitted activity (hosting a party) within a space he was permitted to enter.

Criminal law is very cautious about this. The law generally does not retroactively change an initial "lawful entry" into an "unlawful entry" simply because a person engaged in improper activities after lawfully entering a place. The law is concerned with the "right of entry" (Did the neighbor have the right to enter the house? Yes.), not the "right of activity" (Did the owner permit him to have a party inside? No.). The latter is more of a civil issue (eg, a breach of trust), not a criminal one that would make his entry unlawful.

Here, the man gave the neighbor permission to enter by asking the neighbor to watch the man's house and giving the neighbor a key. And since the man did not restrict the neighbor's use of or access to the house in a way that the neighbor's entry itself became unlawful, the neighbor did not exceed the scope of the man's permission by having a party. Therefore, the neighbor is not guilty of trespass (Choice C).

Burglary is the trespassory entry of a structure with the intent to commit any crime therein. Since the neighbor's entry was permissible (not trespassory) and there is no indication that he intended to commit a crime inside, he is not guilty of burglary (Choices A & B). The friend's entry was also permissible since the neighbor (the possessor) invited him in. Therefore, the friend is not guilty of burglary (Choice A).

Larceny is:
  • the unlawful taking and carrying away of another's personal property; and
  • the intent to permanently deprive the owner of that property.
Here, the neighbor did not take any of the man's property (no larceny). But the friend took the man's rings (taking) and put them in his pocket (carrying away) to presumably keep them (intent to permanently deprive). Therefore, the friend is guilty of larceny.

Educational objective: Trespass is the unlawful entry of a structure - ie, an entry without legal necessity or permission. Trespass rises to burglary if the person enters the structure with the intent to commit any crime therein. And larceny is the unlawful taking and carrying away of another's personal property with the intent to permanently deprive the owner thereof.

选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 0%，C选项 42%，D选项 55%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

非法侵入（Trespass）是指对建筑物的非法进入——即在没有法律必要性或占有人许可的情况下进入。并且，如果进入者超出了许可的范围，那么原本经许可的进入也可能变为非法——例如，获得在大厅等候的许可，但却察看了办公室。

1.“超出许可范围” (Exceeding the Scope of Consent) 的两种情况
在刑法上，这个概念通常在以下两种情况中适用得最为明确：
  • 空间上的超越 (Spatial Limitation): 这是最典型的例子。如果主人说：“你可以进来用客厅，但不准进我的卧室。” 那么，当邻居进入卧室时，他就超出了许可的空间范围，此时他对卧室的进入就变成了“非法进入”。
  • 时间上的超越 (Temporal Limitation): 如果主人说：“你可以在白天进来检查。” 而邻居在半夜闯入，他也超出了许可的时间范围。
2. 本案中的问题：是“活动”超越，而非“进入”超越
在本案中，主人给出的许可是非常宽泛和模糊的：“照看我的房子”。他并没有施加任何明确的空间或时间限制。邻居的错误在于，他在一个被许可进入的空间里，从事了一项未经许可的活动（开派对）。

刑法对此非常谨慎。法律通常不会仅仅因为某人在合法进入一个场所后从事了不当的活动，就追溯性地将他最初的“合法进入”变为“非法进入”。法律关注的是“进入权”：邻居是否拥有进入房子的权利？有。而不是“活动权”：主人是否允许他在里面开派对？没有。但这更多地是一个民事上的违约或侵权问题（比如，如果派对损坏了家具，主人可以起诉邻居要求赔偿），而不是一个让他构成非法侵入罪的刑事问题。

在本案中，该男子通过请求邻居照看其房屋并给予邻居一把钥匙，从而许可了邻居的进入。并且，由于该男子并未限制邻居对房屋的使用或进入，邻居举办派对的行为没有超出该男子许可的范围。因此，邻居不构成非法侵入（trespass）（选项C）。

入室犯法罪（Burglary）是指侵入性地进入一个建筑物，并意图在其中实施任何犯罪。由于邻居的进入是经过许可的（非侵入性的），且没有迹象表明他意图在室内犯罪，因此他不构成入室犯法罪（burglary）（选项A和B）。朋友的进入也是经过许可的，因为邻居（作为占有人）邀请了他。因此，朋友不构成入室犯法罪（burglary）（选项A）。

盗窃罪（Larceny）的构成要件是：
  • 非法占有并转移他人的个人财产；并且
  • 具有意图永久剥夺物主对该财产的所有权。
在本案中，邻居没有拿走该男子的任何财产（不构成盗窃罪）。但是，朋友拿走了该男子的戒指（占有）并将其放入自己的口袋（转移），可以推断其意图是永久占有这些戒指（意图永久剥夺所有权）。因此，朋友构成盗窃罪（larceny）。

教学目标：非法侵入（Trespass）是指对建筑物的非法进入——即在没有法律必要性或许可的情况下进入。如果行为人进入建筑物时意图在其中实施任何犯罪，则非法侵入（Trespass）升级为入室犯法罪（burglary）。而盗窃罪（larceny）是指非法占有并转移他人的个人财产，并意图永久剥夺物主对该财产的所有权。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 刑法考点解析

Burglary & Larceny
正确答案：D

朋友构成盗窃罪 (Larceny)，而邻居不构成任何犯罪。

本题考察的核心在于区分刑事责任与民事责任的界限，特别是关于“许可范围”(Scope of Consent) 的认定。

1. 邻居为何无罪？ Scope of Consent

邻居的行为虽然不道德甚至违约，但在刑法上不构成犯罪。

  • 关于非法侵入 (Trespass)：
    非法侵入要求“非法进入” (Unlawful Entry)。邻居持有钥匙并获得了主人的许可进入房子。
    关键点：虽然主人没有许可“开派对”，但许可了“照看房子”。在刑法中，除非有明确的空间限制（如“不准进卧室”）或时间限制（如“只能白天来”），否则仅仅从事未经许可的活动（Activity），通常不会让最初的合法进入变成非法侵入。
  • 关于入室犯法罪 (Burglary)：
    Burglary = Trespassory Entry + Intent to commit a crime.
    既然邻居的进入是合法的（非 Trespassory），Burglary 的第一个要素就不成立。此外，他进入是为了开派对，而非实施重罪或盗窃。
2. 朋友为何构成盗窃？ Larceny

朋友的行为完全符合普通法盗窃罪 (Larceny) 的所有构成要件：

  • 非法拿取 (Trespassory Taking)： 未经同意控制了戒指。
  • 转移 (Carrying Away / Asportation)： 将戒指放入自己的口袋。哪怕移动距离很短，只要发生了位移即可。
  • 意图 (Intent)： 意图永久剥夺 (Permanently Deprive) 主人的财产。

注意：朋友不构成 Burglary。因为他是被邻居（当时的房屋实际控制者）邀请进来的，进入本身合法。且没有证据表明他在进入房子的一瞬间就有了盗窃的意图。

💡MBE 实战技巧

在处理涉及“许可” (Consent) 的题目时，请务必区分：

  1. 进入权 (Right of Entry)： 是否有权进门？
  2. 活动权 (Right of Activity)： 进门后做了什么？

如果拥有广泛的进入权（如本题中的“照看房子”），仅仅是做了主人不喜欢的事（开派对），通常属于民事违约或民事侵权，而不会追溯性地使进入行为变成刑事上的“非法侵入”。

questions.question:
A woman's ex-husband was getting remarried. The woman believed that he was making a mistake and that she needed to stop him. On the day of his wedding, held outdoors at a park, the woman hid behind some bushes she knew her ex-husband would have to pass before entering the area where the ceremony would take place. When her ex-husband was a few feet away, the woman got his attention and told him to come behind the bushes to talk. When he resisted, the woman pulled out a gun and the husband reluctantly walked around the bushes to talk to her. The woman then proceeded to tell him that he could not get married. Once the ex-husband was able to convince the woman that he would not get married, he was able to leave and notified the police. The woman was subsequently arrested and charged with kidnapping.
Is the woman guilty of kidnapping?

choices.a: No, because the ex-husband was not actually confined.
choices.b: No, because the ex-husband was only forced to move a few feet.
choices.c: Yes, because the woman forced the ex-husband to go behind the bushes.
choices.d: Yes, because the woman prevented the ex-husband from entering the area where the ceremony would take place.

data.questionStem:
Q84125

A woman's ex-husband was getting remarried. The woman believed that he was making a mistake and that she needed to stop him. On the day of his wedding, held outdoors at a park, the woman hid behind some bushes she knew her ex-husband would have to pass before entering the area where the ceremony would take place. When her ex-husband was a few feet away, the woman got his attention and told him to come behind the bushes to talk. When he resisted, the woman pulled out a gun and the husband reluctantly walked around the bushes to talk to her. The woman then proceeded to tell him that he could not get married. Once the ex-husband was able to convince the woman that he would not get married, he was able to leave and notified the police. The woman was subsequently arrested and charged with kidnapping.

Is the woman guilty of kidnapping?

一名女子的前夫即将再婚。该女子认为他正在犯一个错误，自己需要阻止他。在他于公园举行的户外婚礼当天，该女子躲在一处灌木丛后面，她知道前夫在进入仪式区之前必须经过那里。当她的前夫走到几英尺外时，该女子引起了他的注意，并叫他到灌木丛后面谈话。当他抗拒时，该女子掏出了一把枪，其前夫不情愿地绕到灌木丛后面与她交谈。该女子接着告诉他不能结婚。在其前夫说服该女子自己不会结婚后，他才得以离开并通知了警方。该女子随后被逮捕，并被控以绑架罪。

该女子是否构成绑架罪？
options:
A. No, because the ex-husband was not actually confined.
不构成，因为其前夫实际上并未被监禁。

B. No, because the ex-husband was only forced to move a few feet.
不构成，因为其前夫仅被强迫移动了几英尺的距离。

C. Yes, because the woman forced the ex-husband to go behind the bushes.
构成，因为该女子强迫其前夫走到了灌木丛后面。

D. Yes, because the woman prevented the ex-husband from entering the area where the ceremony would take place.
构成，因为该女子阻止了其前夫进入举行仪式的区域。
data.explanation:
Kidnapping


Common lawForcibly abducting or stealing person from his/her own country & sending to another country
MPCUnlawfully moving or confining another to:
  • hold for ransom or as hostage
  • facilitate commission of felony or flight thereafter
  • injure/terrorize victim or another or
  • interfere with governmental/political function
Modern view
  • General
    Intentional & unlawful confinement involving:
    • some movement (asportation) or concealment
  • Aggravated
    General kidnapping committed for:
    • ransom
    • commission of other crime
    • offensive purpose or
    • child stealing
MPC = Model Penal Code.

Under the modern view, kidnapping is: the intentional† and unlawful confinement of another against that person's will (eg, by force, threat, or fraud) coupled with either moving or hiding that person.

Confinement occurs when the victim's freedom of movement is significantly restricted. It is not enough that the victim is prevented from taking a path or entering an area; the victim must be prevented from leaving an area or compelled to go somewhere the victim does not want to go. Additionally, the victim need only be moved a short distance to satisfy the movement requirement.

Here, the ex-husband was intentionally confined when the woman threatened him with a gun to compel him to come behind the bushes against his will (Choice A). And since the man was forced to walk a few feet, the movement requirement was also satisfied (Choice B). Therefore, the woman is guilty of kidnapping.

†General intent crimes such as kidnapping require only the intent to perform an act that is unlawful.

(Choice D) The man was confined because he was forced to go someplace he did not want to go - behind the bushes. Merely preventing a victim from taking a path or entering an area does not constitute confinement.

Educational objective: Under the modern view, kidnapping is the unlawful and intentional confinement of another against that person's will, coupled with the movement or hiding of that person. To satisfy the movement requirement, the victim need only be moved a short distance.

选项正确率统计：A选项 20%，B选项 8%，C选项 67%（正确选项），D选项 4%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

绑架罪


普通法强行劫持或窃取某人，将其从本国送往他国
MPC为达到以下目的而非法移动或监禁他人：
  • 为获取赎金或作为人质
  • 为协助实施重罪或事后逃逸
  • 伤害/恐吓受害人或他人 或
  • 干涉政府/政治职能
现代观点
  • 一般绑架罪
    故意和非法的监禁，且涉及：
    • 某种移动（转移） 或 藏匿
  • 加重绑架罪
    为以下目的而实施的一般绑架罪：
    • 获取赎金
    • 实施其他犯罪
    • 攻击性目的 或
    • 盗窃儿童
MPC = 《模范刑法典》(Model Penal Code)。

根据现代观点，绑架罪是指：违背他人意愿（例如，通过武力、威胁或欺诈），对其进行故意†且非法的监禁，并伴随移动或藏匿该人的行为。

当受害者的行动自由受到显著限制时，即构成监禁。仅仅阻止受害者走某条路或进入某个区域是不够的；必须是阻止受害者离开某个区域，或强迫其去往不想去的地方。此外，只需将受害者移动一小段距离即可满足移动要件。

在本案中，当该女子用枪威胁前夫，违背其意愿强迫他走到灌木丛后面时，他被故意监禁了（选项A）。而且，由于该男子被迫行走了几英尺，移动的要件也已满足（选项B）。因此，该女子构成绑架罪。

†诸如绑架罪的一般意图犯罪，仅要求行为人具有实施非法行为的意图。

（选项D）该男子被监禁是因为他被迫去了一个他不想去的地方——灌木丛后面。仅仅阻止受害者走某条路或进入某个区域并不构成监禁。

教学目的：根据现代观点，绑架罪是指违背他人意愿，对其进行非法和故意的监禁，并伴有移动或藏匿该人的行为。为满足移动要件，只需将受害者移动一小段距离即可。

References

Charles E. Torcia, 3 Wharton's Criminal Law § 207 (15th ed. 2020) (discussing kidnapping requirements).

MBE 考点解析

Criminal Law / Kidnapping
现代绑架罪 (Modern Kidnapping)

根据现代刑法观点，绑架罪通常包含两个核心要素：

  1. 非法监禁 (Unlawful Confinement)：违背受害者意愿限制其自由。
  2. 移动或藏匿 (Movement/Asportation or Concealment)：将受害者移动一段距离或将其隐藏。
本案逻辑推演

本题考察的是对“移动” (Asportation) 这一要素的认定标准。

✔
监禁要素满足：
女子掏枪威胁 (Threat of force)，迫使前夫违背意愿行动，这构成了非法监禁。
✔
移动要素满足：
虽然前夫只被强迫走了“几英尺” (a few feet) 到灌木丛后面，但在法律上，距离的长短不是决定性因素。只要存在非自愿的移动（哪怕距离很短），即满足绑架罪的构成要件。

因此，选项 C 是正确的。女子强迫前夫移动到了灌木丛后面，完成了绑架罪所需的行为。

为什么其他选项是错的？
✖
选项 A (未被监禁)：
错误。前夫被枪指着，无法自由离开，这显然构成了监禁。
✖
选项 B (距离太短)：
这是本题最大的干扰项。MBE 经常测试这一点：“移动”不需要长距离 (Movement need not be substantial)。只要受害者被从一个地方移动到另一个地方（例如从房间这头到那头，或从路边到灌木丛后），就足以构成绑架。
✖
选项 D (阻止进入区域)：
仅仅阻止某人去某个地方（例如挡住路）通常只构成非法拘禁 (False Imprisonment) 或甚至不构成犯罪（如果受害者可以转身离开）。绑架罪的关键在于强迫受害者移动到特定地点，而不是单纯的阻挡。
🎓 MBE 提分技巧 在处理绑架罪 (Kidnapping) 问题时，注意区分它与非法拘禁 (False Imprisonment)。

如果题目中出现了“移动” (Movement) 或 “藏匿” (Concealment)，哪怕只是从客厅移动到卧室，或者移动了几米，都要警惕这可能已经升级为绑架罪，而不仅仅是非法拘禁。

data.questionStem:
Q84114

At a defendant's robbery trial, the state called the victim to testify that the defendant pointed a gun at him before grabbing his briefcase and running away. The state then called a bystander who testified that she saw the defendant take the victim's briefcase but saw no gun.

For which of the following offense(s) could the jury properly return a verdict of guilty?

在一名被告的抢劫罪审判中，控方传唤受害人作证，称被告在抢走其公文包并逃跑前，曾用枪指着他。随后，控方又传唤了一名旁观者，该旁观者作证称，她看到被告拿走了受害人的公文包，但没有看到枪支。

对于下列哪项罪行，陪审团可以恰当地作出有罪裁决？
options:
A. Larceny only.
仅构成Larceny (盗窃罪)。

B. Robbery only.
仅构成Robbery (抢劫罪)。

C. Either larceny or robbery.
构成Larceny (盗窃罪) 或 Robbery (抢劫罪)。

D. Both larceny and robbery.
同时构成Larceny (盗窃罪) 和 Robbery (抢劫罪)。
data.explanation:
Larceny is
  • the unlawful taking and carrying away of another's personal property
  • with the specific intent to permanently deprive the victim of that property.
It escalates to robbery when property is taken from the victim's person or presence by force or intimidation. As a result, larceny is necessarily committed during a robbery - making it a lesser included offense of robbery. And since larceny (lesser offense) merges into robbery (greater offense) once the robbery is completed, a defendant can only be convicted of larceny or robbery (Choice D).

Here, the defendant was tried for robbery. The victim and bystander testified that the defendant took the victim's briefcase and ran off with it. Though the victim also testified that the defendant pointed a gun at him (robbery), the bystander testified that she did not see a gun (larceny). Since the jury can choose whom to believe, it can return a guilty verdict for either crime - but not both (Choices A & B).

Educational objective: Larceny is
  • the unlawful taking and carrying away of another's personal property
  • with the specific intent to permanently deprive the victim of that property.
It merges into robbery if the property is taken from the victim's person or presence by force or intimidation. Therefore, a person can be convicted of larceny or robbery - not both.

正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

Larceny (盗窃罪) 是指
  • 非法占有并转移他人动产
  • 并具有永久剥夺受害人该财产的特定意图。
当财产是通过暴力或恐吓手段从受害人的人身或其身边取得时，该罪行升级为 Robbery (抢劫罪)。因此，在抢劫过程中必然会实施盗窃——这使其成为抢劫罪的当然包含的轻罪 (lesser included offense)。并且，一旦抢劫罪成立，Larceny (盗窃罪，轻罪) 就归并 (merges) 入 Robbery (抢劫罪，重罪)，因此被告只能被判 Larceny (盗窃罪) 或 Robbery (抢劫罪) (选项D)。

在本案中，被告因抢劫罪受审。受害人和旁观者都作证说，被告拿走了受害人的公文包并携之逃跑。尽管受害人还作证说被告用枪指着他（构成抢劫罪），但旁观者作证说她没有看到枪（构成盗窃罪）。由于陪审团可以选择相信哪一方的证词，它可以对任一罪行作出有罪裁决——但不能同时对两项罪行定罪 (选项A和B)。

教学目的：Larceny (盗窃罪) 是指
  • 非法占有并转移他人动产
  • 并具有永久剥夺受害人该财产的特定意图。
如果财产是通过暴力或恐吓手段从受害人的人身或其身边取得，则该罪行归并 (merges) 入 Robbery (抢劫罪)。因此，一个人只能被判 Larceny (盗窃罪) 或 Robbery (抢劫罪)——而不能同时被判两罪。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Robbery vs. Larceny & Merger Doctrine

核心法律概念

Larceny (盗窃) + Force/Threat (暴力/恐吓) = Robbery (抢劫)

1. 包含关系 (Lesser Included Offense):
Larceny 是 Robbery 的必然包含轻罪。你不可能在实施抢劫的同时不实施盗窃。

2. 归并原则 (Merger Doctrine):
如果被告被判犯有重罪（Robbery），轻罪（Larceny）将归并入重罪中。根据禁止双重危险原则 (Double Jeopardy)，被告不能因同一行为同时被判这两项罪名。

本案事实分析

陪审团 (Jury) 是事实的认定者，他们有权决定相信哪位证人：

情形 A
相信受害人
被告使用了枪支
↓
存在暴力/恐吓
↓
Robbery 成立
情形 B
相信旁观者
没看到枪支
↓
仅有非法拿取
↓
Larceny 成立

逻辑推导与结论

题目问的是陪审团可以 (could) 做出什么裁决。

  • 如果陪审团相信受害人，被告构成 Robbery。
  • 如果陪审团相信旁观者（认为没有使用暴力或恐吓），被告构成 Larceny。

因此，根据证据评估的不同，两种结果都有可能。

正确答案：C
Either larceny or robbery.
为什么 D (Both) 是错误的？
这是本题最大的陷阱。虽然事实层面包含了盗窃和抢劫的元素，但在法律判决层面，由于 Merger Doctrine (归并原则)，Larceny 这一轻罪会被 Robbery 这一重罪吸收。被告不能因“拿走同一个包”这一行为同时被判盗窃和抢劫。

💡 MBE 备考锦囊

遇到 "Lesser Included Offense" 类型的题目时，请记住：

  1. 事实认定权： 陪审团可以自由选择相信部分证据，从而认定轻罪（Larceny）而非重罪（Robbery）。
  2. 定罪规则： 尽管行为可能同时符合两罪的定义，但最终定罪时，轻罪会被重罪吸收 (Merge)。
  3. 排除法： 看到 "Both... and..." 的选项时要高度警惕，除非题目涉及的是两个完全独立的罪行（如 Conspiracy 和实质罪行通常不归并）。
Answer Key: C | Source: UWORLD

两名女性，一名拳击手和一名武术家，同意在一场12回合的拳击比赛中对决。赛前，裁判告诫双方选手，不得用张开的手套、攻击肚脐以下、肾脏或耳后部位。裁判进一步警告，在对手被击倒在地时进行攻击是不允许的。

在第十二回合快结束时，两位选手都已精疲力竭，拳击手用紧握的手套反复击打武术家的面部。在武术家正要倒地，且裁判未能将她们分开之前，拳击手再次击中武术家的脸部，打断了她的鼻梁。武术家随后对该拳击手提起了关于伤害罪（battery）的刑事控告。

如果该拳击手被起诉，她针对伤害罪（battery）指控的最佳抗辩理由是什么？
options:
A. The boxer did not intend to break the martial artist's nose.
拳击手无意打断武术家的鼻梁。

B. The boxer punched the martial artist in the face with a closed glove.
拳击手用紧握的手套击打了武术家的面部。

C. The martial artist consented to the battery.
武术家同意了该伤害罪（battery）。

D. The martial artist had not fallen when the boxer landed the final blow.
当拳击手施以最后一击时，武术家尚未倒地。
data.explanation:
Criminal battery is the unlawful application of force to another that results in harmful or offensive contact. A victim's consent is generally not a defense to a crime. However, consent to bodily injury or conduct that may cause bodily injury is a defense when:
  • the injury was not serious or
  • the victim and the defendant were engaged in an activity in which the defendant's conduct and the victim's resulting injury were reasonably foreseeable.
This is true regardless of whether the victim's consent was given explicitly (eg, by signed authorization) or implicitly (eg, by participating in an activity likely to result in injury).

Here, both fighters consented to conduct that may cause bodily injury when they agreed to compete and participated in a boxing match. And since boxing is an activity in which the boxer's conduct (punch) and the martial artist's resulting injury (broken nose) were reasonably foreseeable, consent is the boxer's best defense against the charge of battery.

(Choice A) The boxer may not have specifically intended to break the martial artist's nose. But this is no defense to battery since it is a general intent crime that merely requires that the criminal act (the punch) be consciously performed or criminally negligent.

(Choices B & D) The boxer did strike the martial artist with a closed (not open) glove, and the final blow was landed before the martial artist fell (not when she was on the ground). But the boxer could still be convicted of battery under these facts unless the martial artist consented to the battery.

Educational objective: A victim's consent is a defense to battery if
  • (1) the injury was not serious or
  • (2) the parties engaged in an activity in which the defendant's conduct and the victim's resulting injury were reasonably foreseeable.


选项正确率统计：A选项 2%，B选项 4%，C选项 70%（正确选项），D选项 23%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

刑事伤害罪（Criminal battery）是指对他人非法使用武力，导致伤害性或冒犯性接触。一般来说，受害者的同意不能作为犯罪的抗辩理由。然而，在以下情况下，对身体伤害的同意或对可能导致身体伤害行为的同意可构成抗辩：
  • 伤害不严重 或者
  • 受害者与被告从事的活动中，被告的行为及受害者因此受到的伤害是可合理预见的。
无论受害者的同意是明示的（例如，通过签署授权书）还是默示的（例如，通过参加可能导致伤害的活动），这一点都成立。

在本案中，两位选手在同意参加并实际参与拳击比赛时，即已同意了可能导致身体伤害的行为。并且，由于拳击是一项活动，其中拳击手的行为（拳击）和武术家因此受到的伤害（鼻梁骨折）是可合理预见的，因此同意是拳击手针对伤害罪（battery）指控的最佳抗辩理由。

(选项A) 拳击手可能没有具体意图要打断武术家的鼻梁。但这不能作为伤害罪（battery）的抗辩理由，因为它是一种一般意图犯罪，仅要求犯罪行为（拳击）是有意识地实施或构成刑事疏忽。

(选项B和D) 拳击手确实是用紧握的（而非张开的）手套击打武术家，并且最后一击是在武术家倒地之前（而非在她倒地时）击中的。但基于这些事实，拳击手仍然可能被判伤害罪（battery）成立，除非武术家同意了该伤害行为。

教学目标： 在以下情况下，受害者的同意是伤害罪（battery）的抗辩理由：
  • (1) 伤害不严重，或
  • (2) 双方参与的活动中，被告的行为及受害者因此受到的伤害是可合理预见的。

MBE 考点解析

Criminal Law: Battery & Consent

⚖️ 核心法律规则

在刑法中，受害者的同意(Consent)通常不能作为犯罪的抗辩理由。但是，存在一个重要的例外：

如果行为发生在体育竞技或社会认可的活动中，且该行为及造成的伤害是该活动中可合理预见的(Reasonably Foreseeable)，则同意可以作为殴打罪(Battery)的有效抗辩。

✅ 为什么选 C 是最佳抗辩？

本题考察的是体育竞技中的同意范围。

  • 事实认定：拳击手和武术家自愿参加拳击比赛。拳击本质上就是一项包含身体接触和潜在伤害的运动。
  • 法律适用：虽然打断鼻梁属于严重伤害，但这是拳击比赛中可预见的风险。
  • 关键细节：题目指出最后一击发生在武术家“正在倒地”且裁判“未能分开她们”之前。这意味着该攻击虽然处于规则的边缘，但仍发生在比赛进行的过程中（Heat of the moment），并未完全超出比赛所允许的暴力范围（例如比赛结束后继续攻击）。

因此，武术家通过参赛，默示同意(Implied Consent)了比赛中可能发生的身体接触和伤害。这是拳击手面临刑事指控时最有力的辩护。

❌ 其他选项为何不是最佳？

选项 A 无意打断鼻梁
错误原因：殴打罪(Battery)是一般意图犯罪(General Intent Crime)。被告只需要有意图进行“非法的身体接触”（即出拳），而不需要具体意图去造成特定的严重后果（如断鼻）。因此，缺乏造成特定伤害的意图不是有效的辩护。
选项 B & D 关于手套和倒地状态的事实
错误原因：这些选项只是陈述了事实（Fact）。
  • 选项 B 证明了攻击方式符合拳击常态（未违规使用张开的手套）。
  • 选项 D 证明了攻击时机尚未完全违规（未在完全倒地后攻击）。
虽然这些事实有助于证明行为在“同意的范围”内，但它们本身不是法律抗辩理由。真正的法律抗辩理由是基于这些事实产生的“同意”(Consent)。
💡 MBE 考试技巧
在处理涉及接触性运动（如拳击、橄榄球）的殴打罪题目时：

1. 首先判断行为是否严重超出了运动规则和常规（例如：比赛结束后持械攻击）。
2. 如果行为在运动的可预见范围内，即使造成了严重伤害，“同意” (Consent) 几乎总是最佳答案。
3. 区分“事实”和“法律抗辩”。选项中描述事实的句子通常不如直接点明法律原理（如 Consent）的选项好。

A new lawyer has three clients, all of whom are indigent. To improve the appearance of his office, he decided to purchase some new furniture and to pay for it out of future earnings. Wearing an expensive suit borrowed from a friend, the lawyer went to a furniture store and asked to purchase on credit a desk and various other items of furniture. The lawyer told the store owner that he was a very able lawyer with a growing practice and that he expected to do very well in the future. The store owner agreed to sell him the items on credit, and the lawyer promised to make monthly payments of $800.
The lawyer has never had an income from his practice of more than $150 a month. The lawyer's business did not improve, and he did not make any payments to the furniture store. After three months, the store owner repossessed the items.
If the lawyer is charged with obtaining property by false pretenses, what is his best argument for being NOT guilty?

choices.a: Even if he misled the store owner, he intended to pay for the items.
choices.b: He did not misrepresent any material fact.
choices.c: The store owner could have asked for payment in full at the time of the purchase.
choices.d: The store owner got his property back and so suffered no harm.

一名新律师有三位客户，他们都很贫困。为了改善他办公室的形象，他决定购买一些新家具，并用未来的收入来支付。这位律师穿着从朋友那里借来的一套昂贵西装，去了一家家具店，要求以赊账方式购买一张书桌和其他各种家具。律师告诉店主，他是一位非常有能力的律师，业务蒸蒸日上，并预计未来会发展得很好。店主同意以赊账方式将这些物品卖给他，律师承诺每月支付800美元。

该律师执业以来的月收入从未超过150美元。律师的业务没有改善，他也没有向家具店支付任何款项。三个月后，店主收回了这些物品。

如果该律师被指控以虚假陈述骗取财物(obtaining property by false pretenses)，他最好的无罪辩护理由是什么？
options:
A. Even if he misled the store owner, he intended to pay for the items.
即使他误导了店主，他仍打算支付这些物品的费用。

B. He did not misrepresent any material fact.
他没有对任何重要事实(material fact)进行虚假陈述。

C. The store owner could have asked for payment in full at the time of the purchase.
店主本可以在购买时要求全额付款。

D. The store owner got his property back and so suffered no harm.
店主已收回其财产，因此没有遭受任何损害。
data.explanation:
Misrepresentation (false pretenses & larceny by trick)


TypeDefinitionLiability
Statement of factRelates to past or present fact victim would reasonably consider in deciding whether to transfer propertyAll jurisdictions
False promisePromise made with no intention of keeping itMost jurisdictions
Future eventRelates to something that will take place in the futureNo liability
OpinionSales talk or puffery
The crime of false pretenses requires proof that the defendant:

knowingly misrepresented a past or existing material fact did so with the specific intent to defraud and thereby obtained title to the property of another.

A material fact is a fact that a person would reasonably consider in deciding whether to transfer the property. Therefore, a misrepresentation cannot stem from an opinion or a prediction about a future event.

Here, the lawyer told the store owner that he was a very capable attorney (opinion) with a growing practice and expected to do very well in the future (future event). And the store owner may have considered this statement when he agreed to sell the furniture to the lawyer on credit. But if the lawyer successfully argues that his statements were not misrepresentations of material fact, he would not be found guilty of false pretenses.

(Choice A) In most jurisdictions, liability for false pretenses can stem from a false promise - ie, a promise made with no intent to keep it. Therefore, arguing that the lawyer did intend to pay for the items would show that he did not make a false promise. But this is an incomplete defense since he could still be liable if his other statements were deemed misrepresentations of material fact.

(Choice C) A victim is not required to take affirmative action to prevent a crime. Therefore, an argument that the store owner could have asked for an upfront payment in full (thereby preventing the alleged crime) would fail.

(Choice D) "No harm, no foul" is no defense to false pretenses. And here, the store owner was harmed because he was deprived of his property for three months.

Educational objective: False pretenses requires a misrepresentation of a past or existing material fact - not opinions or predictions of future events.

选项正确率统计：A选项 38%，B选项 52%（正确选项），C选项 2%，D选项 6%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

虚假陈述 (false pretenses & larceny by trick)


类型定义法律责任
事实陈述涉及受害人在决定是否转让财产时会合理考虑的过去或现在的事实所有司法管辖区
虚假承诺作出时无意遵守的承诺大多数司法管辖区
未来事件涉及将来会发生的事情无法律责任
意见销售说辞或吹嘘
以虚假陈述骗取财物罪(false pretenses)要求证明被告：

明知地虚假陈述了一个过去或现存的重要事实(material fact)，其具有欺诈的具体意图，并且因此获得了他人财产的所有权。

重要事实是指一个人在决定是否转让财产时会合理考虑的事实。因此，虚假陈述不能源于意见或对未来事件的预测。

在本案中，律师告诉店主他是一位非常有能力的律师（意见），业务蒸蒸日上，并预计未来会发展得很好（未来事件）。店主在同意以赊账方式将家具出售给律师时，可能考虑了这一陈述。但是，如果律师成功地辩称他的陈述并非对重要事实的虚假陈述，他就不会被判犯有以虚假陈述骗取财物罪。

（选项 A）在大多数司法管辖区，以虚假陈述骗取财物罪的法律责任可源于虚假承诺——即作出时无意遵守的承诺。因此，辩称律师确实打算支付这些物品的费用，将表明他没有作出虚假承诺。但这是一个不完整的辩护，因为如果他的其他陈述被视为对重要事实的虚假陈述，他仍然可能需要承担法律责任。

（选项 C）法律不要求受害人采取积极行动来阻止犯罪。因此，那种认为店主本可以要求预先全额付款（从而阻止所指控的犯罪）的论点将不成立。

（选项 D）“无损害即无犯规”不能作为以虚假陈述骗取财物罪的辩护理由。而且在本案中，店主确实受到了损害，因为他被剥夺了其财产三个月。

教学目的：以虚假陈述骗取财物罪(False pretenses)要求对过去或现存的重要事实进行虚假陈述，而非意见或对未来事件的预测。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：虚假陈述罪

本题考查刑法中的核心概念：以虚假陈述骗取财物罪 (Obtaining Property by False Pretenses)。要正确回答此题，必须理解该罪名的构成要件，特别是关于“事实”的定义。

核心法则 (The Rule)

以虚假陈述骗取财物罪要求被告人：

  1. 对过去或现存的重要事实 (Past or Existing Material Fact) 进行虚假陈述；
  2. 具有欺诈的意图 (Intent to Defraud)；
  3. 导致受害人转移了财产的所有权 (Title)。

为什么选 B 是最好的辩护？

正确答案 B

理由：他没有对任何重要事实进行虚假陈述。

这是本题的“题眼”。在普通法和大多数现代司法管辖区，要构成此罪，虚假陈述必须针对事实。以下两类陈述通常不被视为“事实”：

  • 意见/吹嘘 (Opinion/Puffery)： 销售中的夸大其词。
  • 未来预测 (Future Events)： 对将来发生之事的预测或承诺。

本案事实分析表

律师的陈述 性质分类 是否构成犯罪要素？
"非常有能力的律师" 意见 (Opinion) 否 ❌
"业务蒸蒸日上" 吹嘘/模糊意见 (Puffery) 否 ❌ (通常视为销售话术)
"预计未来发展很好" 未来预测 (Prediction) 否 ❌
"承诺每月付款" 未来承诺 (Promise) 否 ❌ (仅凭违约不能定罪)

由于律师的所有陈述要么是主观意见，要么是对未来的预测，他并没有歪曲一个“过去或现存的重要事实”。因此，从构成要件上攻击检方的指控（即选项B）是彻底无罪的最强理由。

其他选项为何不是最佳？

选项 A

"他打算支付费用"：虽然这能否定“欺诈意图” (Intent to Defraud)，但这通常针对的是“虚假承诺”的情况。如果法律认定他的其他陈述（如业务状况）构成了事实欺诈，仅仅打算付款可能不足以完全脱罪。相比之下，选项B直接否定了犯罪行为 (Actus Reus) 的存在，是更底层的防御。

选项 C

"店主本可以要求全款"：这是指责受害人疏忽。在刑法中，受害人的疏忽不是辩护理由。只要被告人的欺诈行为是导致财产转移的原因，受害人是否轻信并不重要。

选项 D

"店主收回了财产无损害"：刑法关注的是犯罪行为完成时的状态。一旦律师通过欺诈获得了家具的所有权（或占有），犯罪即已完成。事后的归还或赔偿 (Restitution) 不是刑事责任的辩护理由，只能作为量刑时的考量。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧

在处理欺诈类题目时，务必区分商业吹嘘 (Puffery) 和事实陈述 (Statement of Fact)。如果被告说“这是世界上最好的车”，这是吹嘘；如果说“这辆车去年刚换过引擎”，这是事实。只有后者造假才构成犯罪。

questions.question:
A woman who owned a prestigious art gallery was looking for paintings by a recently deceased artist. One of her clients had offered to pay over market price for one of the artist's paintings if the woman could deliver it to the client's home in time for a lavish party that he was throwing the following week. The woman was unable to acquire any of the artist's paintings. However, she knew that her grandfather, an avid art collector, owned one of the artist's earlier works. Knowing that her grandfather was out of town on vacation, the woman decided to have one of her employees pick up the painting from her grandfather's house. The woman falsely told the employee that the grandfather had given her the painting as a gift. When the employee arrived at the grandfather's house, he noticed that the garage door was open and saw the painting leaned up against a wall. The employee walked into the garage, took the painting, and delivered it to the woman. When the grandfather returned from his vacation the following day, he realized that the painting was missing and immediately called the police.
Can the woman be properly convicted of larceny?

choices.a: No, because the employee, as the woman's agent, was unaware of her criminal intent.
choices.b: No, but the woman can be convicted of larceny by trick.
choices.c: Yes, because the woman told the employee to take the artwork with the intent to steal it.
choices.d: Yes, provided the woman does not return the artwork after the client's party.

一名拥有一家著名艺术画廊的女子正在寻找一位已故艺术家的画作。她的一位客户曾提出要约，如果该女子能及时将这位艺术家的一幅画送到客户家中，以赶上他下周举办的盛大派对，客户愿意支付高于市场价的价格。该女子未能购得任何该艺术家的画作。然而，她知道她酷爱收藏艺术品的祖父拥有一幅该艺术家的早期作品。由于知道祖父外出度假，该女子决定让一名员工去她祖父家取画。该女子向员工谎称祖父已将这幅画作为礼物送给了她。当这名员工到达祖父家时，他注意到车库门是开着的，并看到那幅画靠在墙上。这名员工走进车库，拿走了画，并把它交给了该女子。第二天，当祖父度假回来后，他发现画不见了，并立即报警。

该女子是否可被恰当地判定犯有 Larceny？
options:
A. No, because the employee, as the woman's agent, was unaware of her criminal intent.
不可以，因为该员工作为女子的代理人，并不知道她的犯罪意图。

B. No, but the woman can be convicted of larceny by trick.
不可以，但该女子可被判定犯有 Larceny by trick。

C. Yes, because the woman told the employee to take the artwork with the intent to steal it.
可以，因为该女子告知员工去拿走艺术品，并怀有偷窃的意图。

D. Yes, provided the woman does not return the artwork after the client's party.
可以，前提是该女子在客户的派对结束后没有归还该艺术品。
data.explanation:
Larceny is the unlawful taking and carrying away of another's personal property with the specific intent to permanently deprive the owner of that property. The taking requirement is satisfied by any trespassory removal of the property from the owner's possession into another's control. As a result, the taking can be committed by the defendant personally or by the defendant's agent - even one who is unaware of the defendant's criminal intent.

Here, the woman ordered her employee (agent) to take her grandfather's painting. Although the employee had no knowledge of the woman's criminal intent, an unlawful taking still occurred when he took the painting from the grandfather's garage and delivered it to the woman (Choice A). And since the woman had the specific intent to permanently deprive her grandfather of the painting at the time the taking occurred, she can be convicted of larceny.

(Choice B) Larceny by trick is larceny accomplished by a knowing misrepresentation of a past or present material fact that results in the conversion of another's property. The misrepresentation must be made to and relied upon by the victim. But here, the woman's misrepresentation that she was gifted the artwork was made to induce the employee - not the grandfather. Therefore, she cannot be convicted of larceny by trick.

(Choice D) Larceny is complete at the time of the taking. As a result, there is no defense of restoration if the defendant later has a change of heart and returns the property to the rightful owner.

Educational objective: The taking requirement for larceny is satisfied by any trespassory removal of the property from the owner's possession into another's control. The taking can be committed by the defendant personally or by an agent - even one who is unaware of the defendant's criminal intent.



选项正确率统计：A选项 2%，B选项 4%，C选项 72%（正确选项），D选项 20%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

Larceny（盗窃罪）是指怀有永久剥夺所有者财产的特定意图，非法拿走并带走他人个人财产的行为。只要发生了将财产从业主占有中任何侵权性地移走并置于他人控制之下的行为，就满足了拿走的要件。因此，拿走行为可由被告人亲自实施，也可由被告人的代理人实施——即使该代理人不知道被告人的犯罪意图。

在本案中，该女子命令其员工（代理人）去拿她祖父的画。尽管该员工对女子的犯罪意图并不知情，但当他从祖父的车库中拿走画作并交给该女子时，一次非法的拿走行为仍然发生了（选项A）。并且，由于该女子在拿走行为发生时，怀有永久剥夺其祖父画作的特定意图，她可被判定犯有 Larceny。

（选项B） Larceny by trick 是通过对过去或现在的重大事实进行明知的虚假陈述，从而导致他人财产被侵占而完成的 Larceny。这种虚假陈述必须是向受害人作出并被受害人所信赖。但在本案中，该女子谎称她获赠该艺术品，是为了引诱其员工——而非其祖父。因此，她不能被判定犯有 Larceny by trick。

（选项D） Larceny 在拿走行为发生时即已完成。因此，如果被告人后来改变主意并将财产归还给合法所有者，也不能以归还作为抗辩理由。

教学目的：只要发生了将财产从业主占有中任何侵权性地移走并置于他人控制之下的行为，就满足了 Larceny 的拿走要件。拿走行为可由被告人亲自实施，也可由代理人实施——即使该代理人不知道被告人的犯罪意图。

MBE 考点解析

Criminal Law • Larceny
核心考点：无辜代理人 (Innocent Agent)

本题考察的是利用不知情的第三方实施犯罪时的责任归属。在刑法中，如果你利用一个不知情的人（Innocent Agent）来实施犯罪行为（Actus Reus），法律会将该行为直接归责于你。

法律规则解析

盗窃罪 (Larceny) 的定义是：

  • 非法拿走并带走 (Trespassory taking and carrying away)
  • 他人的个人财产 (Personal property of another)
  • 具有永久剥夺的特定意图 (Specific intent to permanently deprive)

关键点：“拿走” (Taking) 这一要素并不要求被告人必须亲自动手。如果被告人指示代理人去拿，即使代理人不知道这是犯罪，拿走的行为在法律上仍被视为是被告人的行为。

本案案情应用

在本案中，女子（被告）想要偷画。

  1. 行为 (Actus Reus)： 她利用谎言诱导不知情的员工去拿画。员工进入车库拿走画的行为，在法律上等同于女子亲自进入车库拿走画。这构成了侵权性的拿走 (Trespassory Taking)。
  2. 意图 (Mens Rea)： 女子在指示员工时，明知画不属于自己，且目的是为了卖给客户（永久剥夺祖父的所有权）。

因此，所有盗窃罪的构成要件均已满足。

选项深度辨析
正确 选项 C
"Yes, because the woman told the employee to take the artwork with the intent to steal it."
这是正确答案。女子的命令结合她的偷窃意图，加上员工实际拿走了画，完成了 Larceny 的所有要素。员工只是她犯罪的“工具”。
错误 选项 A (代理人不知情)
代理人是否知情并不免除主谋的责任。相反，正是因为代理人不知情（无犯罪意图），他才成为了“无辜代理人”，这使得主谋（女子）成为直接正犯 (Principal in the first degree)。
陷阱 选项 B (Larceny by Trick)
这是最强的干扰项。Larceny by Trick 要求通过欺诈手段从受害者（拥有占有权的人）那里获得占有权。

在本案中，女子的欺诈对象是员工，而不是受害者（祖父）。祖父并没有因为被欺骗而自愿交出画作。因此，这不是诈骗型盗窃，而是普通盗窃。
错误 选项 D (归还抗辩)
Larceny 是即成犯。一旦画被拿走且当时具有偷窃意图，犯罪即已完成。事后是否归还（或是否有归还的打算，除非是借用抗辩）与犯罪是否成立无关。况且本案中她是为了卖掉画，根本没有归还意图。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

在涉及财产犯罪的题目中，如果出现“一个人指使另一个人做事”的情节，请立即检查：

  1. 被指使者是否知情？ 如果不知情，他是 Innocent Agent，指使者承担全部责任。
  2. 欺骗了谁？ 如果欺骗的是受害者以获取占有权，是 Larceny by Trick；如果欺骗的是受害者以获取所有权，是 False Pretenses；如果欺骗的是第三方（如本案），通常仍是普通 Larceny。

questions.question:
A principal scientist recently left her job at a biotechnology corporation that manufactures and commercializes biopharmaceuticals for various medical conditions. The scientist began working for a competitor in order to lead the development of an experimental drug that would address the same medical condition as a drug she had been developing at the corporation. When the competitor issued a press release that it was in the final stages of testing the experimental drug, the corporation presented evidence to a prosecutor that the experimental drug contained the corporation's trade secrets and that the scientist first learned of the trade secrets while working at the corporation. The corporation also provided the prosecutor with a copy of its employment contract with the scientist, under which the scientist had agreed that the trade secrets belonged to the corporation and would remain with the corporation even after her employment ceased.
In a common-law jurisdiction, which of the following property crimes is the prosecutor most likely to charge the scientist with?

choices.a: No crime, because trade secrets are intangible property.
choices.b: Embezzlement, because the scientist lawfully acquired possession of the trade secrets.
choices.c: False pretenses, because the scientist obtained title to the corporation's trade secrets.
choices.d: Larceny, because the scientist permanently deprived the corporation of its trade secrets.

The scientist began working for a competitor in order to lead the development of an experimental drug that would address the same medical condition as a drug she had been developing at the corporation. When the competitor issued a press release that it was in the final stages of testing the experimental drug, the corporation presented evidence to a prosecutor that the experimental drug contained the corporation's trade secrets and that the scientist first learned of the trade secrets while working at the corporation. The corporation also provided the prosecutor with a copy of its employment contract with the scientist, under which the scientist had agreed that the trade secrets belonged to the corporation and would remain with the corporation even after her employment ceased.

In a common-law jurisdiction, which of the following property crimes is the prosecutor most likely to charge the scientist with?

一位首席科学家最近从一家生物技术公司离职，该公司为各种医疗状况生产和商业化生物制药产品。该科学家开始为一家竞争对手工作，以领导一种实验性药物的开发，该药物将用于治疗与她在前公司开发的一种药物相同的医疗状况。当竞争对手发布新闻稿称其正在对该实验性药物进行最后阶段的测试时，原公司向检察官提交了证据，证明该实验性药物包含了公司的商业秘密，并且该科学家是在公司工作期间首次获知这些商业秘密的。公司还向检察官提供了其与该科学家的雇佣合同副本，根据该合同，科学家同意商业秘密属于公司，即使在她离职后仍归公司所有。

在一个普通法司法管辖区，检察官最可能以以下哪种财产犯罪指控该科学家？
options:
A. No crime, because trade secrets are intangible property.
不构成犯罪，因为商业秘密是无形财产。

B. Embezzlement, because the scientist lawfully acquired possession of the trade secrets.
侵占罪，因为该科学家合法取得了商业秘密的占有权。

C. False pretenses, because the scientist obtained title to the corporation's trade secrets.
诈骗罪，因为该科学家获得了公司商业秘密的所有权。

D. Larceny, because the scientist permanently deprived the corporation of its trade secrets.
盗窃罪，因为该科学家永久剥夺了公司的商业秘密。
data.explanation:
Legislative changes to theft crimes


Common lawMPC & state criminal codes
  • Larceny, embezzlement, false pretenses & receipt of stolen goods are separate offenses
  • Property limited to tangible personal property
  • Theft is a single statutory crime that encompasses larceny, embezzlement, false pretenses & receiving stolen goods
  • Property broadened to include anything of value - including intangibles, services, documents
MPC = Model Penal Code.

At common law, liability for property crimes is limited to the trespassory or otherwise unlawful taking of tangible property.† Trade secrets are intangible property, so it is unlikely that the prosecutor will charge the scientist with a property crime in this common-law jurisdiction.

†The Model Penal Code and modern theft statutes expand criminal liability for property crimes to include intangible property (eg, trade secrets).

(Choice B) Embezzlement is the fraudulent conversion of another's property by someone in lawful possession of that property. The scientist may have acquired lawful possession of the trade secrets through her employment with the corporation. But in a common-law jurisdiction, the embezzled property must be tangible property or, in some states, real property - not intangible property (as seen here).

(Choice C) False pretenses is obtaining title to another's property by knowingly making a false representation of a past or present material fact with the specific intent to defraud. Here, there is no indication that a false representation was made, and title to the trade secrets never passed from the corporation to the scientist. Additionally, only tangible property is subject to a charge of false pretenses at common law.

(Choice D) Larceny is the unlawful taking and carrying away of another's personal property with the specific intent to permanently deprive the owner of that property. At common law, the property taken must be tangible personal property; intangible property will not suffice.‡

‡ However, documents that represent a right to intangible property are treated as personal property.

Educational objective: Common-law property crimes limit criminal liability to the trespassory or otherwise unlawful taking of tangible property.

选项正确率统计：A选项 55%（正确选项），B选项 36%，C选项 3%，D选项 5%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

盗窃罪的立法演变


普通法MPC & 州刑法典
  • 盗窃罪（Larceny）、侵占罪、诈骗罪和收受赃物罪是独立的罪名
  • 财产仅限于有形动产
  • 盗窃罪（Theft）是单一的法定罪名，涵盖了盗窃罪（Larceny）、侵占罪、诈骗罪和收受赃物罪
  • 财产范围扩大到包括任何有价值的东西——包括无形资产、服务、文件
MPC = Model Penal Code。

在普通法下，财产犯罪的责任仅限于对有形财产的侵占性或非法占有。† 商业秘密是无形财产，因此在该普通法司法管辖区，检察官不太可能以财产犯罪起诉该科学家。

†Model Penal Code 和现代盗窃法规将财产犯罪的刑事责任扩大到包括无形财产（例如，商业秘密）。

(选项B) 侵占罪是指合法占有他人财产的人对该财产进行欺诈性侵吞。该科学家可能通过其在公司的雇佣关系合法取得了对商业秘密的占有。但在普通法司法管辖区，被侵占的财产必须是有形财产，或在某些州，是不动产——而不是（如此案所示的）无形财产。

(选项C) 诈骗罪是指通过故意作出关于过去或现在重大事实的虚假陈述，并怀有特定欺诈意图，从而获得他人财产的所有权。在本案中，没有迹象表明存在虚假陈述，且商业秘密的所有权从未从公司转移给科学家。此外，在普通法下，只有有形财产才会构成诈骗罪的指控对象。

(选项D) 盗窃罪（Larceny）是指非法占有并带走他人动产，并怀有永久剥夺该财产所有者所有权的特定意图。在普通法下，被占有的财产必须是有形动产；无形财产则不构成此罪。‡

‡ 然而，代表无形财产权的文件被视为动产。

教学目标：普通法财产犯罪将刑事责任限制于对有形财产的侵占性或非法占有。

References

Charles E. Torcia, 3 Wharton's Criminal Law § 371 (15th ed. 2020) (discussing that at common law only tangible personal property can be the subject of larceny).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：普通法下的财产定义

本题考察的是刑法中关于财产犯罪对象（Subject Matter of Property Crimes）在不同法律体系下的关键区别。

核心结论：
在普通法（Common Law）管辖区，盗窃类犯罪的对象严格限于有形动产（Tangible Personal Property）。

1. 法律依据与推理逻辑

题目明确指出该司法管辖区适用普通法（Common-law jurisdiction）。这是解题的关键约束条件。

  • 普通法规则： 传统的普通法对“财产”的定义非常狭隘。Larceny（盗窃罪）、Embezzlement（侵占罪）和 False Pretenses（诈骗罪）只能针对可以被物理移动和感知的“有形动产”。
  • 本案事实： 科学家带走的是“商业秘密”（Trade Secrets）。商业秘密本质上是信息、配方或知识，属于无形财产（Intangible Property）。
  • 结论： 由于无形财产不是普通法下财产犯罪的合格对象，因此科学家在普通法下不构成上述任何财产犯罪。

2. 普通法 vs. 现代法 (MPC)

这是MBE考试中常见的对比考点：

维度 普通法 (Common Law) 现代法/MPC (Modern Codes)
财产范围 仅限有形动产
(Tangible Personal Property)		 包括任何有价值之物
(Any thing of value)
具体包含 物品、金钱 有形物、无形资产(商业秘密)、服务、不动产、电力等
本案结果 无罪 可能构成盗窃罪

3. 选项辨析

选项 A (正确)
不构成犯罪。 正如上述分析，商业秘密是无形财产。虽然现代法规（如《经济间谍法》）将其定为犯罪，但在题目限定的“普通法管辖区”内，检察官无法以财产犯罪起诉。
选项 B (侵占罪 Embezzlement)
错误。虽然科学家可能“合法占有”了信息，但侵占罪在普通法下同样要求对象是有形财产。
选项 C (诈骗罪 False Pretenses)
错误。除了财产属性问题外，诈骗罪要求转移所有权（Title）。科学家仅获知了秘密，并未获得公司的所有权，且同样受限于“有形财产”规则。
选项 D (盗窃罪 Larceny)
错误。Larceny 是最古老的普通法犯罪，严格要求对象是他人占有的有形动产。无形的信息不能成为 Larceny 的对象。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 (Exam Tip) 在做刑法题时，务必第一时间圈出题目中的司法管辖区设定：
  • 如果是 "Common Law Jurisdiction"：应用古老、僵化的规则（如本题）。
  • 如果是 "Modern Jurisdiction" 或 "Model Penal Code"：应用更宽泛、符合现代常识的规则。
如果题目未说明，通常默认应用普通法规则，除非涉及特定现代成文法例外。

questions.question:
Early one morning, a husband and wife were walking through an empty parking garage toward their sports car. As they neared the car, a man carrying a crowbar jumped out from behind the car and yelled, "Give me all of your jewelry and your money, or else I will beat your car to a pulp!" The husband and wife handed their jewelry and money to the man, and the man quickly departed. The man was later found and arrested for robbery.
Is the man likely guilty of robbery?

choices.a: No, because a taking by intimidation alone is insufficient to support a robbery conviction.
choices.b: No, because the man only threatened to damage the car.
choices.c: Yes, because the husband and wife had a reasonable apprehension of property damage.
choices.d: Yes, because the man specifically intended to deprive the husband and wife of the money and jewelry.

As they neared the car, a man carrying a crowbar jumped out from behind the car and yelled, "Give me all of your jewelry and your money, or else I will beat your car to a pulp!" The husband and wife handed their jewelry and money to the man, and the man quickly departed. The man was later found and arrested for robbery.

Is the man likely guilty of robbery?

一天清晨，一对夫妻正穿过一个空无一人的停车场，走向他们的跑车。当他们走近车时，一名手持撬棍的男子从车后跳出来，大喊道：“把你所有的珠宝和钱都给我，不然我就把你的车砸个稀巴烂！”这对夫妻将珠宝和钱交给了该男子，该男子迅速离开。该男子后来被找到并因抢劫罪（robbery）被捕。

该男子是否可能构成抢劫罪（robbery）？
options:
A. No, because a taking by intimidation alone is insufficient to support a robbery conviction.
不会，因为仅凭恐吓取得财物不足以支持抢劫罪（robbery）的定罪。

B. No, because the man only threatened to damage the car.
不会，因为该男子只威胁要损坏汽车。

C. Yes, because the husband and wife had a reasonable apprehension of property damage.
会，因为这对夫妻对财产损失有合理的担忧。

D. Yes, because the man specifically intended to deprive the husband and wife of the money and jewelry.
会，因为该男子有明确意图剥夺这对夫妻的钱财和珠宝。
data.explanation:
Robbery


(larceny by force v. intimidation) ForceUse of more force than necessary to acquire property or retain the property immediately thereafter
IntimidationThreat that places victim in reasonable apprehension of immediate death or serious physical injury to victim, close family member, or person present
Robbery requires proof of three elements:
  • The defendant committed larceny - ie, a trespassory taking and carrying away of a victim's personal property with the specific intent to steal.
  • The property was taken from the victim's person or in the victim's presence.
  • The taking was accomplished by force or intimidation.
A taking by intimidation occurs when there is an immediate threat of death or serious physical injury to the victim, a close family member, or another person present. But a threat to damage or destroy property (as seen here), other than the victim's home, is not sufficient. Therefore, the man likely is not guilty of robbery.

(Choice A) A taking by intimidation alone is sufficient to support a robbery conviction. But that intimidation must come in the form of an immediate threat of death or serious physical injury to the victim, a close family member, or another person present (not seen here).

(Choice C) The husband and wife may have had a reasonable apprehension of property damage. But that is insufficient to support a robbery conviction.

(Choice D) The man did specifically intend to permanently deprive the husband and wife of the money and jewelry. But since the taking was accomplished by a threat of damage to the couple's car, the man is not likely to be convicted of robbery.

Educational objective: For robbery, a taking by intimidation occurs when there is an immediate threat of death or serious physical injury to the victim, a close family member, or another person present. But a threat to damage or destroy property, other than the victim's home, is not sufficient.

选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 47%（正确选项），C选项 30%，D选项 20%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

抢劫罪（Robbery）


(通过暴力或恐吓实施的盗窃罪) 暴力为获取财产或在获取财产后立即保住该财产而使用了超出必要限度的暴力
恐吓使受害人、其近亲或在场人员对立即发生的死亡或严重人身伤害产生合理恐惧的威胁
抢劫罪（Robbery）的成立需要证明三个要素：
  • 被告人犯有盗窃罪（larceny）——即，以盗窃为特定意图，非法占有并带走受害人的个人财产。
  • 财产是从受害人的人身上或在其面前被取走的。
  • 该取得行为是通过暴力或恐吓完成的。
通过恐吓取得财物是指，存在对受害人、其近亲或在场的其他人造成立即死亡或严重人身伤害的威胁。但是，威胁损坏或毁坏财产（如此案所示），除非该财产是受害人的住宅，否则是不充分的。因此，该男子很可能不构成抢劫罪（robbery）。

(选项A) 仅凭恐吓取得财物是足以支持抢劫罪（robbery）定罪的。但这种恐吓必须是对受害人、其近亲或在场的其他人造成立即死亡或严重人身伤害的威胁（本案中未出现此种情况）。

(选项C) 这对夫妻可能对财产损失有合理的担忧。但这不足以支持抢劫罪（robbery）的定罪。

(选项D) 该男子确实有明确意图永久剥夺这对夫妻的钱财和珠宝。但由于取得财物是通过威胁损坏夫妻二人的汽车来完成的，该男子不太可能被判处抢劫罪（robbery）。

教学目标：就抢劫罪（robbery）而言，通过恐吓取得财物，是指存在对受害人、其近亲或在场其他人造成立即死亡或严重人身伤害的威胁。但是，威胁损坏或毁坏除受害人住宅以外的财产，是不充分的。

MBE 考点解析

Criminal Law: Robbery
⚖️ 黑体字法 (Black Letter Law)

抢劫罪 (Robbery) 的定义是：通过暴力 (Force) 或恐吓 (Intimidation) 从他人身上或面前非法夺取并带走个人财产，意图永久剥夺。

关于 恐吓 (Intimidation) 的关键限制：

  • 必须是威胁造成立即的死亡或严重人身伤害 (Immediate death or serious physical injury)。
  • 对象可以是受害人、其近亲或在场人员。
  • ⚠️ 关键例外： 威胁损坏财产 (Threat to damage property) 通常不构成抢劫罪（除非是威胁毁坏受害人的住宅/Dwelling）。
🔍 案情逻辑分析

本题考察的是抢劫罪中“恐吓”要素的边界。

  1. 行为：被告人手持撬棍 (Crowbar) 跳出。
  2. 言语："Give me... or else I will beat your car to a pulp!"（给我钱……否则我就把你的车砸烂！）
  3. 定性：虽然被告人手持凶器，但他明确表达的威胁是针对汽车（财产），而非针对夫妻二人的身体（人身）。

根据普通法规则，仅威胁损坏财产（非住宅）不足以满足抢劫罪中的“恐吓”要素。因此，该行为不构成 Robbery。

✅ 正确答案解析 (选项 B)

B 是正确的。 因为该男子仅威胁要损坏汽车 (Threatened to damage the car)。

由于威胁的对象是普通财产（跑车），而非人身安全，这缺失了抢劫罪所需的 "Force or Intimidation" 要素。这种行为可能构成勒索罪 (Extortion/Blackmail) 或单纯的盗窃罪 (Larceny)，但在法律技术层面上不构成抢劫。

❌ 选项 A 错误： 法律并不要求必须使用实际暴力。恐吓 (Intimidation) 本身是足以支持抢劫罪定罪的，前提是该恐吓必须是针对人身安全的。

❌ 选项 C 错误： 虽然夫妻二人对财产损失有“合理的担忧” (Reasonable apprehension)，但这不符合抢劫罪的标准。抢劫罪要求的是对人身伤害的恐惧。

❌ 选项 D 错误： 仅仅有“剥夺财产的意图” (Specific intent to deprive) 是不够的。抢劫罪是复合并列的：必须同时具备盗窃的意图 加上 使用暴力或人身威胁的手段。手段不符，罪名不成立。

💡 MBE 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在处理 Robbery 题目时，请仔细检查威胁的性质：

  • 威胁打断腿？ ➡️ Robbery
  • 威胁烧房子 (Dwelling)？ ➡️ Robbery (历史例外)
  • 威胁砸车、杀狗、毁坏名画？ ➡️ Not Robbery (通常是 Extortion 或 Larceny)
  • 威胁未来某天打你？ ➡️ Not Robbery (威胁必须是 Immediate 的)

questions.question:
The ringmaster of a circus recognized a man sitting in the front row at one of his shows as his ex-wife's new boyfriend. Bitter and jealous, the ringmaster told one of the clowns who worked in the circus to choose the man to be a part of the show when it came time to involve members of the audience. He also instructed the clown to punch the man in the stomach once the other clowns were running around the stage and doing pranks for the audience. When it came time to involve audience members, the clown picked the man, and the man agreed to come on stage. The clown subsequently punched the man in the stomach as planned. The clown immediately regretted doing so, and he blurted out that the ringmaster had told him to do it. The man suffered internal bleeding as a result of the punch.
Can the ringmaster be properly convicted of battery?

choices.a: No, because the man implicitly consented to the battery by agreeing to be a part of the show.
choices.b: No, because the ringmaster can only be properly convicted of solicitation.
choices.c: Yes, because the clown's intent to punch the man was transferred to the ringmaster under the doctrine of transferred intent.
choices.d: Yes, because the ringmaster told the clown to punch the man in the stomach.

一个马戏团的团长在一次表演中，认出坐在前排的一名男子是他前妻的新男友。出于痛苦和嫉妒，团长让马戏团的一名小丑在需要观众参与表演时，选择该男子上台。他还指示小丑，当其他小丑在舞台上跑来跑去、向观众恶作剧时，一拳打在该男子的腹部。到了需要观众参与的环节，小丑选中了那名男子，该男子也同意上台。随后，小丑按计划一拳打在该男子的腹部。小丑立即后悔了，并脱口说出是团长让他这么做的。该男子因这一拳导致内出血。

团长是否可以被正当地判定犯有伤害罪（battery）？
options:
A. No, because the man implicitly consented to the battery by agreeing to be a part of the show.
不可以，因为该男子同意参与表演，即默示同意了该伤害行为。

B. No, because the ringmaster can only be properly convicted of solicitation.
不可以，因为团长只应被正当地判定犯有教唆罪。

C. Yes, because the clown's intent to punch the man was transferred to the ringmaster under the doctrine of transferred intent.
可以，因为根据转移意图原则（doctrine of transferred intent），小丑殴打该男子的意图被转移到了团长身上。

D. Yes, because the ringmaster told the clown to punch the man in the stomach.
可以，因为团长让小丑殴打该男子的腹部。
data.explanation:
Criminal battery is the unlawful application of force to another that results in harmful or offensive contact. Although the force can be applied directly by the defendant, this requirement is also met if the defendant:
  • ordered another person to apply force, thereby acting as an accomplice or
  • set an object in motion that resulted in the application of force (eg, by throwing a rock at the victim).
Here, the ringmaster ordered the clown to punch the man in the stomach (unlawful application of force). The clown did so, causing the man to bleed internally (harmful contact). As a result, the ringmaster can be properly convicted of battery.

(Choice A) Consent to conduct that may cause bodily injury is a defense to battery when, in the case of a sporting event or similar activity, the defendant's conduct and the victim's injury were reasonably foreseeable. But here, it was not reasonably foreseeable that the man would sustain a punch that caused internal bleeding by participating in a circus show.

(Choice B) Solicitation occurs when a person:
  • entices, encourages, requests, or commands another to commit a crime
  • with the specific intent that the crime be committed.
If the crime is completed, the soliciting party is liable for the crime as an accomplice and the solicitation merges with the completed crime (as seen here).†

†Had the clown ignored the ringmaster's order, the ringmaster would only be guilty of solicitation.

(Choice C) Under the doctrine of transferred intent, a defendant's intent to harm one person is transferred to another whom the defendant unintentionally harmed while attempting to harm the first person. This doctrine does not transfer intent from a person acting under the defendant's direction to the defendant.

Educational objective: For battery, the defendant can unlawfully apply force to another by:
  • applying the force directly,
  • ordering another person to apply force, or
  • setting an object in motion that results in the application of force.




选项正确率统计：A选项 0%，B选项 22%，C选项 12%，D选项 63%（正确选项）

刑事伤害罪（Criminal battery）是指对他人非法使用武力，导致有害或冒犯性接触。虽然武力可由被告直接施加，但在以下情况下，该要件也同样满足：
  • 命令他人施加武力，从而充当共犯或
  • 使某一物体运动从而施加武力（例如，向受害人扔石头）。
在本案中，团长命令小丑殴打该男子腹部（非法使用武力）。小丑照做了，导致该男子内出血（有害接触）。因此，团长可以被正当地判定犯有伤害罪（battery）。

(选项 A) 在体育赛事或类似活动中，当被告的行为和受害人的伤害是可合理预见的，那么同意可能造成身体伤害的行为可以作为对伤害罪（battery）的抗辩。但在本案中，该男子参与马戏表演会遭到导致内出血的一拳，这是不可合理预见的。

(选项 B) 教唆罪（Solicitation）发生在一人：
  • 引诱、鼓励、请求或命令他人犯罪
  • 且具有希望该罪行被实施的特定意图。
如果罪行完成，教唆方将作为共犯对该罪行承担责任，并且教唆罪与已完成的罪行相吸收（如本案所示）。†

†如果小丑没有听从团长的命令，团长将只犯有教唆罪。

(选项 C) 根据转移意图原则（doctrine of transferred intent），被告伤害某人的意图，会转移到被告在试图伤害该人时无意中伤害的另一个人身上。该原则不适用于将按被告指示行事的人的意图转移给被告。

教学目标：就伤害罪（battery）而言，被告可以通过以下方式对他人非法施加武力：
  • 直接施加武力，
  • 命令他人施加武力，或
  • 使某一物体运动从而施加武力。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 刑法考点解析

Battery & Accomplice Liability

核心考点：伤害罪的构成

伤害罪 (Battery) 的定义是对他人非法施加武力，导致身体伤害或冒犯性接触。

关键点在于“施加武力” (Application of Force) 的方式：

  • 直接施加： 被告亲自拳打脚踢。
  • 间接施加： 被告启动某种力量（如扔石头、放狗咬人）。
  • 通过他人施加： 命令或指使他人实施伤害。
正确答案 D 的逻辑

本题中，团长 (Ringmaster) 虽然没有亲手打人，但他命令小丑去打。

在法律上，小丑成为了团长实施犯罪的“工具” (Instrumentality)。当团长命令小丑实施非法武力，且该行为导致了受害人内出血（有害接触）时，团长的行为完全符合 Battery 的构成要件。

结论： 团长通过命令他人实施了伤害，视同自己实施。

陷阱辨析：为何不是教唆罪？

选项 B (Solicitation) 是最大的干扰项。

确实，团长“教唆”了小丑。但是，MBE 刑法中有一个重要的原则叫 Merger Doctrine (吸收原则)。

  • 如果小丑拒绝了命令，团长只犯教唆罪 (Solicitation)。
  • 一旦小丑实施了犯罪，教唆罪就会“被吸收”进既遂的犯罪中。

因此，团长现在是伤害罪的共犯 (Accomplice to Battery) 或直接被视为正犯，而不仅仅是教唆犯。

陷阱辨析：同意与转移意图

选项 A (Consent)： 观众同意上台表演，通常只包含对轻微接触（如被推搡、被水泼）的默示同意，绝对不包括导致内出血的重击。这种伤害超出了同意的范围 (Scope of Consent)。

选项 C (Transferred Intent)： Transferred Intent 适用于“想打甲却误伤乙”的情况。本案中，团长就是想打这名男子，意图非常明确，不需要“转移”。

💡 MBE 实战技巧

在处理 Battery 题目时，切记不要局限于“被告的手是否碰到了受害人”。

只要被告引发了接触（无论是通过下毒、设陷阱、还是命令他人），只要存在非法意图 (Unlawful Intent) 和有害接触 (Harmful Contact)，Battery 即成立。

看到“命令他人犯罪且罪行已完成”，优先选择实体犯罪 (Substantive Crime) 的定罪，而不是教唆罪。

While browsing in a clothing store, an actress decided to take a purse without paying for it. She placed the purse under her coat and took a couple of steps toward the exit. She then realized that a sensor tag on the purse would set off an alarm. She placed the purse near the counter from which she had removed it.
Which crime, if any, has the actress committed?

choices.a: No crime, because the purse was never removed from the store.
choices.b: No crime, because she withdrew from her criminal enterprise.
choices.c: Only attempted larceny, because she intended to take the purse out of the store.
choices.d: Larceny, because she took the purse from its original location and concealed it with the intent to steal.

questions.question:
A man owned an investment portfolio that, for the past several years, had consistently outperformed the stock market average. When the overall stock market precipitously declined in a single day, the man immediately contacted his financial advisor to ask about the status of his investment portfolio. The advisor lied to the man and told him that due to the decline in the stock market, the value of his account was $250,000, an amount significantly less than what the man had anticipated. However, the decreased value was not attributable to the decline in the stock market but rather the advisor's negligence in managing the portfolio. The man demanded that his account be closed and that the remaining balance in the account be transferred to him within the next two days. The advisor agreed and, accordingly, closed the man's account and transferred the remaining balance two days later. Unbeknownst to the man, there had been a temporary recovery in the investment portfolio that had resulted in a $5,000 increase in the man's account balance the day before his account was closed. The advisor retained the $5,000.
In a jurisdiction that follows the common law with regard to property crimes, which crime has the advisor committed?

choices.a: Embezzlement.
choices.b: False pretenses.
choices.c: Larceny by trick.
choices.d: Theft.

A man and his friend were competitive marathon runners, and the man was determined to win a race that was upcoming in two days. The man invited his friend over for dinner, and afterward, the man asked his friend if he wanted to see the new bar that he had recently built in his basement. The friend agreed, and the man led him into his basement. When the friend entered the basement, the man locked the door behind him. The man left the friend in the basement, ran the marathon, and returned two days later to let him out. The friend immediately reported the man to the police, who subsequently arrested and charged the man with kidnapping.
Is the man guilty of kidnapping?

choices.a: No, because the friend was not moved.
choices.b: No, because the man did not use force or threats to confine the friend in the basement.
choices.c: Yes, because the friend was confined due to his reliance on the man's misrepresentation.
choices.d: Yes, because the man concealed the friend in the basement for two days.

Is the man guilty of kidnapping?

一名男子和他的朋友是竞争关系中的马拉松运动员，该男子决心赢得两天后即将举行的一场比赛。该男子邀请他的朋友共进晚餐，之后，该男子问他的朋友是否想看看他最近在地下室新建的吧台。朋友同意了，于是该男子将他带入地下室。当朋友进入地下室时，该男子从后面锁上了门。该男子将朋友留在地下室，自己去跑了马拉SONG，并于两天后回来将他放出。朋友立即向警方报案，警方随后以绑架罪逮捕并起诉了该男子。

该男子是否构成绑架罪？
options:
A. No, because the friend was not moved.
不构成，因为朋友没有被移动。

B. No, because the man did not use force or threats to confine the friend in the basement.
不构成，因为该男子没有使用武力或威胁将朋友监禁在地下室。

C. Yes, because the friend was confined due to his reliance on the man's misrepresentation.
构成，因为朋友因信赖该男子的不实陈述而被监禁。

D. Yes, because the man concealed the friend in the basement for two days.
构成，因为该男子将朋友藏匿在地下室两天。
data.explanation:
Kidnapping


Common lawForcibly abducting or stealing person from his/her own country & sending to another country
MPCUnlawfully moving or confining another to:
  • hold for ransom or as hostage
  • facilitate commission of felony or flight thereafter
  • injure/terrorize victim or another or interfere with governmental/political function
Modern viewGeneral
Intentional & unlawful confinement involving:
  • some movement (asportation) or concealment
Aggravated
General kidnapping committed for:
  • ransom
  • commission of other crime
  • offensive purpose or
  • child stealing
MPC = Model Penal Code.

Under the modern view, kidnapping is:

the intentional† and unlawful confinement of another against that person's will (eg, by force, threat, or fraud) coupled with either moving or concealing that person.

Concealment occurs when the victim is kept in a hidden location - ie, a place where the victim is not likely to be found - for a substantial period of time.

Here, the friend was unlawfully confined against his will after the man lured the friend into the basement to see the new bar. The friend was then locked in the basement for two days - a substantial period of time. And since the man's basement is a place where the friend was not likely to be found, the man is guilty of kidnapping.

†General intent crimes such as kidnapping require only the intent to perform an act that is unlawful.

(Choice A) Kidnapping can be accomplished either by moving the victim (even only a short distance) or by concealing the victim for a substantial period of time (as seen here). Therefore, the fact that the friend was not moved does not absolve the man of guilt.

(Choice B) A confinement must be accomplished by force, threat, or fraud. Although the man did not use force or threats to confine the friend in the basement, the man did use fraud to do so.

(Choice C) Unlawfully confining the friend in the basement by misrepresentation constitutes false imprisonment. But it does not amount to kidnapping, where the confinement must be against the person's will and coupled with the movement or concealment of that person.

Educational objective: Kidnapping is the intentional and unlawful confinement of another against that person's will, coupled with the movement or concealment of that person. Concealment occurs when the victim is kept in a hidden location for a substantial period of time.

绑架罪


普通法强行劫持或窃取某人，将其从本国送往另一国
MPC为达到以下目的而非法移动或监禁他人：
  • 索取赎金或作为人质
  • 为实施重罪或事后逃跑提供便利
  • 伤害/恐吓受害人或他人或干涉政府/政治职能
现代观点一般绑架罪
涉及以下情况的故意和非法监禁：
  • 某种程度的移动（转移）或藏匿
加重绑架罪
为以下目的而实施的一般绑架罪：
  • 索取赎金
  • 实施其他犯罪
  • 攻击性目的或
  • 拐带儿童
MPC = 《模范刑法典》(Model Penal Code)。

根据现代观点，绑架罪是指：

违背他人意愿（例如，通过武力、威胁或欺诈），故意†且非法地监禁他人，并伴随移动或藏匿该人。

藏匿是指将受害人置于隐蔽地点——即一个受害人不可能被发现的地方——并持续相当长的一段时间。

在本案中，在该男子引诱朋友进入地下室观看新吧台后，朋友被违背其意愿地非法监禁。朋友随后被锁在地下室两天之久——这是一段相当长的时间。并且，由于该男子的地下室是朋友不可能被找到的地方，因此该男子构成绑架罪。

†像绑架罪这类的一般意图犯罪，仅要求行为人具有实施非法行为的意图。

(选项A) 绑架罪的构成既可以通过移动受害人（即使只是短距离移动）又可以通过将受害人藏匿相当长一段时间（如本案所示）来实现。因此，朋友未被移动这一事实并不能免除该男子的罪责。

(选项B) 监禁必须通过武力、威胁或欺诈来实现。尽管该男子没有使用武力或威胁将朋友监禁在地下室，但他确实使用了欺诈手段。

(选项C) 通过不实陈述将朋友非法监禁在地下室构成非法拘禁罪。但这并不等同于绑架罪，因为绑架罪要求监禁必须违背他人意愿，并伴有移动或藏匿行为。

教学目标：绑架罪是指违背他人意愿，故意且非法地监禁他人，并伴随移动或藏匿该人的行为。藏匿是指将受害人置于隐蔽地点并持续相当长的一段时间。

References

Charles E. Torcia, 3 Wharton's Criminal Law § 207 (15th ed. 2020) (explaining that a kidnapper substantially interferes with the victim's liberty by confining the victim in a place where the victim is not likely to be found).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

刑法：绑架罪 (Kidnapping)
⚖️ 法律规则 (Modern Law)

在现代刑法（及 MPC）下，绑架罪 (Kidnapping) 的构成通常需要满足以下要素：

  1. 非法监禁 (Unlawful Confinement)：违背受害人意愿；
  2. 加重情节 (Aggravating Element)：必须包含以下二者之一：
    • 移动 (Movement/Asportation)：将受害人从一处移动到另一处；或者
    • 藏匿 (Concealment)：将受害人藏在隐蔽地点 (Secret Place) 相当长一段时间。

✅ 正确答案分析 (选项 D)

Correct Answer

理由：本题考察的是绑架罪中“藏匿”这一替代要素。

虽然受害人是自愿走进地下室的（最初没有使用武力），但被告随后将其锁住，构成了非法监禁。关键在于，被告将受害人关在私人地下室这一“隐蔽地点” (Secret Place) 长达两天 (Substantial Period)。

这种“藏匿”行为满足了绑架罪的加重构成要件，因此即使没有发生物理上的移动，依然构成绑架罪。

❌ 陷阱选项排除

选项 A (No movement)

错误点：这是普通法 (Common Law) 的旧观念。现代法律中，移动不是唯一的必要条件。如果存在“藏匿”，即使没有移动也构成绑架。

选项 B (No force/threats)

错误点：监禁可以通过武力、威胁或欺诈 (Fraud) 实现。本案中，被告利用欺诈（看吧台）诱骗受害人进入，并用锁门的物理手段实施了监禁。

选项 C (Reliance on misrepresentation)

错误点：这个选项描述了非法拘禁 (False Imprisonment) 的成因，但没有点出为何升级为绑架 (Kidnapping)。绑架罪的核心在于“监禁 + 移动/藏匿”。选项 D 更准确地指出了定罪的关键依据。

💡 MBE 解题技巧

在处理涉及限制人身自由的考题时，请按以下步骤思考：

  1. 先判断是否构成非法拘禁 (False Imprisonment)：是否违背意愿限制了某人的行动自由？
  2. 再看是否有升级要素使其成为绑架 (Kidnapping)：
    • 是否有移动 (Movement)？
    • 是否有藏匿 (Concealment)？

如果只有监禁而无上述升级要素，通常只构成非法拘禁。

questions.question:
A man who had retired from a career in music was asked to play some of his old songs at a local bar. Because he was anxious about singing after being retired for a few years, the man drank several shots of liquor at his friend's house and became intoxicated. Before he left for the bar, the man saw his friend's guitar, which was much nicer than the man's. The man wanted to give a good performance, so he took his friend's guitar to use that evening without the friend's permission. On his way to return the friend's guitar the next day, the man tripped and fell, breaking the friend's guitar outside of the friend's house. Upset by the man's actions, his friend called the police, and the man was charged with larceny.
Can the man be properly convicted of larceny?

choices.a: No, because the man did not intend to deprive the friend of his guitar indefinitely.
choices.b: No, because the man's intoxication prevented the formation of the requisite intent.
choices.c: Yes, because the man took possession of the friend's guitar without permission.
choices.d: Yes, because the man's destruction of the guitar constituted a continuing trespass.
